reviews.author: Anna-Leigh B
reviews.title: Amazing and Safe Solo Trip Experience
reviews.text:
I had a really great experience during my stay here. I traveled solo, and as someone doing a solo trip for the first time, I felt very safe and comfortable throughout my entire stay. The staff was attentive, friendly, and almost everyone spoke English very well, which made everything feel much less stressful and easy to navigate.

My room ( reserved adults only swim out suite) was clean, comfortable, and relaxing. The only downside was that the walls seemed fairly thin, so I could hear the couple staying next door at times. Aside from that, the room itself was very nice and comfortable to come back to after long days outside.

The beach was one of my favorite parts of the resort. Even though I only stayed 3 nights, every time I went down to the beach there was always someone there to help lay out towels and check in with me. Even though there were multiple vendors trying to sell you thing, the beach area was beautiful, relaxing, and very well maintained.

I also really enjoyed the restaurants on the property. I ate at Flora, Mina, and Sante during my stay. Sante had the best view, and Mina had the best atmosphere and vibe, but Flora was my favorite overall because the food and service were excellent. The staff at Flora especially stood out to me because they actually came over and made conversation with me, which I really appreciated since I was dining alone. The buffet food personally wasn’t really to my liking, but the room service was great and ended up being my preferred option.

My concierge, Eriol, was amazing throughout my stay. He always responded quickly, answered my questions, and was extremely helpful whenever I needed information or assistance. I also got a massage from Ironelis, who was very friendly and did an excellent job.

The resort also sends out a daily list of events and activities, which I appreciated. My only issue was that I sometimes had trouble figuring out where the activities were located because there weren’t many signs around the resort directing you where to go. Since I visited during a slower time of year, some activities also felt a little empty when I arrived.

Overall, I had a wonderful stay and would absolutely recommend this resort, especially for solo travelers looking for a safe and relaxing experience.

reviews.title: Truly Exceptional Care
reviews.text:
I was incredibly lucky to have Alan/Alam as my concierge during my stay. From the moment I arrived, he was a steady, warm, and genuinely reassuring presence — the kind of person who makes you feel completely taken care of without ever being intrusive.

Near the end of my trip, there was a brief logistical mix-up, and although it wasn’t the hotel’s or his responsibility, he handled it with such calm professionalism and kindness that it completely diffused any stress. He made everything feel smooth and manageable.

What stood out most was how naturally attentive he was — checking in, anticipating needs, and making me feel genuinely looked after. It felt less like a standard concierge experience and more like having someone you could fully trust to be in your corner. That sense of care made my entire stay better.

The hotel is very lucky to have him. He’s a natural at what he does, and I truly hope to return and have him as my concierge again. A wonderful and memorable part of my trip.

reviews.author: T B
reviews.title: Disappointing Experience — Reserve Upgrade Not Worth It
reviews.text:
Where do I even begin. I am genuinely confused as to how this resort has received such glowing reviews, with “lackluster” being the most consistent theme throughout my stay.

Despite my room being ready, I waited nearly an hour in the Reserve lobby while the front desk agent assisted multiple other guests. The check in experience set the tone for what was to come. 

The Kanna / private members-only area is visually appealing, but unfortunately it highlights how underwhelming the rest of the property is by comparison. I paid $575 to upgrade to The Reserve, and upon arrival, seriously considered leaving altogether.

My first experience with a Reserve-only restaurant was shockingly bad. The host appeared visibly annoyed by my presence, and after being seated, no one approached me for an extended period of time. The food was genuinely inedible. I initially tried the buffet, couldn’t stomach anything, and then ordered from the menu hoping for improvement. It wasn’t. The salad was soggy and unappetizing, and the gazpacho was equally unpleasant.

The two Reserve-only pools were extremely secluded and had no bar service, which made the upgrade feel pointless. Ironically, the large adults-only pool with a swim-up bar was accessible without any Reserve upgrade and was far superior.

After exploring the property, I immediately returned to the Reserve lobby to ask about a refund and potentially changing resorts. While the hotel did agree to refund the Reserve upgrade, they refused to refund any portion of my stay. As a result, I downgraded my room and stayed for the remaining five nights.

I have previously stayed at a Meliá property in Mexico and had an excellent experience, which made the quality gap here especially surprising.

The rest of the resort is, at best, mediocre. Poor maintenance was obvious everywhere: bad paint jobs, cracked fixtures, aging infrastructure, and neglected landscaping. Most staff members appeared disengaged and unhappy, which unfortunately showed in the service. I tried three specialty restaurants, all of which were underwhelming. The food quality across the resort was a 4/10 at best. Ironically, the buffet offered the best food and service during my stay.

Housekeeping was inconsistent. My minibar was never refilled, and service often consisted of only making the bed and removing towels. The magnifying mirror in my room was falling out of the wall, and I walked past the same dead roach on the stairway for four consecutive days before it was finally removed.
Basic guest conveniences were also lacking. Obtaining small bills to tip staff was surprisingly difficult. At the sports bar, I ordered a gin martini twice and received a vodka martini both times. The walls in the rooms are extremely thin — I could clearly hear everything happening in the adjacent room.

I also visited the spa, which was another disappointment. The reception staff were unfriendly, and while I was required to prepay for my service upfront (which was fine), there was no option to tip the therapist. I booked the 80-minute signature wine massage, which sounded unique and indulgent, but it turned out to be nothing more than a basic Swedish massage. None of the advertised elements were incorporated.

That said, a few employees truly stood out and deserve recognition. Christopher, my concierge, was excellent and the highlight of my stay. Jimbert and Rosanna in the buffet were very warm and personable and consistently went out of their way to make breakfast enjoyable. Luis at the Ginger bar and Jonathan at the pool bar were also fantastic, as was every member of the bell staff I encountered.

Unfortunately, good employees cannot compensate for poor management, inconsistent service, subpar food, and a tired property. I would not return to this resort and would not recommend it to others. For the price and the promises made — particularly around the Reserve upgrade — this property falls well short.

reviews.author: Harriscj9
reviews.title: Not an adults only resort
reviews.text:
This is not an adults only resort. Not at all actually. This resort cuts corners/blends and if you’ve ever been to the one in playa del Carmen Mexico, you will understand what I mean. That’s basically two separate resorts with two totally independent sides. 

This resort has no real distinctions between the adult and family “sides”. The adults only buffet (Malva) is closed during the day for breakfast and lunch so everyone eats at one location, “the lunch box”. Malva restaurant is only open at night and that’s because the resort restaurants are open so they count on most people and families eating at those instead of the buffet which is very limited as a result food wise. There’s also families there (Malva) at that time. So unless you’re in a reserve section, there are no adult only dining options. The restaurants for reservation are family restaurants as well. Adults and kids alike. The pools are also not adults only really. There’s one on one side but it’s so dead with no activities and kinda pointless to be at unless you just want to be in water. No poolside bungalows, in water pool beds or poolside entertainment/activities at that pool. Just a swim up bar and water. The main pool is basically adults and kids with most of the entertainment and activity catering to the kids and parents. 

The heart of the resort (main entry) is the same. This is where all the restaurants line up and where the sports bar (kicks bar) is. Again, another family area so much so that they even have face painting for the kids at night. 

There’s nothing wrong with a family resort but if you identify and select a resort as adults only, that’s what you expect. Not kids running around, screaming, crying and having to listen to their screen entertainment devices playing while you’re eating. But that’s not what you get here by far. 

The staff… there were a few shinning stars but in all, the staff is not very friendly as experienced at other resorts. Not horrible but not as warm and just bubbly and welcoming. 

The resort is also old. At least the side I stayed on was. It def needs revamping and reconfiguration. The main terrace furniture is kinda old and dated. Hard plastic with thin cushions I hate comparing this place to the playa del Carmen location but it’s night and day as far as luxury, accents and even upkeep. 

This is my 3rd time at this resort since 2010 and I definitely remember it differently. 

There’s a lot that can be improved on here. 

I will say that the buffet food is pretty good. 

Overall, I think there are other resorts for a cheaper price for what you get here. But go see for yourself.

reviews.title: DO NOT EVEN THINK ABOUT STAYING HERE – WORST EXPERIENCE EVER
reviews.text:
"DO NOT EVEN THINK ABOUT STAYING HERE – WORST EXPERIENCE EVER!"

This is not a hotel – it’s a backstreet circus! If you value your money, peace of mind, and respect, do not even dare to book here. Staff act as if they’re paying you to stay and treat themselves like kings of the planet. Smiling? Forget it. Courtesy? Non-existent. You pay $500 per night, but what you get is rude, unprofessional behavior and an experience that feels more like a punishment than a vacation. You will feel like you are in prison, you are the prisoner and the staff are the prison guards

The rooms are small, outdated, and not worth the price at all. They assign you a so-called "concierge" who has absolutely no clue about anything. I asked the concierge to book me for the sauna, and he assured me it was done. When I arrived, there was no sauna booking, and no one had a clue about it.

The staff also went so far as to openly discuss my gender, questioning whether I was a man or a woman. This level of disrespect was appalling and incredibly offensive.

If you ever use the in-room phone to call for assistance, be prepared for an absolute nightmare. It takes a minimum of 30 minutes for someone to answer (if they even bother), and when they do, a man named Carlos will interrogate you like you’re a criminal and then hang up on you. Forget about reaching a manager—managers are completely unreachable, and the staff couldn’t care less about solving any issues. If something goes wrong, you’re completely on your own.

The front office and check-in staff stare at you with the most hostile, hateful expressions, like you’re their worst enemy. If you request to speak to a manager, they take you to a random computer room with no explanation. No one understands English, and no one cares to help or even try.

Stay far, far away from the following staff members: Gustavo, Richard Sanchez, Carolina Marchi, and Vicmar Simeoli. These individuals, along with the rest of the team, are the epitome of unprofessionalism and rudeness.

This place is a disgrace to the hospitality industry. I wouldn’t recommend it to my worst enemy. Save yourself the time, money, and frustration, and book anywhere else. This was, without a doubt, the worst hotel experience of my life.

reviews.title: You are excelente, Basillo!  See you again soon!
reviews.text:
12月のはじめに行きました。プンタカーナは大型のオールインルシブ型のリゾートがどんどん建設中で、今後もいろんなところが進出してくると思われますが、そんな中で今回はParadisus Palma Realを選びました。ここはMelia系列のリゾートで、広い敷地に３つのMelia系列のリゾートがあります。空港から車で３０分弱で到着して、距離も近いので便利です。Paradisusはファミリー全般で滞在できるのですが、Reserveという地域は大人専用で、こちらは特に喧騒から離れてゆっくりしたい方にお薦めです。Reserveエリアを予約すると、特別のブレスレットが与えられ、担当のバトラーが付きます。このバトラーのBasilloさんは常に気を遣ってくれて、滞在中も頻繁に連絡をくれ、ニーズにこたえてくれました。レストランの予約もいち早くアドバイスをくれ、人気がある混雑しているレストランを抑えてくれたので、ディナーも大変楽しめました。彼には大変感謝です！
　またReserve Areaですと専用のレストラン、Santeにも入れますので、特に朝食時は混雑を避けられてゆっくりと楽しむことができました。泊まるなら是非、Reserveエリアをお薦めします。また３月に行ってきます！See you all Soon!

I went at the beginning of December. Punta Cana is currently seeing a surge in the construction of large-scale all-inclusive resorts, and it seems that more companies will be entering this space in the future. Among these, I chose Paradisus Palma Real for this trip. This is part of the Melia group of resorts, and there are three Melia-affiliated resorts within the expansive grounds.

It’s conveniently located just under 30 minutes by car from the airport. While Paradisus is suitable for families in general, the Reserve area is adults-only and is particularly recommended for those who want to relax away from the hustle and bustle. When you book in the Reserve area, you receive a special bracelet and are assigned a personal butler.

Our butler, Basillo, was incredibly attentive, staying in frequent contact with us throughout our stay and meeting all of our needs. He gave us great advice on restaurant reservations, securing spots at popular and busy restaurants, so we were able to fully enjoy our dinners. We are very grateful to him!

Additionally, by staying in the Reserve area, we had access to an exclusive restaurant, Sante, which allowed us to enjoy a relaxed and uncrowded breakfast. If you’re planning to stay here, I highly recommend booking the Reserve area.

I’ll be visiting again in March! See you all soon!

reviews.author: AMR
reviews.title: Stay elsewhere.
reviews.text: I chose this hotel as part of The Hotel Collection with AMEX. Upon arrival service was good though a bit on a shaky start since they could not find my reservation and had me waiting out front with the bellhops which was awkward. Front desk was nice but I was put off by the fact that they offered me a paying upgrade, but when I pointed to the fact that the Program offered said upgrade in a complementary fashion... mysteriously the upgrade then offered was suddenly "not available". Fine. Hotel grounds are beautiful and well kept. Servers are attentive and cheery. Sadly, my stay began to fall short as my dinner reservation at Mina was a disaster. I arrived 10 minutes before as suggested, but ended up gettin to my table about half an hour after scheduled. My dinner took 52 minutes to get to my table: burnt steak and cold potatoes. My guess is they were otherwise engaged with the 10-guy table next to me. Somehow they were timely served. Anyways, thanks to Stephanie who seemed to be the only manager who cared. She was attentive and caring. Dinner at Blue Agave was wonderful, best experience there. Also, I was madre to wait about 35 minutes at Yhi Spa because they were doubtful of recognizing the resort credit that comes with the AMEX program. They finally did and my service was great. Honestly AMEX should revise how hotels are trained about the program because its very annoying to have to be explaining this to them, and they get annoyed if you wish to use your benefits which I find ridiculous. If not for the AMEX program I would have probably not stayed there in the first place. Trip was ended on a bad note as I found a roach, yes a roach in my room (see picture). I discretely expressed my concern to the night manager and he was extremely dismissive, as if nothing happened. He even made jokes as to how big the roach was, since I took a picture with my phone to show him. In sum, for a hotel this pricey I expected a better stay. Will not return. If you want a short answer: stay elsewhere.

reviews.text:
I’ve stayed at other Melia hotels before so Paradisus was next on the list. It’s another  quite a big hotel so the check in / lobby was large but not much of a queue luckily. A few hiccups along the way of my stay, hence 4 stars.

 The room I had was in building 20 and was a basic garden view. I was pleasantly surprised, it was certainly spacious enough and near the many pools and beach, big bonus for me. The slight disappointment was you could hear the neighbours talking next door as it was an adjoining room (door separating). I also had two cockroaches visiting in the evening of my first night but housekeeping came with spray and sorted it out. No site of the roaches since, thankfully. My bracelet key card didn’t work either when I first arrived so I had to return to the lobby but as it was 2 mins walk it wasn’t a big deal. It’s a stunning looking property and you can take some amazing pictures around the grounds. No one really explained how the beach towels worked etc so other than the ones in the room it took me a while to figure out that staff place some out on chairs but I’m still not sure where to ask for them! The map provided of the hotel grounds has super small text so not easy to read so I took a picture of it to be able to make things bigger and I don’t even have bad eyesight! 

I’ve seen a lot of complaints about the food from others. The only absolutely horrific food I had was at the Mediterranean a la carte. It looked like prison food, uncleaned prawns and rice with no seasoning. I actually left to go to the buffet. Buffet is hit and miss as they undercook the potatoes so they were hard to get time I tried and the bacon in the morning wasn’t crispy cooked on all occasions. Other than that, I always found something to eat and I liked the teppanyaki and Mexican.  Sometimes the hardworking waiting staff struggle for keep up on cleaning tables at busy lunch hour and evening hour at the buffet but there’s a lot of people here! Quite a few areas to sit around and have a drink, nice rocking chairs, sports bar, wine shop, upstairs by the lobby, main courtyard area etc. Didn’t catch much of the entertainment or activities as I did my own thing off the resort a few nights and day trips. 

There’s always free beach and pool loungers and it doesn’t fill up with towels laid out by 7.30am as at other hotels I’ve been (at least when I stayed). The pools are plentiful and both adult only or kids / families so if your avoiding kids then choose wisely. I also went to the spa - super stunning with little huts and obligatory Buddhas placed around. Massage was amazing (thank you Yeimi). A tad bit pricy compared to London where I’m from, but DR is not cheap for anything, really. Worth it though! I also went to the gym several times and it has some decent machines and free weights (I’m not a cardio bunny!). It was always quite hot so the aircon could be turned up in my view. Not busy around 6.30-8am when I went, mostly the same 3-4 faces. 

The final niggle was that I extended my room check out time, of course the key card bracelet didn’t work to get in to the room when I tried. I had to queue up at reception with 20 mins to spare of my extended time. Again, not a biggie to deal with but not 5 star. 

I would come back here again, i enjoyed my experience. As a European with a healthy dose of realistic expectations of service (we are way behind Americans in that space) it was pretty fabulous all things considered. Maybe I will go for a room with pool next time though!

reviews.author: jcolestoapple
reviews.title: A wonderful resort to escape to!
reviews.text:
I had a very enjoyable stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. My stay was in early March and I opted in for the Reserve, Adults Only package. The biggest perk of this package was staying in a building/room much closer to the beach. 

Overall, the grounds are spacious and extremely well-maintained. This includes the beachfront which arguably has the cleanest/best patch of beach to any of the neighboring resorts. This is due in part to the incredible staff who are as professional as they are attentive. A big shoutout to my concierge, Osvaldo. He made my stay the best it could be, and elevated the experience through his responsiveness and help with whatever question I had! 

The drinks were great, and the bar staff in the Reserve areas were friendly and attentive all day long. The restaurant selections are plentiful, and are enjoyable but not otherworldly. The spaciousness of the common areas are inviting to a lot of patrons, but never did it feel overwhelming busy.

Overall it was a satisfying stay and enjoyable experience.

reviews.title: Wonderful time

Jesus was delivering us drinks while we were hanging by the pool and on the beach and he was so great always checking if we needed something. The ginger bar is such a cool hangout spot. Lots of good entertainment! Kelvin at the steak restaurant was a wonderful waiter and was so quick to getting us anything we needed! The Italian restaurant was my favorite, the shrimp basil pasta was incredible! The buffets for breakfast and lunch did have tons of options, but the food was cold a lot of the time and quality not the greatest. The beach was not crowded at all and the ocean water felt wonderful! The gentlemen that were working in the towel area by the pool we so fun and spunky. They were always having a great time with the guests! The pool was a bit chilly, but after jumping in it didn’t take long to get used to. It was a nice, relaxing trip! Cant wait to return!!

reviews.author: Chelsea P
reviews.title: It just depends on what type of traveler you are
reviews.text:
Overall: 3.75 Stars. Best suited for age 55+ and desire peace & quiet over fun. I’ve stayed at many resorts in the Caribbean and this was the most beautiful. You’ll feel like a Kardashian as soon as you enter. However, the low quality, limited variety, and poor taste of food will probably keep me from returning. If the food was good, this would truly be a [third- world country standards] five star resort, in my opinion. 

In Depth Review: I’m a 47 year old black American female traveling solo for 5 nights without hubby. I’ve traveled the world on a shoestring budget, lived in South America for 7 years,  and currently live in a major metropolitan city on the east coast. I’ve stayed in huts in the jungle with flying bats and roaches and I’ve stayed in some pretty swanky joints. So I’d like to say my review is pretty trustworthy. However, reviews must be taken with a grain of salt because they are simply opinions. You’ll have to form your own, but below was my experience. TIP: Spanish speakers, like myself, will have a better experience due to the language barrier.

Arrival: 2 Stars. Resort is a quick 20 minutes or so from PUJ. Nobody helped me unload or carry bags to front desk and acted like it was a chore to walk me to the check-in desk. No welcome drink or extra fanfare but at least I had no wait and the whole process took about 10 minutes. The desk girl was nice and even upgraded my room. I was given a bracelet but it wasn’t explained that it doubled as an electronic room key. I was given a map of the property and basically a “good luck finding your room and everything on your own” since nobody offered to help me any further. I had to ask directions from another worker. He pointed, but didn’t offer any other help. I was starving from a long day of travel but nobody told me where I could eat. I wandered around tired, hungry, and feeling unwelcome. TIP: Request to be personally taken to your room. Anything else is unacceptable.

Room: 5 stars. I will be upfront and say I did need to open windows and air out the harsh bleach and cleaning chemicals. But the room was spotless, spacious, and posh. I even had a private patio with my own Bali bed. I  was truly impressed with all the little details that make this a fancy place. No need to call the front desk if you forget your toothbrush. All toiletries are included, even toothpaste. TIP: Leaving sliding door open turns off your AC and lets in mosquitos! Also there is a red or green button by your door to push if you desire privacy or cleaning. 

Food: 1 star. Due to low capacity, the main dinner buffet was closed and we were forced to either have a restaurant reservation (also not explained to me and not all were open) or dine in a tiny makeshift buffet area called Malva. Hot foods were lukewarm (I never saw heat lamps) and cold items were not kept on ice at all. Breakfast and lunch were just as gross. I’m talking gray asparagus, chicken put in a blender and called “shredded”, and an Inedible omelette that tasted like Fabuloso. It left my tongue slimy and I got an instant headache, which leads me to believe they are washing their pots and pans in non food-safe chemicals. The restaurants I tried were just as terrible, but friendly service. TIP: If you ask for a paper plate from the hostess you can take your buffet items to the beach/pool. Otherwise, no food is served on the beach or poolside, which was sad. 

Drinks: 4 stars. At one beach bar I was told that technically they weren’t supposed to serve me because I had a green bracelet. Another thing not explained to me. But they were nice and served me a piña colada anyway. It was poured from a bottle mix and I ended up throwing it away. Hands down the best bar is Ginger Bar in the lobby. That’s where all the cool kids hang out and the drinks were strongest. TIP: Mixed drinks will give your tummy syrup rot but stronger cocktails or simple drinks are amazing. Try a refreshing Basil Smash!

Entertainment: 5 stars if you’re part of the older crowd and like to be in bed by 10pm. Amazing singers/musical performances, but not much else. I absolutely loved it and enjoyed getting a quiet restful sleep since the shows end early. TIP: Get your seat for the show early as they fill quickly. 

Beach: 5 stars. I was there in early February, so there was no seaweed to muck through. Clear waters with small waves and miles of beach to walk. Weather was perfect! Drink service was far and few between but Vanessa was a sweetheart. TIP: Bring your good attitude and realize you will be asked to buy something from hawkers frequently. But remember they make like $5 a day and you’re staying in a 5 star resort. Don’t be a jerk, Karen. 

Pools: 5 stars. Sparkling, clean, and not overpowering with bleach odor. However, the color of your bracelet will determine which pools you can swim in. I never had an issue getting a chair; no need to wake up early and reserve it. TIP: You can purchase towel clips at the gift shop to prevent your towel from blowing off your chair into Neverland.  

Staff: Extremely hard working. Yes, they are hoping for a tip, but don’t act like it’s required. TIP: Remember, you’re visiting a different culture. What might seem rude or apathetic to you is really just their shy and quiet nature to some extent. Dominicans don’t try to be best friends with strangers like Americans sometimes do. You have to earn their trust and respect their country first and foremost. Speaking Spanish will get you preferential treatment, but that’s at any resort in DR. 

THE GOOD: Pure relaxation and great sleep!

THE BAD: The food is disgusting!

THE UGLY: If your skin is darker than a paper bag be prepared for horrific racism. I had to discuss this with management when a security guard tried to get me thrown out. Vicmar truly seem to care and said he would launch an “investigation”, but nothing was ever done, and I wasn’t notified of the outcome nor offered even a free massage to compensate for my humiliation.

reviews.author: Niall M
reviews.title: The worst service followed up by a gag clause!
reviews.text:
This hotel uses non disparagement / gag clauses to suppress honest reviews (pictured). 

To be able to write this review, it cost me MeliaRewards points worth 500EUR. The service at this hotel is truly the worst and most incompetent I have experienced at any price range. This was despite having Melia top tier status + staying in their most expensive suite. 

After an awful stay with numerous issues, almost 2 months to get any explanation for any of my experience, and despite a written promise of points from staff - I was offered 100000 points ONLY IF I would sign a release forbidding me from writing about my stay (I declined and lost the points). How can we trust the ratings from this hotel when they not just discourage honest feedback, but put in place legal methods that grant them the ability to suppress it?

Melia more centrally appear to have no escalation process for handling disagreements with their hotels. And so despite years as a Melia Rewards Platinum member, this is the end of my spending with Melia hotels.

I would ask that the hotel do not provide a copy/paste response to my review as they were notified of issues (+ follow up) while I was there to ensure they had every opportunity to respond, but they chose not to. I believe their responses of 'we wish we would have known so we could make it right' to other reviews are completely disingenuous. 

I will just refer to a few of the issues related to this stay:
- Despite having confirmation, booking with Melia and noticing myself the room disappearing from sale shortly after booking, my stay does not appear to have been processed properly prior to my arrival. Something went wrong and the room appeared for sale before I checked in, I was sent to the wrong check-in area and told I would have the wrong type of room. After being quizzed about my booking and providing all documentation I was kept waiting in reception for around an hour for them to get ready the suite which they obviously didn't expect me in and I was lucky wasn't resold! 
- When asked, they provided no explanation while I was there and were unavailable to comment. Subsequently a call with the 'Insight' team acknowledged that they'd confirmed my wait but bizarrely denied the issue, saying they had expected me to be in the right room (no explanation given for why I was being given the wrong room initially or why I was directed to the wrong check-in area). Furthermore I was told guests can expect to wait "an hour or even more" for their rooms even when arriving at 7pm.
- The personal concierge / butler service has been downgraded such that they really only book your meals and send you activities. Other hotels utilise good apps. My concierge didn't contact me until almost 24 hours after arrival and I had no dinner. When the concierge was in contact, he would send activities in the morning after they had begun (once 2 out of 3 activities had started/finished before I got them). This repeated despite me telling the concierge and continued with the next concierge (despite reassurances it wouldn't).
- As well as no concierge for my first day, the person who was assigned went on leave 3 days later and the replacement concierge again waited almost 24 hours to contact me. 
- There is no beach waiter service despite what's advertised. Because of multiple bookings at once, I have unfortunately stayed at this hotel for 4 weeks before + 1 week recently. The waiters choose not to walk the beach. 
- Despite waiting a long time for the room, it was not checked. Cleanliness issues, missing items (e.g. a bottle opener for wine or beer from the minibar), a mostly empty minibar with a half empty bottle of coke. 
- Requesting a bottle opener at least 6 times gave no result. The follow up call suggested bottle openers are not provided in rooms for the beer and wine. 
- On my 4 week stay after they never had in stock the fillet steak (from day 1) I was told they'd just run out. 
- Food & drink choice and quality are very poor.
- They had no change for tips for 5 days! Furthermore they can never advise when change will come, and so 10 walks to reception checking gave no results. 
- I could go on listing issues but it is essentially missing any aspects of good or even competent service. Lovely setting, but I think it would be crazy to spend the prices charged for this hotel when there are better more honest options. Melia should reconsider how they position the Paradisus brand, as they are so far from luxury all inclusive. Do not expect Ikos, Domes, Excellence hotels levels of service. 

In summary, don't do it!

reviews.author: LawtToronto
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Worst Service and Food
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort but very poor service, booked for 9 day stay.
Beautiful beach, comfortable loungers and palapas.
Resort food was the worst I have ever experienced at a 5 star resort, very poor quality,  by  day six  I was having problems from the food.
 Stayed at the Reserve adults only swim-out room with luxury concierge  service, I spoke with the concierge person once when I arrived only to never hear or see him again, don't waste your money for that service.
 Went to the reserve service room for information only to be sent somewhere else, what a joke.
The resort caters to business  Conventions which is not a problem other than it made it harder to get seating at restaurants.
Tables in the buffet restaurant   sticky dirty.
I arrived on a Friday and was told the information  session  was on Monday, couldn't find the tour guy, was sent to the other resort no guy there, I gave up wasting my time.
The room was very nice, but spotty cleaning service, had to switch out the pillows due to moldy smell. No turn down service which was offered in package I purchased.

The room is not sound proof, every night I could hear snoring, the TV, people talking from the room next to me, and these people were not loud party people.
It got to the point where I couldn't take another day at this place, booked a flight home the next day at extra cost for flight and airport service.

Resort made me sign a disclaimer, saying there would be no refund for not staying to the end of my reservation, no problem signed and done.
I will never return this place, not worth the money and not  5 star service.

reviews.author: Denise
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Beach lover
reviews.text:
This was my first time at Paradisus Palma Real since Jan 2020 and since they have remodel the Royal Service (Now called The Reserve) section and it is beautiful.  The enlarges the adult only pool and added a second pool with room on the first floor that have walkouts to the pool.  It is very nice.
The restaurants were all wonderful and there is now an adult only buffet as well.  This resort is on the best beach - so if love the beach as I do and love to walk the beach, this is the place for you!

But what made my stay perfect, or I should say who made my stay perfect, was my concierge Kelvin Fernandez.  He was so kind, polite and very professional.  He checked in every morning so see how my days was going, if there was anything he could assist with and to make sure I received the list of daily activities.  He also checked in during the day, again asking if there was anything I needed and to make my dinner reservation.  He was very patient when I wasn't sure where I wanted to eat and made wonderful suggestions.  
I happen to mention that I needed coffee one morning and he took the time to show me they best coffee spot in the resort (The Ginger Bar).  He was right!

I would love to return to Paradisus Palma Real again and when I do I will most definitely be requesting Kelvin Fernandez as my concierge.  I don't think anyone could top his service!

I also have to give a shout out to Wanda the bartender at the Adult only pool area! She is friendly, fun and makes the best drinks! 

I can't wait to stay there again!

reviews.title: Paradise in the Caribbean
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real is a wonderful property. Incredible service, great pools, beach, and activities. The room was exceptional and very clean. The beach lounge area was very good in spite of  the seaweed-lots of seaweed- not good for swimming.

reviews.author: Demetria T
reviews.title: Spectacular Service
reviews.text:
Great Hotel!

I stayed in the Nikita suite at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf Resort and Spa. I had an amazing time! The hotel is right on the water, and the ocean was a perfect turquoise blue! There is some seaweed and the hotel does a good job of trying to keep the beach well maintained. Did I mention the beachside service - a waiter carrying your favorite drink was always available! Drinks can be as strong or as light as you prefer (ask for a Dominican Sangria and try the mamajuana). My concierge (Felix) did an amazing job and was very attentive, welcoming, and thoughtful. He decorated my room for my birthday and helped make arrangements for anything I needed.  The suite was huge and ocean front - waking up to that spectacular view everyday was definitely a highlight. I can’t say enough about the service, everyone was nice and extremely helpful (house keeping, wait staff, lobbyist, etc). The spa is a unique outdoor spa - Dorka did my massage, and was very thorough. Gladys gave me a beachside shoulder massage and was amazing.  This hotel is not the party hotel, it’s much more designed for relaxation and families. There was some entertainment at night (live band, violinist, acrobats, dancers) but mostly this is a chill environment.

Cons - Food - I struggled to find good food. Breakfast, I ordered room service (which was fine). Buffet was bad (skip it and order off menu - shrimp tacos). The small bites at the bars are your best bet for lunch. Dinner - by far the best restaurant was the Blue Agave (Mexican), the food was spicy and flavorful.  The steak
Restaurant was meh, not a fan of how the beef tastes. The Hibachi restaurant was ok (mostly because of service - I never saw an empty glass the whole night).

Cons - beach vendors are extremely aggressive, especially if your a woman (they aren’t just selling souvenirs).. after day3 of 6, I wanted to avoid the beach all together.. which was unfortunate because that’s what I came for..

Overall - I had a great time and would go back for sure!

reviews.author: Carolina G
reviews.title: Me llevo los mejores recuerdos de este viaje!
reviews.text: Maravilloso sitio y realmente está lleno de palmeras ( valoro que no las tumbaran como en otros resorts), te hacen sentir como en casa desde que llegas. Restaurantes excelentes, gracias Santo!, eres una gran persona. Habitación increíble, amplia y cómoda, a pocos pasos de la playa en la zona adults only. Lo mejor: mi concierge Ariel Benzo, profesional, respetuoso y siempre pendiente del detalle.

reviews.author: GabA656LT
reviews.title: Buena estadía.
reviews.text: Los aspectos a mejorar es las actividades: clase de bachata, talleres de sombrero, talleres de cigarros por ejemplo. Deben asignar la gerencia de estas tareas a alguien especializado y que levante esta situación. A la noche nos miramos la cara porque han desaparecido los bailes y las actividades nocturnas   De todas maneras quiero agradecer por el personal de maleteros excelente el personal de los bares de la playa excelente el bufet excelente mi mayordomo Luis excelente la gente que trabaja aquí es espectacular. Muy buena predisposición. Les insisto con el área de actividades y nocturnas porque es una picardía que estoy pasando esto

reviews.author: James M
reviews.title: A1 service
reviews.text: Wendy Antonia was great with my order and made sure that we got everything we needed. He delivered excellent service. A1 service. I would recommend the resort to anyone they are great with all of the services.

reviews.author: Alexis M
reviews.title: Worst experience ever at Melia….!!!!
reviews.text: The worst experience ever had to wait in the lobby for my room for four hours then apparently the room that they gave me was the wrong room. They gave me a master room and I paid for a swim up master room. Also, the service was terrible I had to wait for towels every day till like 3 o’clock in the afternoon People in the front lobby where the worst people ever ever a counter with the very disrespectful. Do you not have no compassion for a person like me coming all the way from Connecticut to punta cana for the first time and had to wait four hours for our first room then the next day we had to move to our original room  Whole Lotta inconvenience in this experience. We also paid for an experience at the Paradis’s Palma riyal resort spa and they ended up putting us in the Palmer reserve because the Palmer riyal was not done till December 15, 2022. So again they put us in a wrong hotel  Experience that I seen on the Internet was a totally different experience that was in real person real time. Please whoever is experience this with Melia please make sure you check your flights in your destinations because it seems like whatever destinations you put, they put you in a different hotel, or a brother hotel . I did not pay for to experience in the reserves hi paid for the experience at the Palmer riyal. Very disappointing with this issue. Try to make the best out of it but didn’t have a good time wasted a whole Lotta money and a whole lot of my time and I also wasted my time for vacation with my wife. Please be careful with ordering or making plans with Melia the hotel.

reviews.author: Theo W
reviews.title: Best vacation
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Christopher S
reviews.title: Chef Wilkin is amazing
reviews.text:
The chef at the restaurant (Wilkin Tapia) made our trip very special by cooking food for my family that we had requested even though it wasn’t on the menu.  The food was amazing 5/5! The food was amazing and tasted great. This was one of the highlights of our trip

Gracias Wilkin

reviews.author: Melissa G
reviews.title: Punta Cana dinner
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my dinner. I came to the restaurant with a group of nine other people. I had the vegetarian toast, the vegetable stew and the vegetarian meatballs. We had prompt and friendly service with Lissette Montilla. The manager Jose Batista checked on us frequently to make sure everything was to our liking. The chef was Francis Javier and another server that helped us was Adriel Perez. They all did a great job! I highly recommend this restaurant.

reviews.author: Jessica E
reviews.title: Beautiful but SO loud at night
reviews.text: Overall the resort is nice and the service is very good. I am giving 2 stars because it is incredibly noisy at night. I have switched rooms once already and every night there is very loud music with bass that is directly outside my windows. This may not be an issue further from the ocean but it’s worth noting that the ocean view and ocean front rooms are not for anyone who wants to sleep before 11pm. I find it unacceptable that I was transferred from one room to an even louder room. I would gladly be farther from the ocean to get a good nights sleep. They should be more understanding to guests sleep preferences and understand that guests are coming from different time zones.

reviews.author: Seaside335105
reviews.title: The place is beautiful  and  peaceful. Food was delicious  and my room was unbelievable.
reviews.text: Amazing place to spend your vacation, looking forward to go back as soon as possible. Staff was pretty amazing. I had an assistant that was out this world unbelievable I have nothing to worry, Edgar Rodriguez made my stay there an unbelievable weekend. I totally love the place and would go back.

reviews.author: mandita55
reviews.title: Espectacular!
reviews.text: Muy buena la experiencia en el hotel. Todo muy bien preparado para pasar unas vacaciones sin preocupaciones y relajado! Las playas son espectaculares y las noches muy divertidas. Los tragos del bar avenue son geniales! Gracias Doris, Luis Rosario, Víctor, Alta  Gracia y Manuela

reviews.author: Colleen K
reviews.title: Beautiful, amazing and memorable
reviews.text:
Beautiful and memorable.  With covid precautions in place it was obvious things were not what they were pre covid.  But I felt safe and ensured of cleanliness with the current pandemic.  All the staff wore masks at all times and going into the buffet, you were given a mask and gloves. They asked if you had any allergies your room number and how many person in your party. 
I also very much enjoyed having a bracelet instead of a card for our room to get in. It is very convenient.

We had a concierge, which I must say I’ve never had. His name was Sandy Gil. And this man made a most amazing trip for my husband and I. It was our 20th wedding anniversary and he decorated our sweet tub outside with rose petals and a bubble bath and a bottle of champagne. Even on his day off he had checked on us and made reservations for our dinner. I have been in this service/hospitality industry for over 20 years and I have to say he is amazing at his job and definitely needs to be recognized for that. He has crafted his skill and I was honored to be one of his clients. Anything we asked for he came through each and every time. He went above and beyond his job to ensure our happiness.

The staff is extremely nice and polite. Every morning they would greet us with a “hola familia”. And I must say they truly did make us feel like family. Wanda at the sunset bar was amazing. She remembered our drinks and always had a smile for us and out of the millions upon thousands she’s probably seen to have someone remember that means the world.

reviews.author: psykep
reviews.title: Excepcional
reviews.text:
Simplemente excepcional , tanto el trato como el servicio.  Las instalaciones son maravillosas, todo súper bien mantenido y cuidado, el trato excelente. El complejo es una pasada, las piscinas, los jardines…. todo es una maravilla y todo cuidado  hasta el último detalle.  
Viajábamos con un bebé y siempre tenían palabras amables para ella, nos buscaban siempre una trona, y nos preparaban comida adaptada para ella. Hicimos una reunión con el chef y Mayte (experience manager) para comentar el tema de sus comidas, y nos lo pusieron todo súper fácil, ya que era un tema que nos preocupaba. En la habitación, nos pusieron una cuna y un lote de set de baño para ella.  
Los restaurantes son geniales, hay mucha diversidad de opciones y en todos te tratan genial, y un detalle que nos gustó mucho es que siempre preguntaban tema de alergias alimentarias. El buffet también es una maravilla, con un montón de opciones y todo con las medidas anti COVID.  Tienen un servicio de pruebas COVID y al irnos nos hicieron un test de antígenos gratis y a las pocas horas ya teníamos el certificado en el email. 
Teníamos un servicio de mayordomo incluido y fue increíble tener siempre una persona dispuesta a ayudar y a facilitarnos todas las gestiones. Atendía todas nuestras peticiones, nos reservaba la mesa para los restaurantes, nos gestionaba el tema de las papillas y hizo que nos sintiéramos súper arropados y acompañados.  
Solo tengo palabras bonitas para el Palma Real, gracias al chef, Mayte, Zenovia y Adriane por crearnos recuerdos tan bonitos y por hacernos sentir como en casa al otro lado del Atlántico. Y en especial, felicitaciones a Adriane por gestionar un hotel de manera tan maravillosa, y gracias por los mil detalles, por la ayuda y por la atención. Está claro, que las personas son las que marcan la diferencia. 
Por desgracia, nuestro vuelo de vuelta fue cancelado y la compañía nos reubicó en un hotel de 4*, que nada tenía que ver con el Palma Real, ni en el servicio, ni instalaciones, ni limpieza… no le llegaba a la suela de los zapatos. Tras esa experiencia, pudimos reafirmar nuestra buena elección con el Palma Real. 
Enhorabuena por vuestro trabajo tan bien hecho!

l chef, Mayte, Zenovia y Adriane. Mil felicitaciones por la faena tan bien hecha, por crear un hogar al otro lado del atlantico.

reviews.author: Samantha W
reviews.title: Perfect visit
reviews.text: The most relaxing five days I’ve had in years. The Reserve package is absolutely worth it. All my needs were met from the moment I arrived. The dedicated, adult-only pool and restaurant were some of my favorite parts of my stay. My concierge, Franklin Truque, made my visit seamless. He took care of my dinner reservations, made suggestions about excursions, sent me daily activity options, really, anything you can imagine. I had a massage and a facial at the YHI spa—both of which were some of the best I’ve ever had. If you go, ask for Ruth. I also took part in a healing mud workshop offered at the spa. Sal and Palazzo were my favorite dining options. I chose a junior suite and my room was beautiful and immaculate. The jacuzzi tub was definitely a highlight. The only less than stellar part of the trip is the Meliá app. It needs a lot of work. Luckily, I had Franklin so it wasn’t a problem. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Bill D
reviews.title: William Dean
reviews.text: My experience at the Punta Cana what is exceptional.  Juan Castillo what is the best host It was my personal concierge. He made my reservations for the restaurants where I enjoyed every meal. He also helped my massage with Brenda who was a terrific masseuse.

reviews.author: Bernadette
reviews.title: Excellent séjour
reviews.text:
Mon séjour au Paradisus Palma Réal était parfait pour une semaine de repos et de farniente.
L’hôtel est magnifique et le personnel était charmant, toujours prêt à m’aider en cas de besoin

Yesica, la concierge qui veillait sur moi était aux petits soins et cherchait tous les moyens à sa disposition pour agrémenter mon séjour.
Maria, la femme de ménage qui s’occupait de ma suite était très discrète : il m’a même été possible de choisir l’heure du ménage ! 
Grâce à Jonathan, mon mini bar était toujours garni.
Ma suite était proche de la plage et de la piscine : j’étais au large (49 mètres carrés !) et j’ai particulièrement apprécié le nespresso avec capsules à volonté dans ma chambre.

Tout le personnel de l’hôtel garde le masque en permanence à l’extérieur comme à l’intérieur, et l’hôtel se charge de faire un test Covid si on le souhaite .
Le site est splendide et la piscine immense et très propre; un coin de la grande piscine est réservé aux adultes et une piscine plus petite aussi.
Les repas délicieux et variés et pour tous les goûts. Je n’ai jamais vu un buffet de petit déjeuner aussi copieux !!
Il est aussi possible d’avoir un repas plus raffiné au Restaurant Palazzio
Mention spéciale pour le Barman de la piscine : ses pinas colada (avec ou sans alcool) sont à tomber par terre.

Un tout petit bémol indépendant de la volonté de l’hôtel : l’hôtel enlève tous les jours les algues qui s’échouent sur le sable, mais il restait quand même quelques algues dans l’eau; cela ne m’a pas empêché de le baigner heureusement.

Je comprends pourquoi cet hôtel est dans le top 10 des hôtels de Puntacana 
J’y retournerai l’année prochaine c’est sûr !!

reviews.text: Sal is the speciality steakhouse at Paradisus. Leonardo and Larry were our waiters.  Excellent service.  I had the ribeye (entrecôte on the menu).  My wife had the grilled grouper. reviews.title: Mi primera vez en Punta Cana
reviews.text: The food was great, service superb(very attentive), and the views and ambience were spectacular. Alejandro (Happy Boy) is an outstanding entertainer, funny and very personable. Jairo is a great concierge and Yoiner is quite an outstanding gentleman and concierge All of the rest of the staff were outstanding and would without reservation recommend this resort to anyone looking for a Caribbean getaway.

reviews.author: Karim
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text:
J'ai séjourné deux semaines dans cet hôtel. Le cadre est splendide, la décoration de l'hôtel correspondait à mes attentes, la plage est très grande et bien entretenue, je suis venu en basse saison donc c'était vraiment calme, ce que je préfère. La nourriture était bonne mais selon mes goûts, pas exceptionnelle. Ma chambre était très spacieuse la literie confortable. 
La grande piscine très agréable. Les jardins magnifiques et l'hôtel très propre et luxueux. 
J'ai particulièrement apprécié le travail de mon majordome Felix, toujours très attentif et disponible toujours souriant et très efficace, il pensait toujours à faire quelque chose qui me ferait plaisir, ainsi qu'Omar à la plage très disponible et vraiment sympatique qui prend le temps avec chaque client. Merci encore à eux mille fois car ils ont fait de mes vacances un souvenir très agréable et spécial.
 
Concernant le personnel de l'hôtel j'ai trouvé très aléatoire certains sont vraiment sympa et toujours souriant et d'autres ne vous calculent pas et ne vous répondent même pas lorsque vous dites bonjour, ou quand vous demandez un renseignement. Certaines femmes de chambre sont vraiment désagréable et parfois impolie.
Lors du service à table certains sont vraiment peu sympatique et ne prêtent absolument pas attention à vous, notamment au restaurant Palazzo du Royal Service.
Je suis déçu pour ce point pour un 5* je m'attendais à mieux.

reviews.author: Denise_I
reviews.title: A little piece of heaven!
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at the Paradisus Palms Real resort in Punta Cana.  The resort was absolutely beautiful, the service was fabulous, every restaurant was wonderful and the people were friendly and polite.  I stayed in the royal service - adult only part of the resort and the service was fantastic!.  My butler Kelvin Fernandez was amazing!  He was kind, courteous and attentive.  Everyday he checked in asking if I needed anything, to see how my day was going, making sure i had the dinner reservation of my choice and the list of activities for the day.  He spoke with the staff at the royal service pool/beach to ensure they reserved me a cabana everyday of my stay.  If I was walking around the resort and Kelvin saw me he always made a point to stop and talk and ask how my day was and see if there was anything i needed.  I was also able to text him at anytime if I had a question or needed something. He was just very kind and personable and helped make my vacation relaxing and extra special.  If I ever travel back to Paradisus Palma Real (and I hope I do someday),  I will be again stay in royal service and will be requesting Kelvin Fernandez as my butler.  
And a shout out to Omar, who set up my beach spot everyday and Wanda, the best bartender ever!   
I feel like I made 3 new friends! Best Vacation ever!

reviews.text: Hotel magnífico , são 3 hotéis da rede melia , melia residence , palma paradisus, e um recente hotel melia  circle... todos dentro de um complexo . reviews.author: Heather R
reviews.title: Great Holiday
reviews.text:
This was my 3rd or 4th time to Paradisus Palma Real and it was great. I was able to relax and spend time soaking in the sun and enjoying the amenities of the resort. 

My butler was Ariel Benzo and he was great! Ariel always took care of my reservations, helped me with my bath time and spoiled me with chocolates and bubbles with the hot tub! ❤️❤️

The restaurants had changed since my last trip. Honestly, Palazzo was still one of the best, I went there for breakfast and dinner 2X, I loved The Winery, but didn’t have another person to do the wine tasting for 2. So, instead I opted for dinner and a bottle of wine. They have a great selection with so many to choose. I went for an amazing Malbec that was fabulous and opted for the steak from Rare, The steakhouse next door. 

I also ate at Bento, but felt the food at Palazzo was better. 

I went as part of my recovery from spine surgery, so I didn’t try any excursions, but several told me about theirs. 

It was a great time. I’ll definitely return. I hope to have Ariel as my butler, as he was great!!

reviews.author: pepperminty00
reviews.title: Full Details of our stay
reviews.text:
So this was our 3rd trip to DR and 2nd with a Paradisus brand, the first being in Playa del Carmen Mexico. We chose the Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana because our experience in Mexico was amazing. We are a couple in our late 30’s who chose a last minute 4 night getaway without the kids. So we were also scoping this out as a place for the next time we come with kids. 
Upon check in- this was a pleasant process. Room was ready. We had requested a king bed and walked into a room with double beds. We actually were fine with our own beds…(married 15 years- I like my own blanket). Next morning they pushed the beds together and I asked them to return it and they laughed at my reason why haha. 
First night we ate at the buffet. Reservations for the restaurants can only be made at the desk from 9-4pm. Buffet was typical…variety of different foods. We were hungry and tired so it didn’t matter. 
Next day we made reservations for Rare (steakhouse), Vento and Aqua (at reserve). Our favorite was Rare. Vento had a pasta dish with mushrooms which sounded delicious on the menu but it was a bowl of pasta with finely chopped mushrooms and a ladle of butter….JUST BUTTER. 
Each morning and lunch we only ate at the buffet because that is the only option. Though we didn’t have the kids with us, I always kept an eye on things like what would they eat? There was fresh grilled steaks and chicken as well as kid friendlier items such as pizza, pasta and fries. BUT- they never had plain pizza? Not sure how many American children will eat pizza with corn or green olives. (But I loved the green olive). There wasn’t a grill section near pool like Mexico where you can grab a burger. Just buffet. Also Mexico changed it up with themed food too. 

This resort was great because the pool overlooked the ocean. The Paradisus in Mexico was secluded from beach due to the mangroves and we didn’t get to enjoy that as much. There is a more family oriented section on the reserve but I would find it annoying to go back and forth. 

Entertainment- wow did this resort lack on all aspects. For Pool- every once in a while they did aerobics or yoga. Pool didn’t have music and guests had their own portable speakers both around pool and beach which didn’t give it a resort vibe. Felt like I was on a public beach. No inflatable pool slides or obstacle courses in water for kids. (Mexico had this). For night- amphitheater was empty most nights. One night there was a woman dressed up on what seemed like 15 ft stilts with creepy music. So thinking if we had kids, after dinner there wasn’t anything to do with them. 

Rooms- were clean. Toilet and shower area were a little tight. but overall the room was great. Cleaning service came 2x once for cleaning in am and turn down in pm. 

I would expect that as a brand- some things would remain consistent. I would probably come back but on the fence.

reviews.author: Jimmy L
reviews.title: An Experience Just This Side of Heaven!
reviews.text:
If the path to heaven were by train, the Paradisus Punta Cana Resort would be its next to the last stop! Because I lacked for nothing & had no need to leave the resort, I could describe the Paradisus as a city unto its own; however, labeling it just a city would be an injustice. While it's fully equipped as a city, the size is very approachable and made to feel even more accessible by the extremely friendly & accommodating staff. I never once had a need that the Paradisus staff couldn't fulfill.
 Personally, I think the Paradisus should be renamed. I would rename it: The Paradisus by Jeuri, Punta Cana Dominican Republic. Jeuri (pronounced Jerry) was assigned as my personal "Butler". As a guest staying in the Royal Service portion of the resort, each room is assigned a butler. My room was assigned the most attentive, proactive, responsive, kind, calm and reassuring person that I met in the Dominican Republic. Jeuri was so observant. At times, when he noticed that I was stressed, he would say “You're on Vacation – no worries". It worked. I would immediately relax. 
In summary , I highly recommend the Paradisus and strongly recommend making your reservation for a room in the Royal Service section. Who knows, maybe you'll be lucky and Jeuri will be assigned as your Butler!

reviews.author: neila leal
reviews.title: Praia de Bávaro - Muito Sargaço
reviews.text:
A praia é cheia de sargaço. Não acredito que seja temporada.
Fiquei decepcionada. Se gosta de tomar banho de mar (como eu), leve isso em consideração. O mar é verdinho, de fato, mas não é transparente porque a areia é muito fina e fica em estado de suspensão. Talvez em passeios de barco as coisas sejam diferentes. Mas passeio de barco não é minha "praia".

reviews.author: Explore43152150618
reviews.title: Paradisus lives up to its name
reviews.text:
Royal service was exceptional! All our questions and needs were fulfilled down to a special dinner menu created specifically for our group.
The personnel at the hotel and golf course were great also. It was truly service with a smile.

reviews.author: Ronald B
reviews.title: Get away
reviews.text:
Had the royal service 
Wanda royal service bartender great
Great service from butler and recommend 

Wife passed away over Christmas week and had a wonderful time solo 
Good food good restaurants and great staff

reviews.author: Alexi
reviews.title: Termites in the room
reviews.text: After paying so much money the room was over run with termites.  Pretty upsetting I must say. Called the front desk and they were pretty unconcerned. After much fuss housekeeping came at almost midnight  & changed the sheets.. .foid was ok nothing to shout about...grounds very well kept.

reviews.author: Valerie
reviews.title: Great Resort!
reviews.text: The resort is great. I have stayed here before, and came back due to the exceptional service. This time, I upgraded to Royal Service, on the Adults Only side of the resort. My butler, Jose, was great, taking care of all of my dinner reservations, golf and other requests. He would regularly check in with me during the day to make sure that all my needs were taken care of. I felt very looked after. I was able to go to most of the restaurants, and they were all very good. The restaurant exclusive to the Royal Service guests, Palazzo, was excellent, and the staff there were very attentive. I would definitely return.

reviews.author: melodic1
reviews.title: The Calm Before Life's Storms
reviews.text:
This was a dream come true! My husband and I came to the DR to celebrate our 20th Wedding Anniversary. This was our first honeymoon. We had been to the Caribbean once before, for missions, but never on vacation. Upon arrival at The Paradisus Palma Real, we were greeted and taken to the Royal Service headquarters. We received mimosas and given room keys and property information. A few moments later we meet Ariel, our personal butler. He welcomed us, introduced himself and took us on a tour of the property, ending with our room. Ariel gave us his cell phone number and informed us that he was here, to assist us, with anything.

Ariel was amazing!! He tuned in early to our desires. He was proactive, and meticulous in the way he served us. He made suggestions and scheduled daily cabanas in the Royal Service are and nightly dinners to the restaurant of our choice.  Before the day of our anniversary, we walked into our room to find the bed filled with heart shaped roses, champagne, Dominican fruits and chocolates. We were elated!!! Taped to our mirror, was a certificate acknowledging our commitment. On the day of our anniversary, Ariel took it even further with a candle lit champagne toast- bubble bath with roses spelling out “I Love You”. Our bed was covered in roses again, with the words "Happy Honeymoon".

Rooms- Nice, Adequate, but could use a little updating. The Royal Service is definitely worth the money!
Food- Pretty Good, Although my husband became ill after eating a meal one night.
Grounds- Very clean and well kept. There were always people around cleaning! A daily sanitation occurred in the evenings into the night. This made me happy:)

This was indeed the highlight of our year! After returning home, we would encounter Hurricane Florence(September). We would be without a home for two and a half months, longing for our time on the beautiful beaches of Punta Cana. We will hold this memory in our hearts and hope to return in the near future.

reviews.author: Jo N
reviews.title: Simply Paradise
reviews.text:
Meliá is simply the best. A heavenly experience. I will only be going to Melia resorts going forward. 

The beautiful beaches of DR make for a perfect experience. The food, room, service... I cannot wait to return.

reviews.author: Sheldon R
reviews.title: Special Staff Member
reviews.text: I stayed at this resort Oct 2018. I had stayed at the sister resort Melia Level Jan 2017. While I had a few small issues the first day, it was actually resolved mostly by an unrelated party.  While at the resorts they have agents looking to sell condo vacations. I thought they were selling actual condo's so at first I was interested. The agent who approached me was Presley. ( yes named after Elvis) . In fact he is a budding local musician.  A young well spoken  sales rep. While he wasn't able to sell me the vacation resort membership, he took a keen interest in my concerns with the actual resort and got involved with mangers to get me to the right people.  He knew I was not buying from him and he was not going to make a dime off me, yet he spent several hours during my staff checking up on my daily to see how I and the stay were.  We maintained contact after my departure until this day. I since returned again this month to Melia and once again Presley reached out to me .  Its nice to know some people still care about personal relationships above the almighty dollar!  The 5 stars are for Presley, Likely 4.5 stars for the resort.

reviews.author: Angela V
reviews.title: Excellent and friendly service
reviews.text: I was warmly welcomed by Presley who works at the circle. He was extremely helpful and wonderful to work with! I was very impressed by the condos at the circle and the high quality service I received!

reviews.author: Javier Anibal M
reviews.title: EXCELENTE LUGAR
reviews.text: Desde que llegué todo ah estado estupendo, el hotel es hermoso, ya estuve el año pasado pero este año hay más novimiento, la comida muy buena y la bebida estupenda, me quede en Royal es súper y tranquilo, siempre busco paz y tranquilidad, Luis Carlos mi mayordomo muy bueno; y las chicas de actividades JOHANNA, CARIDAD y KELYIS me hicieron pasar la noche súper amena y divertida, son las MEJORES me voy con un bonito recuerdo. LO RECOMIENDO AL MAXIMO.

reviews.author: GrandTour07672520536
reviews.title: Visit

reviews.author: Cathy C
reviews.title: Vacation 2018
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at your property! I had the pleasure of meeting one employees who was my butler his name was Nicolas! He had such a great personality and took great care of me! He is a great asset to your property and company!

reviews.author: Luis L
reviews.title: Perfecto
reviews.text: Sin fallos. Me asignaron una de las mejores habitaciones de The Reserve. Exactamente lo que necesitaba para desconectar y relajarme. Atención permanente sin atosigar. Volvería en cuanto pudiera.  Gracias.

reviews.author: jmarley52794
reviews.title: Honeymoon Bliss
reviews.text: My husband and I extremely enjoyed our honeymoon. Our butler, Angelo, was absolutely amazing. He made our stay so easy and relaxing. We could not have picked a better resort to stay at. The food was great, the service was outstanding, and the atmosphere was so fun. We will definitely be returning soon!

reviews.author: TravelwithFMA
reviews.title: Fantastic Resort
reviews.text:
I was here for one day on a day pass as I was staying close to the hotel and wanted to treat myself. I had an amazing day and all staff I met were friendly and helpful. I met a gentleman called Alain who guided me around the resort and showed me the facilities, such great service he's a credit to your hotel! I enjoyed relaxing by the pool and spent a lot of my day either eating or drinking,  lots of choice which is great.

reviews.title: Vacation to Dominican Republic

This time I got Argenis and he’s one of a kind. By far the best butler I’ve had. He very helpful and concerned if your having a good time or not. If I come back I want him to be my butler again.  He also make sure I knew where to go for the things I was looking for.   I really hope I can come again soon!

reviews.author: anil1282018
reviews.title: Lo recomiendo 100% 😎
reviews.text: Las instalaciones del hotel son excelentes y hay muchas actividades por hacer. La comida deliciosa nunca me decepcionó, los restaurantes temáticos me encantaron, son muy elegantes y variados. Quisiera resaltar la amabilidad y buena disposición de su personal, en especial la de JUAN GOMEZ y su equipo (José,  Juana, Pamela) del bar del lobby principal, quienes fueron increíblemente amables, profesionales y muy amigables... sus cócteles los mejores!!! Realmente da gusto conocer personas como Juan Gomez que no solamente brindan un excelente servicio sino que adicionalmente son tan especiales con el huésped que volvería sin pensarlo a este hotel.No tengo nada negativo que decir, es un 5 estrellas en todos los aspectos.

reviews.author: Kathy N

While we are there my husband and I renewed our vows after 10 yrs. and the romance department did a fabulous job.  Can’t say enough nice things about this resort.  Can’t wait to come back.

reviews.title: Short vacation
reviews.text: I enjoyed my time at the Paradisus Punta Cana, it was my second trip to DR is this hotel is amazing! Everything from the resort, decor, staff and food was great! Will definitely stay here again next time I'm in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Jeanette M
reviews.title: My room was amazing and Leidy Jimenez was the best!
reviews.text:
I took a quick trip to have a relaxing getaway.  I was kindly upgraded with my room and received a junior suit with a partial ocean front view, which was amazing. The breeze while sitting on the beach was great, and it was very close to my room.  I had the privacy of staying at The Reserve Beach.  This provided for additional services and special treatment. 

I had a personal concierge, Leidy Jimenez, who was wonderful. She was always so bubbly, responsive, wanted to ensure that you had a good time, and was very sweet. She did everything with a smile and helped me to enjoy my stay. 

The hotel was very clean, the pools are lovely, and the beach was great, other than the seaweed.  But, the hotel cannot do anything about nature. 

The staff was very responsive and kind.  The only thing that I was not ecstatic about was the food.  I saw prior reviews that said the food is/was amazing.  I found it to be just okay, but then one sort of expects this in an all-inclusive hotel.  I did not get the opportunity to stay for very long, so I cannot really comment on the service for the various restaurants.  I only ate at two, and the service was perfectly fine, but in one of the restaurants, they were slow with service and one of my plates arrived cold--twice!  

However, this hotel is great in terms of location, access to the beach, the service, and the room.  I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: 567joanr
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text:
A member of this resort for 10 years, I always feel as if I am coming home. 
Much of the staff is rotated but George Alriche at the member pool, is a delightful welcoming face each and every year.  From the first day until your last, George will have your lounge and drinks replenished as if reading your mind.
The activities available will keep you as busy as you like every hour; dance lessons, zumba, volleyball, painting, cocktail making, aqua aerobics....its endless.
Restaurant service is consistent as is the food.  Recommend you make reservations upon arrival to ensure your selections are open and available.
The grounds are impeccable and the reason why so many weddings are held at this beautiful location.
I highly recommend spending time at the spa; had a great massage and facial in February.  
Can't ask for a more enjoyable,  peaceful and restful vacation.

reviews.author: Lisa S
reviews.title: Second to None
reviews.text: This resort is second to none! I’ve stayed at several all inclusive resorts, and this was second to none. I had the Royal Service. The service provided was amazing and went way above my expectations. My Butler Argenis was absolutely amazing. At other resorts, I had to have dinner at the buffet (I hate buffets) for dinner the night I arrived because it was too late to have a same-day reservation. Here, upon arrival, Argenis told me he had already made a dinner reservation for me at the Hibachi restaurant for that night. I was provided with his cell number so I could text him, day or night, with anything I needed. His response was immediate, and anything I needed, including things I didn’t even know I needed, were resolved above expectation. Each day, when I went back to my room, there was a surprise waiting for me, such as a bubble bath with flower petals in my jacuzzi, or chocolate covered strawberries, cheese and crackers, etc. I also received a “Good morning” text every morning to make sure there was nothing that I needed. I told him I wanted nothing but bottled water in my in-room refrigerator, and I got it. In other resorts, I always had to ask for more water because there was never enough, and I may or may not have gotten it. Not here! He made all of my dinner reservations, even changed them when I texted that request, and sent me pictures of the computer screens showing that the reservation was made. On my first beach day, he also introduced me to the beach service staff, who were also amazing. My beach service contact was Luis, who was also amazing. The resort was slow when I went, so I had no issue getting a bed on the beach. Luis brought me to TWO beds, not lounge chairs, one in the sun, and one under a palapa so I could have some shade (these were a scarce at other resorts). He then got towels for me (I had to get my own at other resorts), set them up on my beds, and brought me a table and an ashtray when I asked for them, asked what I wanted to drink, and brought it to me. After my first day, Luis met me at the beach entrance, and brought me to my beds, which he already set up before I arrived, complete with towels and everything I requested the first day, remembered what I like to drink, made sure I still wanted that, and brought it to me. Argenis checked in with me every day while I was on the beach to make sure everything was still ok and to ask if I enjoyed myself the night before and asked if I needed anything again. All of the room service staff, including Mikael and Billy, were extremely attentive and beyond accommodating. I told one other server how much I love the coffee there (I unfortunately didn’t write down his name so I forgot it). I asked what it was, and he told me the name, which is Santo Domingo, told me they sell it in the gift shop, and offered to bring me some to save me a trip to the gift shop. Room service was always prompt and even arrived sooner than committed. One day, I was on my patio when they arrived so I didn’t hear them knock on my door. I got a phone call saying that they tried to deliver and they would return, which they did within minutes. After that day, the servers called me to tell me they were on their way so I could be prepared to open the door. On my last beach day, I got sunscreen in my eyes. When I ordered coffee after the beach, I told Billy what happened, and he told me to flush my eyes with water, and to make sure I used the bottled water. The next day, when he called to tell me my breakfast order was on its way, he asked how my eyes were. Also, when he delivered my coffee the day before, I asked him if I could get an omelet made to order, which was not on the room service menu. I got it the next morning, exactly as requested, and at the exact time I wanted it. Again, exceeding expectations and resolving needs I didn’t know I had. The room was always impeccably clean and well-kept. I was traveling alone, so there was one towel. I called and requested 4 in my room. After that day, there were always 4 towels in my room without me having to make the request again. The food at this resort was beyond amazing, which says a lot since I am extremely picky. Every restaurant’s food was amazing; if they were near me, I would gladly pay to eat there. The Royal service beach was clean. The unfortunate thing that happened was a couple of plastic cups washed up on the shore from the ocean, probably from the party boats, which is out of the resort’s control. But, they didn’t stay there long! My last day, there was a storm offshore, so LOT (e.g. wall) of seaweed washed ashore) not being picky - I expect seaweed since it’s the ocean after all). However, there was a truck out there picking it up all day. This resort was so amazing that I would never consider staying anywhere else. Service was amazing, and by the time my trip was over, the staff members became my friends. Also, I was traveling alone, and although it was completely safe, I was nervous walking back to my room at night by myself. I communicated this to the front desk, and was told I could get a golf cart to drive me directly to my building, which happened, so if you’re a woman and want to travel alone but are nervous, this is definitely the place to stay. My only recommendation to management would be to put up barriers off the beach like the Melia next door did to keep the wall of seaweed out of the swimming area and off the beach (FYI, the hotel next door is owned by the same company and they had the barriers, so I was allowed to swim there). I wouldn’t ever consider staying anywhere else, promarily because of the staff members I mentioned, and, because of them, I would make Punta Cana my Caribbean vacation of choice so I could stay at this resort again. Thank you Argenis, Luis, Mikael, Billy, and the server whose name I forgot who offered to bring me coffee from the gift shop (to management, he delivered coffee to me at approximately 5:30 PM on Thursday May 10 in room 1116) for making this one of my best vacations ever!
