reviews.author: K6695EKdavids
reviews.title: terrible customer service ruins vacation
reviews.text:
The Good:

The Paradisus Palma Real (Palma) was a good value in that it was significantly cheaper than some other resorts I looked into booking in the last week of February 2018 in the Dominican. There is some truth though to the saying that you get what you pay for.

My room was somewhat dated. The night lites on the headboard were both broken. Several channels listed on the satellite TV service also wouldn't work properly (no sound and/or picture). That being said, the room was clean and I was more than satisfied with it and it had all the amenities one needed.

The restaurant selection was somewhat limited and the food was, for the most part, slightly above average but nothing to write home about and definitely not 5 Star quality. Evening entertainment was typical resort stuff - very average in that regard. The Casino apparently has been reduced in size to about 20 slot machines, a couple of BJ tables, a Craps table, roulette and Caribbean poker and is only open at night.

There was a very bit of seaweed (weedy type as opposed to mucous type) on the beach but it was mostly dried seaweed and there wasn't that much in the water so it really wasn't an issue and could be largely ignored. There was a wide variety of water activities available (some included in the package price and some not). The golf course, which was a typical resort friendly wide open affair, was well maintained and had 27 holes which provided some variety when playing multiple days.

The Semi-Bad:

They use a reservation system for both the restaurants and the golf course. Some might appreciate it while for others it might seem like work on a vacation having to plan specific mealtimes days in advance. Additionally, they preferred you only booked golf 2 days at a time (other resorts I have been too allow you to book golf for your entire stay in advance). They also charge a "cart" fee of $65-75 US dollars which in reality is a green fee because it applies to each person in your group and is on the high side for an all-inclusive resort. Additionally, the shuttle to the course is only once an hour so if you finish your round at 1:05 pm and want to hit the beach you have to wait until 2 pm for the next shuttle back to the hotel. There's really no good excuse for the shuttle not running at least every 1/2 hour.

There is only one store on the resort with a very limited selection of snacks/beverages/cigarettes. Luckily, there is a shuttle that runs every 15 minutes to a mall just 5 minutes away (and next to the golf course which has hourly shuttles only) that has a plethora of stores, including a grocery store and pharmacy and 3 brand name restaurants if you want to eat off the resort.

I had to call often to get my mini bar replenished with pop and water as they didn't seem to regularly replace the pop and water I had drunk. That being said, they did respond promptly when called.

If it wasn't for the terrible customer service experience I am going to describe below I would probably have rated the Palma as average to slightly above average and recommended it to others. But, unfortunately, I can't do that.

The Terrible:

I had brought $300 US with me. On the 2nd or 3rd day there I went to buy some small items at the only store on the Resort property (apparently managed by a 3rd party). I paid with a $100 US bill and received four $20's US and change in return. Unbeknownst to me, as I wasn't paying close attention, one of the $20 bills had been taped back together. When I tried to use it at the nearby Mall the clerk refused to accept it. So I went back to the resort store and explained the situation to them and politely requested they exchange the bill for me. They refused on the basis that they had to know which cashier had given it to (I had told them it wasn't't anyone working currently). They explained that the other cashiers worked opposite shifts and asked me to come back the next day so see if I could recognize the cashier when that crew was working. Though I thought this completely unnecessary I remained polite and patient and agreed to come back the next day. The next day I couldn't recognize the cashier either and they said that unless I could provide a receipt to prove my purchase and allow them to review the security footage to confirm the transaction they would't exchange the bill. I told them I couldn't do that and requested they review the tapes themselves to find the transaction. They agreed and told me to come back again the next day. 

When I did come back the next day they produced footage of someone that didn't look anything like me buying a lot more items than I did. This appeared to me to be an attempt by them to claim that my story was fabricated and I wouldn't have gotten the bill from them to justify them not exchanging the bill. At this point it was obvious the situation was not going to be resolved and I told them I was going to speak to hotel management.

That caused a bit of a stir as they called ahead to tell their side of the story. I ended up dealing with Domingo the guest services manager. Domingo was great. Even though he initially reiterated the store's request for proof after I advised him the bill was legal tender and acceptable at any bank as way as making the case that security footage wouldn't really prove anything because it wasn't of good enough quality to see tape on the bill he agreed to have the bill taken to the bank for me (instead of me having to spend the time and money to do so) and asked that I come back an hour later. This whole conversation lasted 5 minutes and the situation was resolved. If the staff at the store had any customer service skills at all they would have made the same offer initially instead of requiring me to come back 3 times and refusing to do anything.

I'm giving both the store staff and Domingo some slack here because they both wanted verification (receipt/bank acceptance) as opposed to just a straightforward exchange but we were dealing in a foreign currency so I can accept they wanted to be sure the bank would take it. But refusing to help me at all, as the store staff did, was totally unacceptable.

If the story had ended here because Domingo was such a gentleman and professional I probably wouldn't bother to mention the whole incident. It's what happened next why I will never stay again at the Palma and can't recommend it to anyone.

The next day I used the resort ATM to get Dominican money. I went to the Resort Casino to exchange it for US dollars. I then tried to pay for something at the Resort store using one of the $20 bills I had gotten from the Casino. The cashier examined the bill like she was a Mint employee. She refused to accept the bill claiming it was to old or some other nonsense. It was quite obvious that not only was the store never going to help me to begin with with the original $20 bill they now considered me the problem and didn't want my business despite this all being entirely their fault.

I immediately asked to speak with a hotel manager and was referred to a pleasant and emphatic young man who was the front desk Supervisor. When told the story and shown the bill in question he agreed there was nothing wrong with it and that I shouldn't have been treated this way. I asked him 2 things. Speak to the staff at the store and give me some token form of compensation. He said he would look into it and come back later.

When I did come back he said he had spoken to the store manager who had held an impromptu staff meeting and that this wouldn't happen again. Furthermore, the store manager was supposed to contact me to apologize. He was non-committal when I asked for token compensation again, politely I might add.

I never was contacted by the store manager and never received any token compensation. I will never stay at the Palma again because of this highly insulting situation which they didn't handle very well and failed basic customer service 101 in the pro

reviews.author: TravelAddict6464
reviews.title: Rooms Very Far from Beach
reviews.text:
A resort within Paradisus Punta Cana with newer rooms but the facility is very far from the beach and many rooms face the road!  Make sure to ask for a room facing the pool if you want a view and/or more tranquility. Unfortunately the golf cart for transport does not come by very often and Circle members (time share) have first priority so be prepared for allot of walking!

Rooms are newer but the closet is very small and it was hard to fit all my clothes.  I cannot imagine a family or couple sharing such a small closet.  I also experienced many maintenaince issues with room especially with air conditioning.  Room was so cold that I couldn't sleep for first 3 nights, even though I made several calls to fix!

The pool is wonderful with plenty of activities (best part), but the bar does not serve premium alcohol which I am surprised at given the price paid!  Spa has very limited water therapy activities.  Food is average.

Overall, I would not return given that there are 100+ resorts and many newer with better amenities along the Bavaro, Punta Cana strip.

reviews.author: J K
reviews.title: Mediocre - 8 day stay, second visit to Paradisius Palma Real.
reviews.text:
Cons:
- time share pressure was extremely rude, annoying.  concierge is responsible for making reservations at restaurants.  My concercierge, Kati spoke very little English. I explained I was here last year and attended the time share mutual and was not interested. The next day she catches my attention and again she is literally begging me to attend a meeting and that she will give me two free massages or a $50 gift voucher and that it would take 20 minutes.  To appease her I went to chat with them. I explained to them the exact same thing and they understood and asked me is there any point in me chatting with them or see a presentation again. I said no it is no, then they sent out their manager the manager was very rude and he said that he was there to run a business  and that they would not be giving me a free massage.  He insinuated that I was there merely to get a free massage and not to listen to the presentation. This was not the case I was merely doing Kati a favour, I specifically told her I do not want a massage and she insisted that it was something that I would receive.   In fact she told me that she would give me two free massages. And then this manager comes out and tells me that they would not be giving me anything. I did not care for any motivation or incentive.  The manager could not have been more rude. I get massages all the time at where I live. I was merely doing the concierge, Kati a favour.   I am not  impressed with this tactic when a person is on holiday.   The reason I am letting Travelers know about this is they will tell you that it will take 45 minutes of your time, this is not true they will keep you there in excess of one hour, they are using this incentive IE. Free massage or a $50 gift voucher to be spent at the hotel, to lure you to attend their  timeshare "Circle" meeting.  Personally, this is a big turn off for me.  Feufteen minutes of my life wasted with these timeshare business.  Note that they will express their dusmay to your face, when you express no interest, and do not stay for their complete sales pitch.  

.  They ask you to present a towel card to get a beach towel. When you return the towel they give you back a beach card. Purpose of this is to ensure that you return your towel. I found this  very inconvenient, and I let the concierge genesis no and I asked her to do something about it. Genesis was very kind and attentive and looking after my concerns. She spoke spoke  English well. I let her know for the remainder of my stay I will not be presenting a towel card to receive a towel nor will I be returning a towel. I explained that this is a five star hotel and I am wearing a bracelet so why would I need to present a towel card,  I found this to be insulting and insinuating that people would steal towels. I was here in March 2017 and they did not have this towel procedure in place. 

The concierge that was assigned to me specifically Kati was not helpful whatsoever. However another concierge, Genesis spoke English well, was extremely friendly and understanding sympathetic and helpful. 

 Upon check in to my room there were several deficiencies including a safe that was not attached or secured anything. It was like a loose shoe box. As well the combination attachment/ mechanism was loose. A lightbulb needed to to be replaced. A lizard needed to be removed.  I was locked into the bathroom,  and could not get the door open. I had to climb out of the bathroom through the window shutters. The temperature of the water in the shower constantly fluctuated from cool to too hot. This is not safe.

. Hotel is worn and needs to be updated.

. The Bavaro Beach is public therefore there are vendors everywhere constantly approaching me asking me to purchase their goods. Picture this, here I am lying on a lounge chair and venders literally come within 2 feet of me and asks me whether I want to have my hair braided or to purchase bags hats sunglasses.  They weave/walk all around the people on lounge chairs to solicit.  This made me  very uncomfortable and unsafe. As well as  I am walking along the beach they will  approach  and ask me to take an excursion, to go shopping in their stores along the beach, this unwanted solicitation is constant, and annoying.

. Communication difficulty because some staff do not speak English well, and definitely should if they are assigned to an English speaking guest as myself.

Pros:
. Good variety of restaurants.  Some food was very good. Great varieties of food.
. My room was cleaned well daily.
. Nightly entertainment which was okay.
. Some staff are friendly and helpful.
. Paddle board exercising was great, taught by Xavier, Noel, Hanson.
. Enjoyed the mini trampouline exercise session.

reviews.author: Irena
reviews.title: 9 days in December
reviews.text:
About 15 minutes drive from the PUJ.
Big and beautiful resort divided on different sections,  like RS for adults only, club Melia,
family concierge - for families with kids.
A few swimming pools, water was cool early in the morning.
Great beach area, nice white sand, again as a resort beach divided on different sections, and it is plenty of room in shade and on the sun for everybody.
There are chain of resorts along the beach so it is safe to walk for a long time along the water in both directions.
there is a seaweeds in a water, so water is a little murky, and there is board on the beach with explanation of ecosystem and the seaweed as part of it.
Vendors walking on a beach with trinkets and if you say No they don't bother you.
Service with drinks and food provided on a beach also.

Plenty of choices for food in buffet , food is commercial, 
not like before, when fruit and veggies was delivered fresh from farms.

open air sitting, you can feel nice breath 
food was good

timing - everything was on time
atmosphere - a lot of families with kids, and kids of course very active and rowdy,
                       music was pleasant.

with kitchen behind the big window, so it was entertaining to observe the food preparations by staff.
Menu - OK
Food - good
Presentation- good
Timing - good
service - good
atmosphere - noisy, a lot of people, very busy place.

Aqua
everything was good, menu, food, service, timing and atmosphere.

reviews.author: barbara2223
reviews.title: Only For Families
reviews.text:
I requested Royal Service and the only thing I received was terrible service.   I am recovering from a serious illness and was told this was for the ADULT only swimming pool.  This was note enforced. Didn’t care that the only thing I requested ICE was not in my room that I had to go each day to make my own dinner reservations each day far from my room.
But that the employee are so nice they do not want to tell people that the private pool was private. I became the person who told them. It was the most unsatisfactory hotel I have ever stayed

reviews.author: gabriel s
reviews.title: Hotel Maravilloso
reviews.text:
Estuve a fines de octubre y comienzo de noviembre en el área de socios melia, y como siempre muy bien y comodo. Al ingresar al hotel, mi habitación tuvo un inconveniente, para lo cual inmediatamente me cambiaron a una habitación mejor. Aunque el restaurant de hamburguesas que se encuentra al lado de la playa, se encuentra en refaccion, la atención nunca dejó de ser buena, ayudados por la poca cantidad de huspedes por ser temporada baja. Siempre voy a recomendar el Hotel, ya que la atención al socio melia es muy buena, para lo cual agradezco a los Sres. del Salon de ventas:  Sra Judith, Sr Angel de Jesús, Sr. Jose Luis Martínez. Agradezco también a los Sr. Juan Perez, Sr Dionisio de la gerencia del hotel, los Sres. Angel, Juan Carlos, y Sra Judith del club Melia, y atención en playa; Sra Yesenia, Junior, Obeydy, Gregori, Felipe, Dionis,  Rabel, Raul, Gabriel, Victor, Boni, y George.y Por ultimo Sr Justo de la cocina.
Por ultimo recomiendo que se hagan socios, dado que hay una notoria diferencia con el areay servicio a socios, con respecto al área regular del hotel, con solo imaginarse que el área regular del hotel es excelente, imagínense el área de socios...... no vas a querer dejar este maravilloso lugar.

reviews.author: Makeise F
reviews.title: Pre-Birthday "Pamper Me" Trip
reviews.text:
Honneeyyy, let me tell you about my vacation to Punta Cana. This was a pre-birthday trip and it was EPIC! I stayed at the Paradisis Palma Real and I paid a little extra for the ROYAL SERVICE...because it was my birthday.  Let me tell you, from the moment I checked in...up until I checked out (6 days).....I WAS PAMPERED LIKE A QUEEN. I had my personal/favorite butlers, bar tender, masseuse and waiter that thought of everything! Towels pre-laid under a cabana, my favorite drink waiting on me, you remembered I love shrimp  (extra on my plate), you remembered I was diabetic and I skipped lunch and you had a beautiful mix of cheeses, crackers, & fruit waiting in my room for me....you even had special baths drawn for me in the evening with rose pedals! Now, if that's not special treatment, I don't know what is....

Let me add that this was my 2nd stay at this resort and my 1st time using the ROYAL Service. Trust me it's worth every dime. I will definitely be back next year because of the exceptional service these people provided with a smile every single time: Luis Sanches, Jose Lugo - Butlers, Cristian Castro - Waiter @Fuego restaraunt, Lee Valdez - Bar Tender and Ms. Evelyn @The YHI Spa !!! When you come to a place and it feels like the home you never wanted to leave...That experience deserves to be "repeated"! Thanks to all the staff, the beautiful property, the amenities and exceptional FOOD (can't forget the food, lol). I will DEFINITELY be back next year, but I think I need to add on additional days next time.

P.S. To Management the people I named DESERVE a promotion...YESTERDAY!

reviews.author: marsel0
reviews.title: Sehr schöne Ferien
reviews.text:
Ich habe die Zeit sehr genossen. Die Animation und das Tanzen mit Miss Germania José hat mir am meisten Spass gemacht.
Die A-la- Carte Restaurants und das Buffet waren super.
Die Zimmer sind sehr gross.
Alle Mitarbeiter sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend.
Ich werde wieder kommen.

reviews.author: LaTanya M
reviews.title: I would totally go again
reviews.text:
This was my first solo trip and I completely loved this place. I wouldn't change a thing even with the hurricane. they took very good care of us. I enjoyed everything from the views from my room to the service. everyone is very friendly. I would definitely go back
 My butler, Kelvin Fernandez, was super super nice and helpful and gave great suggestions on excursions and wine . And he went above and beyond to make my birthday special.

reviews.author: ericaa901
reviews.title: Beautiful Property - Terrible Hospitality
reviews.text:
Several room issues throughout my stay. I went for a wedding and it was a pretty big group of people and we all had issues. Whether it was a bar tender who refused to give us straws or when my phone, shower, and toilet broke and it took two days to fix. I would not recommend arriving on a day other than Saturday or Sunday. You must make dinner reservations and you can do those for the whole week on Saturday or Sunday, but if you arrive any other day you can only do it one day at a time and availability was like 9PM for dinner.  Also, they rank their guests so make sure you book not through a travel agent otherwise you will only be able to do dinner at some of the places. I paid for all inclusive and they charge $5 for room service to be delivered. 
Also, they want you to tip. I've never had an all inclusive experience where they expected tips. They gave me longer wait times at bars when I wasn't holding money in my hand. Also, they only want US dollars.

reviews.author: Aidan N
reviews.title: Beyond expectations!
reviews.text:
The last time I stayed at this resort was in 2014. 3 years have passed and when I set foot here again this month, I was still in awe of the sheer beauty and relaxation that overwhelms me. 

The resort is beautifully kept and modernized. I felt that there were more food and drink options than the last time, which is rare for an all-inclusive resort. The caliber of service is set high, on par with other 5 and 6-star resort I have been to around the world.

The resort manager, Ms. Blum went out of her way to help make my stay a memory that I won't ever forget. In all honestly, I owe this good time to her hospitality and kind courtesy. If you're reading this, thank you Sandra! I just decided to book another trip here next month for 5 people of my family. 

I was assigned butler service, and it was as meticulous and gracious an experience as one could ask for. My butler, Mr. Francis Newton was top-notch. He took time to walk me around the resort, noted down every request of mine and actually made them happen no matter how big or small, how easy or challenging. He was most respectful yet easy going, and professional yet approachable, intuitive yet unassuming. His unexpected treat for me at the end of the stay was truly appreciated. 

In short, if you're looking to be pampered and truly relaxed, go with Paradisus, and opt for that Royal Service because it's worth every cent. 

Will I be back? Yes!

reviews.author: 437MartinC437
reviews.title: The best
reviews.text: I went to this resort with my family and I was amazing and we loved it we would totally come back there was two people that had always cared for us there names where Olga and ray they where so nice to us when we where at this stay and the beach was wonderful and so fun at the dance party's and we all enjoyed it we are coming back tomorrow haha

reviews.author: jtuchsch2017
reviews.title: Fantastic 2nd Honeymoon
reviews.text: The staff at Paradisus left a lasting impression.  Miguel, our butler, made us feel very welcome and customized his interactions with us perfectly.  He was great to talk to and answered lots of questions about the resort, surrounding areas, and culture of DR.  We loved the fact that he shared his family background and deep rooted traditions and beliefs.  A wonderful man.  Rafael, our beach concierge, wouldn't let me lift a finger at the beach.  Even when he caught me grabbing a drink walking back from the room.  He was personable, friendly, and made us feel like we were the most important people there.  He chatted with us frequently which made the time even more enjoyable.  Last but not least, Juan Suarez, our daily waiter in the buffet is one of the finest customer service individuals I've ever met.  He remembered us from the first day we had breakfast, and we ended up planning our meals around his schedule.  We didn't chat much with him, but he made us feel so comfortable we looked forward to seeing him each day.  A consummate professional.  Overall the resort was great and very relaxing.  The food was phenomenal, especially the royal service Italian restaurant, which we enjoyed twice.  A few minor hiccups could have been handled a little better, but nothing that would make me think twice about staying there again.  If you plan a trip to Paradisus, definitely upgrade to Royal Service.  AND, seek out Miguel, Rafael, and Juan!  You won't regret it.

reviews.author: jay k
reviews.title: Dahiana is the best
reviews.text: Dahiana is the best. She is very nice and welcoming. She showed me a great time whether it was dancing or painting. She was fabolous and I loved her. She is kind, thoughtful, and a beautiful person. She is awesome.

reviews.author: Stephen P
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Awesome resort highly recommended  food was great people were friendly and helpful pools beach were great restaurant's were good room's were great the pool bar and lobby bar were great this resort didn't have the loud music around the pool that some resorts have witch was nice it's a five star resort

reviews.author: jeninatl2017
reviews.title: Great and Not-so-Great
reviews.text: This was our first time visiting Punta Cana and I spent hours searching for he best resort based on reviews and aesthetics. This resort was the winner and I'm glad we chose it. There are just a couple of things that need improvement. First, there are no heated pools! I might have chosen a different resort had I known that ahead of time, but it wasn't that big of a deal because the ocean wasn't too rough most days, so you could get in the ocean if you really wanted to swim. Second, we received an email with a form to fill out with our preferences prior to our visit, but there were no instructions on how to submit the form and we ended up assigned to a room with 2 double beds instead of a king bed. I didn't mind having 2 beds, but I feel that you shouldn't advertise that the butler will collect your preferences prior to your stay if you don't make sure there are instructions fir how to submit your preferences. Having mentioned those 2 things, I would still definitely return! Another reviewer said that the specialty restaurants weren't that great and recommended the buffet. I do have to agree that the buffet was wonderful every time we went, but several of the restaurants were great as well. I highly recommend the Royal Service because you get to stay in an adults-only section, but are free to go to the rest of the resort that is family-friendly whenever you want. Our butler, Kelvin, was great! He surprised us several times with thoughtful things, such as a beautiful bubble bath decorated with flowers, a dessert sampler, and a meat and cheese tray. Thanks, Kelvin! Lastly, there are different activities every night, but we didn't go to them because we didn't find out about them ahead of time. If you go, be sure to ask about the events!

reviews.author: vanzee2018
reviews.title: Royal service outstanding. Worth the extra money
reviews.text:
We spent 8 days at this resort in Feb 2017. The resort exceeded our expectation for an all inclusive. With the Royal Package, guest are assigned a butler. Armando Minier, our personal Butler was exceptional in every detail. Armando made dinner reservations for every evening. In other all-inclusive resorts we have spent precious time at the concierge desks making reservations ourselves . Armando found us at the pool and asked where we wanted to eat and at what time, and everything was executed exactly as planned. Every evening Armando had a "special treat" for us in the room, from wine, sweets, fruits or cheese it was all beyond expectations. Armando thru out the day checked in with us to see if we needed anything and if everything was meeting our expectations. At many resorts a person needs to get up early and "mark" your chair by the pool in order to have a place to relax. That is not the case in the Royal Service Package. Francisco Cabrera along with Armando made sure we had the chairs and a location we wanted everyday. Francisco made sure we had cold water or drinks available throughout the day. Many days we slept in till 10am and still our lounge chairs were exactly where we wanted them. In other resorts we have had to get up as early as 7am just to get a chair. This is an awesome service, that spoils a guest, exceeding all expectations. 

We would have a difficult time coming up with anything negative to say about this resort. The restaurants were decorated beautifully, but we would give the quality of the food a rating of 7 or 8. This is not bad, but the resort did not exceed our expectations in the area of food quality.

If there was any negative to this beautiful resort, we would say the beaches should have been groomed every day to rake up the seaweed that the tide brought it. Beaches were phenomenal,  pure white sand, wide and not crowded, but the seaweed did distract from the beauty. The other resorts also has seaweed along the shoreline.

We would recommend this resort to anyone looking for a great experience. Armando and Francisco along with the rest of the staff will see us again. We hope very soon. "Salute"

reviews.author: Kathryn R
reviews.title: Fabulous... the beach, the staff, the rooms, the pool. Loved it all 😀
reviews.text:
I travelled alone to The Reserve. It totally met my expectations. 

I will comment that if you want to be close to the beach choose the main Paradisus. 

The value of the Reserve is everything is so much more personal with no chaos and you can use the main area as well. 

Beach is FANTASTIC 

The concierge at the building was fabulous. Melvin....always remembered my name 

Hermes Martinez, Pedro, and Silvia Aleman were fabulous at the pool bar/lounge 

Hotel activities were good!

reviews.author: grandemali
reviews.title: La atención personalizada es excelente
reviews.text: La infraestructura del Ressort es excelente al igual que la atención personalizada que uno recibe. El departamento, armónicamente arreglado y equipado, ofrece al huésped una cálida estadía, con una vista excelente a la zona de piletas.

reviews.author: michilopez
reviews.title: Great Service!
reviews.text:
I had the chance to stay here only for one night and I regret my short stay because everything was beyond perfect.

Let's start from the check in: Cheila  was very nice and attentive. The process was very smooth and she even gave me a tour of the beautiful property.

The rooms are spacious and cozy. Again, I regret that I only stayed one night :( (but I'll definitely come back with my boyfriend). 

I don't have kids but I really liked the fact that they have so many areas for kids and activities to entertain them. The best part is that if you don't like kids running around there are restaurants that are only for adults. 

At the pool you will never get bored if you are close to Germania, she is really funny and I had a great time doing the aerobics with her.

The pool service was phenomenal! I never ran out of piña coladas thanks to Juan. 

I had the chance to meet the GM Adrián while he was in one of his rounds at the restaurant. Very welcoming and offering suggestions during my short stay. 

Overall... It was amazing. I had the chance to relax and enjoy good food and drinks while I was getting a beautiful tan.

Definitely a must go place in Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: Ruthie L
reviews.title: Best Spa Service!
reviews.text: I just got back from Palma Real and I have to mention that I had the best spa service at the Oriental Garden Spa by YHI.   Sintiya gave me an incredible massage!  The environment is very relaxing and tranquil such as an Oriental Garden should be.  The day I went it was raining and hearing the raindrops in the hut that I had my massage in was so relaxing.  This was one of my best memories of my vacation.  Thank you so much!

reviews.author: kostjan07
reviews.title: Very good!!!
reviews.text: Отличный отель!!! Отличный персонал!!! Особенно хочется спасать слова благодарности аниматорам Luis and Germania!!!! Очень веселый и общительные ребята!!!Всем советую! Приезжайте!!! Отель предназначен не только для отдыха с семье, но и в одиночку скучать не придётся !!! Очень вкусная еда!!!!

reviews.author: Hopsing129
reviews.title: Upscale Great
reviews.text: We stayed at the Reserve in the Paradisus Punta Cana.  The rooms were all upscaled, lots of room, dual thermostats for comfort.  The food at the VIP dining was delicious and although our reservation was lost they still got us right in for outstanding service.  Drinks were flowing but if you order the highest quality brands there is a large fee.  Beach was great and several pools were very clean.

reviews.author: Judi H
reviews.title: Royal service is the way to go!   Yohel, my butler, made this trip awesome.
reviews.text: Service exceptional. My room was decorated for my birthday. It was so special. I can't wait to come back. Yohel, my butler, is the best. Food was excellent. He went above & beyond my expectations. I had the time of my life!

reviews.author: Kalli2802
reviews.title: Punta Cana at it's Best
reviews.text: Beautiful beach resort with very friendly staff, nice location, decent size with good restaurants and a great offer you expect from an all-inclusive resort. Rooms are nice & large, especially the ones in the Royal Service and the Family area.

reviews.author: Francoise D
reviews.title: The Reserve au petit soin pour nos vacances
reviews.text: Je suis retournée au Paradisius Punta Cana pour la deuxième fois et pour changer, à The Reserve pour sa grande suite avec une pièce intégrant le jacuzzi. Un troisième étage sans ascenseur qui ne m'a pas posé de problème, la possibilité de prendre tous les repas dans la suite lorsque l'on en a envie en commandant même 30 mn avant. La Réserve c'est aussi la possibilité incluse d'accéder à une dizaine de restaurants, en réservant la veille, trois d'entre eux sont avec supplément. Une grande piscine est près des quelques bâtiments. La réserve est située près de la réception, il est donc indispensable de prendre une voiturette pour accéder à la plage, en traversant le magnifique parc et en longeant la mangrove. Bon pour les amateurs de botanique. Le personnel est efficace et intervient rapidement. Très aisé en anglais, parlant généralement français et d'autres langues. Personnellement je n'utilise que l'espagnol, langue  du pays. De nombreuses activités sur la plage et le soir. La plage est surveillée, le drapeau hissé. J'y retournerai pour des vacances sans soucis. Un bémol, partie avec Jet Tours, ils n'étaient pas présents dans l'hôtel.

reviews.author: tsuee
reviews.title: Five days in paradise!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience after waiting an hour and a half to get into our beautiful room.  The accommodations and people were very helpful.  In our case, Enrique was exceptional to work with.  He took care of all our reservations and made our 25th extra special.  We definitely would visit again.  There are different levels of service according to your color of wrist band.  We were not aware of these when making our reservations.  The different levels allow you to eat at certain resturants and swim at certain pool areas and beach areas.

reviews.author: Angela M
reviews.title: Muy Excelente! Nestor Perez
reviews.text: Nestor Perez was one of my servers at breakfast and dinner at the Vento restaurant. Nestor was wonderful! Probably the best worker there! Nice, pleasant, and very attentive. If you are at the Reserve, please ask for Nestor! You'll be very satisfied with your service🖒

reviews.author: RicardoHolligan
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Excelente personal en el resort, con in personal maravilloso con una actitud positiva siempre de seguro regresare porque no hay nada major que estar en Paradisus Punta Cana junto a Yokaina Peguero, JoseA, Jose Fernandez,Marionell

reviews.author: Barbara C
reviews.title: Pampered in Paradise
reviews.text: I had the most amazing experience at the Paradise Palma Real resort. This is my 3rd time visiting the resort. I decided to enroll in royal services where I had my own private butler name Samuel Rodriguez. He was so amazing . He was always there to cater to my needs. He made my experience that much special. Every morning Carlos Rosario the beach concierge reserved a bed on the beach and served me drinks. Leonardo at the sun set bar made delicious drinks and always greeted me with a beautiful and cheerful smile. Martin and Felix at the palazzo restaurant always made me feel welcomed and was very accommodating. The food was deliciou. I had an awesome time and look forward to visiting again next year.

reviews.author: gabriel s
reviews.title: Nueva estadia en Paradisus PalmaReal
reviews.text: Después de una nueva visita al hotel, estoy  satisfecho con las instalaciones, habitación, y el area de socios melia, me han hecho sentir otra vez como en casa, ya que la atención recibida fue impecable y con amplia predisposición hacia mi persona. He visitado casi todos los días el Restaurant Palazzo, donde degusté las entradas y todos sus platos sabrosos y que despiertan todos los sentidos. También me dio satisfacción y alegría ver que después de innumerables visitas al hotel, ver el progreso de los que me servían el desayuno a la mañana convertidos en encargados de Restaurantes, son el caso de La Sra. Mencia (Restaurant Palazzo) y el Sr. Franklin de la Rosa (Restaurant Oleo) a ellos mis mejores deseos de progreso en lo particular y profesional, deseándoles que sigan en recorriendo ese camino exitoso!!! Sería injusto no volver a mencionar mi agradecimiento a todo el personal del hotel y restaurantes, entre ellos Zenovia, Martin, Jhoneidy, Osvaldo, Edison, Zenovia, Yelitza y Alexis, todos ellos del Restaurant Palazzo. También me agradecimiento al area de playa y bar Sunrise, Sra. Kenia, el infaltable Francisco Estrella y Hector Rogers, Sr. Obeydy(el primo), que además de disfrutar de la playa y el sol, no parar de reirme !!! Muchas gracias a ellos !!!  Con respecto a los aspectos a mejorar y revertir inmediatamente, beneficios al socio Melia, considero que la Gerencia debería replantear volver a sumar al menu poder almorzar entre otros platos por ejemplo Langosta, y volver a contar  en la habitación con los licores que enviaban permanentemente, esta decisión errónea debe revertirse, al socio se le debe dar mas beneficios, no quitárselos. Asimismo se dejaron de hacer los sorteos y eventos por la tarde como se hacían hace años atrás, También es necesario reinstalar la pequeña excursion que se realizaba en catamaran que duraba pocas horas, ya que los pequeños inconvenientes que trajo son muy fácil de solucionar, es todo un poco mas de voluntad...... Todas estas criticas son constructivas y no se deben tomar como aspectos negativos, ya que la estadia fue excelente. Mi sincero agradecimiento a todo el personal del Hotel !!!

reviews.author: kurkles
reviews.title: Great vacation

reviews.author: BHSolo
reviews.title: What a Disappointment
reviews.text:
This review is from someone who has visited the Caribbean before, stayed in high-end and low-end hotels, and is pretty forgiving. With that being said I would not recommend this hotel.

Right after book I realized I made a mistake of 1 instead of 2 people, originally it was a solo trip but my friend was going to join, I called Melia to try and switch it. I received 4 different answers, including the hotel saying they would charge me $200 more per night than the website was saying. A manager was to call me to explain why and I am still waiting for that call 2 months later.

The hotel:
Pros: 
Nice beach area with plenty of palapas with great shade coverage when wanted and 4 chairs all underneath each one.
Fuegos - a delicious restaurant with every good service
The pool was very nice with the beds in them
The gym was your pretty decent average hotel gym but I really did enjoy the paddleboard fitness and yoga, those were great.

Cons:
Upon arrival the bellman was dismayed, offended, and seemingly annoyed I came by myself - asking why I didn't have any friends? The maitre 'd at the buffet also was quite insistent on being upset I was traveling by myself. Thankfully I am a strong person to stand up to this but it was very offputting.
After being in my room and about to get ready for dinner I had no bath towels, the clock did not work, my fridge was not full, the outside light was out, the lock did not work well, the tv you had to get up to turn on and off with a missing channel button, and when I went to call to have these items fixed I found out my phones also did not work.
On the beach, the waiter went to get me a mudslide to only come back and say they had no Bailey's. Strange since I was able to get it at the bar right afterwards. The next day I tried again, assuming they would replenish, when the waiter said they were still out. So instead of him going to another bar to get it for me he told me to get up and get it myself.
The safety at the resort was also a bit disconcerting. The hotel doors only have a lock that maybe works, no chain. The partially lighted path is many times empty at night and becomes pitch black when the power goes out during a storm.
The overall service was bleh and at times a bit rude.

There is a new tiki bar in The Reserve beach area where things are very festive & lively with some informal dance lessons & 2 very nice bathrooms. This time, I upgraded to the 'Royal Service' and took a room on the beach which was amazing... More modern than the Reserve rooms, closer to the beach, and there is a private pool / bar / concierge lounge with top shelf alcohol in a very upscale setting.

Hector my butler was also very friendly and attentive.. He helped make the trip truly memorable and even arranging a super fun dune buggy trip that was a highlight of my trip.  The resort was also not too crowded this time of year, and the beaches are some of the nicest in the world! 

Definitely recommend, and recommend the beach front rooms (*some have jacuzzis) and they are cleaner / newer..  Some of the Reserve rooms are older and so I'd recommend the newer rooms by the beach per above although they don't have the in-room tubs.

The resort is very large, and there are many restaurants and it's just fun to explore all the different pools and pathways. They have golf carts to shuttle people around to wherever you want to be. One of my favorite destinations.

My butler Fermin Mato was beyond accommodating. I am not a demanding person and did not want to run him, but he was eager to be of assistance for whatever I may have needed. reviews.author: Jen C
reviews.title: Birthday celebration
reviews.text:
We were celebrating a friends birthday in December. The room was spacious enough for 3 adults. The first few days the room was cleaned rather late but after we requested It be cleaned earlier the resort immediately changed the cleaning schedule.
We celebrated the birthday by having dinner at Passion. It was unforgettable, everything was so delicious. Even though we paid extra for the meal it was well worth it. In N.Y we would have paid hundreds more. The food at Naos (buffet) was very good. Although there was prepared food, It wasn't sitting there for long. There were chefs at each station replenishing the supply. The meat, fish and pasta dishes were made to order. 

The staff  was very attentive, and very friendly. Caesar the captain at Passion also supervised staff at Naos the buffet and he would always come over to say hello to us. We received excellent service from Naos staff Johnny, Francisco, Junior and Victor. Everyone was so friendly and helpful that when we asked the ingredients of their local dish they went out of their way to go into the kitchen to get the root potatoes and yams so we see what they look like.
The entertainment was fabulous. The live shows were fantastic and the entertainment team " Live and Rich in entertainment" were the best. Shaky Shaky, Carmelo, Angel, Yudy, Agrippina, Snoopy, Carlos and Boom Boom kept us busy from morning to late afternoon. Morning was stretching, volley ball then water aerobics or water spinning. At 4 pm it was Zumba then merenge lessons. The only negative, these classes were too short. After the evening show we hung out at Gabi beach where the entertainment team was present to keep the party going.
The other negative the restaurants were not as good as my last stay. Naos made up for it. After the shows I would pop in to grab a cup of coffee and dessert. The worst was the sushi restaurant stay away from it.

reviews.author: Kate B
reviews.title: Потрясающе
reviews.text:
Это не первый мой отдых в Доминикане и есть с чем сравнить. Пока нахожусь в отеле - напишу свой отзыв. Отель конечно роскошный и премиум. 
Начну наверное по порядку:
1. территория огромная,  при этом удобная и интуитивно понятная, красивая и очень зеленая. Отель находится на территории Paradisus Punta Cana, но имеет свой ресепшн, бассейн, рестораны, бары, пляж. Так как это повышенная категория проживания, пользоваться бесплатно можно абсолютно всей инфраструктурой, кроме Роял клаб (ресторан и пляж). 
2. Номера большие и очень большие). Вначале приобрела стандартный люкс, но потом поменяла за доплату на огромный главный люкс. По сути обе категории номеров одинаково хорошие, но отличаются планировкой (в стандартном спальня расположена отдельной комнатой и лично мне там не хватало света) и размером. Главный конечно роскошен с огромным джакузи!  Сами номера расположены в отдалении от моря, но по территории постоянно курсируют машинки и вас довезут куда скажете. Лично мне было приятно прогуляться 5 минут до моря.
3. Сервис на высоком уровне. Есть русскоговорящий менеджер Виолетта (спасибо ей огромное!!), но и все остальные сотрудники искренне пытаются максимально помочь и сделать отдых незабываемым (я много путешествую, всегда выбираю высокую категорию отелей и с уверенностью это утверждаю). WiFi бесплатный, на неограниченное количество устройств, ловит на территории всего отеля, скорость отличная (качала фильмы спокойно).
4. Питание - вкусно, правда. Мне больше всего понравился габи клаб ресторан, там в основном и ем. Меню не огромное, но как минимум 2-3 вида рыбы, мяса всегда есть, при этом не приходится набирать полную тарелку, а потом из этого выбирать съедобное - вкусно все, серьезно (хотя я нереально привередлива). Наверное показательно, что в первый мой завтрак я увидела черную икру. Мидии, тунец, креветки и тд - есть всегда. Помимо этого в бесплатный сервис включена доставка в номер (заказывала лосось гриль, вкусно!). Бары отличные, коктейли делают вкусные.
5. пляж чистый (хотя с погодой в первые дни не повезло, были дожди и сильные волны), водорослей нет. Лежаки-кровати ну нереально удобные, места всегда есть. Бассейны тоже достойные.

В общем, можно много говорить, но я резюмирую "Это рай!". Еще не уехав из Доминиканы, уже планирую следующую поездку. А ведь после прошлогоднего посещения, совершенно не хотела возвращаться)

reviews.author: Jermaine G
reviews.title: Recent stay at Royal Service
reviews.text:
My most recent stay (December 2015) was my second consecutive year to visit Royal Service at Paradisus Palm Real Gold & Spa Resort.  The environment is completely relaxing and the service is remarkable.  My stay was 4 nights in an ocean front room (the same room I stayed in last year, as requested).  The room was not brand new, but was very well-maintained with large king bed, nice linens, bath robes/slippers and awesome beach/ocean views.  It also had all of the usual amenities one would expect to find in a nicer hotel/resort.  Room service was prompt and very friendly.  The Royal Service offers a Butler service that makes the experience seem even more luxurious.  Samuel (Sammy) attended to my every need, from making my dinner reservations each night to planning time on the resort's tennis courts with one of the tennis pros to reserving time in the beautiful Yhi Spa.  He would also leave various treats and surprises in my room that would await me after a relaxing day on the beach.  Even though this resort is very nice and ALL staff members are extremely accommodating, it was the butler service by Samuel that made me want to go back time and time again.  I hope they are ready to see me for a third consecutive December!!!!

I will comment also on my butler service from the previous year since I failed to write a review last year.  Joelvi (hope i spelled his name correctly) was just as amazing last year as Samuel was this year.  These gentlemen went beyond their level of training to make me feel as though I was their only priority, even though they had other guests and responsibilities. 

The thing I liked least was the presence of solicitors on the beach.  Although they were not allowed on the resort property, they would stand along the shoreline and wait for people to ask them to shop at the various beach shops where they worked.  At times, it was a bit too much.  

Overall, this is a resort that I would visit time and time again without hesitation.  I can't wait until next December!!!!!

reviews.author: Deanna M
reviews.title: Already planning to return!
reviews.text: I booked a four-day stay at the Paradisus Palma Real the first week in December and it was THE most peaceful and relaxing vacation I've ever had. PROS: 1) The resort is absolutely beautiful and the beach is gorgeous. 2) If you want to take your experience to the next level, you MUST book the Royal Service. My Royal Service concierge, Jose Salvador, took my experience from good to great! I work in a business where we consistently emphasize that great customer service is about anticipating customers' needs before they even think to ask, and Jose did just that throughout my entire stay. When I checked into the resort, as part of the Royal Service, I was provided with a phone to contact Jose whenever I needed assistance, and if I didn't call Jose, he checked in each day and made suggestions about services he could provide or activities I could participate in. I decided to use the jacuzzi tub one night, but unfortunately the drain didn't work. When I mentioned this to Jose, he not only had the drain fixed, but when I walked into my room that night, the jacuzzi bath was prepared complete with rose petals and candles! This is only one of many examples of Jose anticipating my needs and going above and beyond. GENERAL ADVICE: 1) I paid extra for the Garden View Suite, but in my opinion the extra money isn't worth the mediocre view. Unless you decide to book an Ocean View Suite, book a standard room and save some money. 2) The best rooms in the resort are the newly renovated family concierge rooms, but unfortunately, as a solo traveler I wasn't given the option to book this room. These rooms should be offered to everyone. CONS/ISSUES: 1) My room was clean; however, it had a consistenly damp, moldy smell -- a bit annoying but not a deal breaker. 2) I mistakenly thought that the ATM service fee was $195 U.S. dollars -- turns out the actual fee was 195 pesos -- silly mistake! I mentioned this exhorbitant fee to TWO different employees at the currency exchange desk, but not one person listened to me carefully enough to confirm that the fee was in pesos so I decided to forego several services because I didn't have enough cash for tips. This is a mistake that I can see other Americans making so it would make sense to train the currency exchange employees to be aware that this question/issue may come up. Fortunately, my conciege, Jose, saved the day by doing the research and letting me know that the fee was in pesos so I was at least able to get cash to pay for my taxi ride back to the airport. 3) Twice, I got the distinct impression that waiters at Naos and Blue Agave were annoyed when I sat in certain areas (I even got an eye roll). It finally dawned on me that they preferred to seat me at specific tables since I was a solo traveler, but to show irritation towards me was a real turnoff . OVERALL: The Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful resort that's perfect for fun-filled family vacations, romantic couple getaways, or low-key solo respites. I'll definitley be back next year.

reviews.author: Gabriel S
reviews.title: Nueva visita a "mi casa"
reviews.text: Hola a todos, regresé nuevamente a "mi casa" jaja. reviews.author: Rebecca P
reviews.title: Beyond Amazing Staff
reviews.text: I planned a week long vacation from Oct. 21-27, 2015.  I selected the Royal Service.  The staff were EXCELLENT.  Francisco Cabrera and Angel Frias were very attentive, always up beat and smiling.  I never had to ask for anything; they always had my bed or bungalow ready and waiting and I either had a fresh water or fresh drink in hand at all times.  It was a pleasure to be around two exceptionally professional, yet positive and happy gentlemen all day for a week.  My Butler, Nicolas Marcallo was also excellent.  He always had a smile and was always honest when I asked about things I didn't quite understand.  I'm big on integrity.  Nicolas had my dinner reservations made every night and baths drawn in the evening.  I felt very pampered and well taken care of.  I would definately recommend staying at this resort and getting the Royal Service.  I will definately be back.  Thank you to all the staff behind the scenes as well. reviews.author: Vania L
reviews.title: Best hotel around!

reviews.author: shayshay825
reviews.title: Great Property
reviews.text: So far, this property is the best location that I visited in DR (approx. 6). It has the upscale, modernized look and feel that I prefer to have when I'm spending my hard earned cash to travel. There's one buffet area which is the best I've ever seen for an all-inclusive property there are lots of options. Although, it one location it was never overcrowded and did not lack service. You have to make reservations for a la carte by 9am. The pool area lacks a lot of shade but there are several huts on the beach which is steps away from the pool. The gym, the beach and hotel are very clean.

reviews.author: Ncstevie
reviews.title: Almost Perfect
reviews.text:
I had a lovely 7 night stay in The Reserve. My room was spacious, clean and very comfortable. I really liked the modern/Asian type  decor. Checkin made me feel like a queen upon arriving. I was personally guided through the offerings of my all inclusive status as a guest in The Reserve, provided refreshments (which were much appreciated after a long journey and into scorching hot weather.)  my sister and her family were to be staying at the resort too but were delayed. My checking person, Rosemery, kindly offered to move me to the same building as my sister and her family, which I gladly accepted. 

My first buffet lunch I met Luis and was introduced to other wait staff who took great care of me by myself. They proceeded to greet me each time they saw me and made me feel right at home. 

My sisters concierge, Sophia, was amazing. Family concierge is the way to go if you want to be super pampered. Sophia took care of making all reservations, booking a snorkel trip, spa services, seeking us out each day to remind us of the entertainment at night, and even provided special treats for my sister and her kids: chocolate covered strawberries and/or wine in the room after returning from the pool, making up a Bubble bath with balloons for the kids, and bottles of bread crumbs as fish food for their snorkeling adventure. Any concerns or questions, Sophia was there to take care of it. But above and beyond that, the staff at the desk in our building lobby were always happy to help you if needed. 

Part of family concierge as being able to book a daily cabana by the beach or pool. We chose the beach the first day. Santos was our beach service contact who greeted us warmly and bright towels to our reserved cabana with luxurious beds, enough for each of us ( including me even though I wasn't family concierge level!). Santos was very attentive, kindly offering to bring drinks on a regular basis, which was great in the hot weather.   We found the ocean to have a LOT of seaweed, which we could see was trying to be managed, but it was still an issue for most of us except those who were happy boogie boarding (with boards we borrowed from the recreation center after paying a deposit). 

We ended up booking a cabana by the pool the rest of the week, as we discovered beach cabanas were easier to come by. Again, the cabanas were super comfortable and the wait staff were phenomenal. Anthony offered great entertainment and service and the poolside wait staff was amazing!

reviews.author: brooklyn626
reviews.title: Royal Service is an Oasis in Paradisus
reviews.text:
I visited the Paradisus Palma Real Resort for 5 nights over the Fourth of July holiday.  I traveled solo as I was exhausted and looking forward to a few days of rest and relaxation.  I booked my trip through American Express, which placed me in a room in the main hotel.  However,  after reading the reviews on TripAdvisor, I contacted the hotel and upgraded to Royal Service Adults Only.  It was the best decision I could have made and worth the extra money.  

From the moment you arrive, Royal Service elevates the vacation experience.  I was ushered into a sleek, air-conditioned lounge, served a cold cocktail and finger foods while a Paradisus representative checked me in.  She explained the many amenities available to Royal Service guests, including a personal butler, children-free pool and beach area and Palazzo, an intimate Italian Restaurant reserved exclusively for Royal Service.   The child-free zones were critical to me as a solo traveler looking for quiet and solitude.  Right after check-in, I was introduced to my personal butler, Juan De Leon.  Personalized butler services include dinner reservations, reserved Bali Beds on the beach, jacuzzi bath preparation and even ironing (I never used the ironing service).  

I cannot praise Juan De Leon enough!!  He made my stay at the Paradisus wonderful!  Juan is an old-world gentleman who takes great pride in his work.  When I checked-in, Juan gave me a cell phone to contact him whenever I need or wanted something.  I only called him to make dinner reservations.  However, when I didn't call him, Juan looked for me when he arrived at the resort every day.  He usually found me on the beach, relaxing on my reserved Bali Bed.  He asked about my evening, whether I had everything I needed, and what he could do to make my stay better.  Without request from me, one evening he had chocolates delivered to my room, a cheese plate another evening, scented lavender pillows and had a bath drawn for me.  I felt pampered beyond expectation.  I was so relaxed that I slept 12 hours a night, exactly what I needed to relieve my burn-out.  Juan was the consummate professional - attentive without being intrusive, informed, charming and unflappable.  He made my stay a memorable one.

Juan made nightly dinner reservations for me at the resort's numerous restaurants.  The resort offers many dining options such as a steakhouse called Rare, a Mexican place called Blue Agave and an Asian Fusion place called Bana.  All seemed lovely but were too large, busy and overwhelming for the solo diner.  I explored them all but each evening I retreated to Palazzo, the quiet Italian restaurant reserved for Royal Service guests.  The food was excellent and the service impeccable.  I dined there just about every night of my stay.  Felix Garcia was my waiter just about every night, including my first night at Paradisus when I was so exhausted I fell asleep while eating dessert!  Felix is the kind of first-rate, professional waiter one encounters in New York City's finest restaurants.  Alexander Guzman waited on me at breakfast and the one dinner when I wasn't seated in Felix's area.  He was attentive, engaging and professional.  The entire staff at Palazzo - the hostesses, bartenders, and wait staff are wonderful.  

Finally, I would say that as much as I enjoyed my stay at the Paradisus, I do not recommend it for solo travelers.  If you travel here solo, you must do Royal Service, as the main section of the resort - while stunningly beautiful and the site of three destination weddings during my stay - caters to families and couples.  I felt overwhelmed by the scale of the place each time I ventured out of the intimate Royal Service section.  The place is the first choice of couples and families.  I did not meet any other solo travelers during my stay there.

The resort also has a separate section called The Reserve, which caters to more upscale families.  Royal Service guests also have access to private pool and beach reserved for guests of The Reserve.  I spent a quiet, wonderful day there.  However, the mostly male staff there fixated on my solo status, repeatedly asking why I didn't have a family. I was left with the impression that they never encountered a woman traveling on her own.

Overall, I enjoyed my stay at the Paradisus; it served my goal of a restful, relaxing vacation.  I was well taken care of by Juan De Leon, Felix Garcia and Alexander Guzman.  However, in the future, I would choose a more solo-friendly destination.

reviews.title: Club Melia at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana-outstanding Resort!!:)
reviews.text: I just got back from this Resort and had an absolutely amazing time.  There were a few not so perfect things, like an occasional foul smell in my room that occurred twice.  Smelled almost of feces.  It seem to come out of the blue and eventually went away but I never did figure out where the smell originated from.  Also, the mosquitos were the worst.  I eventually figured out what to do, purchased mosquito repellent spray just for the room and mosquito repellent spray that went directly on my body.  That finally did the trick and I stopped getting eaten alive.  What seems to cause this issue is the Maids leaving the door wide open when they clean your room.  Also the back and forth with Management, prior to getting there, was a pain.  There were a million and one emails back and forth between me and Management with just trying to get my check in sorted out.  It was tiresome and cumbersome.  Also the WiFi was extremely spotty, they didn't have SAP for Cable so English speaking channels were limited which was annoying, to me personally, and no free calls to the US or Canada like my Hard Rock and Palace Memberships.  There were a few other minor issues but overall this is a beautiful Resort and I loved it.  I look forward to going to another Club Melia Resort and the next time I go I will purchase a Trial Membership as that is the only Membership they have with no maintenance fees.

reviews.title: Great trip- especially for solo traveler
reviews.text:
This was my second solo trip to the Royal section of the Paradisus Palma Real.  What a wonderful, relaxing trip- an easy trip to do for a solo traveler. The resort is beautiful, staff wonderful, good liquor selection and food is quite good too (amazing lobster at fuego). I’m sure I’ll be back again.  

I wanted to especially thank a few of the staff at the resort.  My pool concierge, Francisco was so very helpful and thoughtful making sure I had water or a cocktail made by talented Crème de la Crème (who makes the best margaritas!).   I was always warmly welcomed by the hostess at the Palazzo (I’m sorry I can’t recall her name, lovely young woman).  Miguel Jimenez at the Palazzo- the perfect waiter. He’s charming, funny, polite, very attentive but not intrusive- I can see him going far in the business.  My butler, Omar made sure I had everything I needed. He is a true gentleman. He is so very kind, interesting and intelligent. I would definitely request him again the next time I go.  Thanks to everyone at the resort!

reviews.author: Kristie M
reviews.title: The most relaxing place to be!
reviews.text:
My husband and I took this trip to celebrate our 10th anniversary. A few of my husband's co-workers have been and had suggested we looked in to it - we couldn't have been happier. We arrived on Sunday and were immediately taken in to the private Royal Service lounge.  We were met by a hostess that provided us with drinks and then  showed us how to hook in to wifi and use our butler phone. We then met our Butler Evian - he was great. He took us on a tour of the property and then brought us to our suite. The rooms are beautiful - a beautiful suite with canopy bed, sitting area and patio overlooking the beautiful gardens. The bathroom had a huge jacuzzi tub and stand-up stall shower. the only complaint about the bathroom was it is totally open, so you have no privacy when using the toilet! Each night they offered turn down service and sprayed our pillows with lavender, it was heavenly!
The resort its self was clean and the ocean was breath-taking. The weather could not have been any more perfect! We would start each day with breakfast and then hit the gym. The gym was staffed and had quite a bit of equipment. It even smelled like a spa!!. After our workout we would head to the pool and sit and relax for the entire day. There was always some sort of water aerobics, pool party or drinking to be done. We also took some nice walks on the beach to see what the other properties looked like. There is a lot of water sports to try and some shops down the beach that you can barter on goods (never fall for their high prices, always get them down :) !!)
Each evening our butler set up reservations at the restaurants for us.  We never had a bad meal. Our favorites were Fuego and Rare, the steakhouse. We had excellent service and meals at both. Evenings brought more entertainment and drinking. Lots of places to just sit back and relax and enjoy your company. We would typically sit at Gabi Beach and enjoy the giant beds to relax and take in the view.
Our last evening was quite special - our butler, Evian, set up our jacuzzi with flower petals and got us a cake to celebrate our anniversary. It was a nice final touch. 
The one tip we can give everyone, make sure you bring plenty of sunscreen.  You will need it and if you run out, the cheapest bottle on the resort and surrounding shops was $28!!

Einen kurzen Bericht zu den Überbuchungen bei meiner Ankunft hatte ich ja schon gemacht.  So erging es nicht wenigen  Gästen genau so. Nichts desto trotz wurden wir auf andere Anlagen umgebucht. Mit etwas Glück bekamen sie ein Zimmer in einer vergleichbaren Anlage ,bzw. Kategorie. In meinem Falle hatte dies leider nicht zugetroffen und ich landete in einem dunklen Standard Zimmer in der Nebenanlage welche auch zur Melia Gruppe gehört. Nach der ersten unglücklichen Woche in einer Anlage die ich von früher kannte und selbst nie gebucht hätte sollte es die zweite Woche nicht viel besser werden
Derzeit gibt es eine Baustelle im Bereich Strandabschnitt oberhalb der Restaurants Market Grill und Buffet Naos gibt. Dort entsteht  ein neuer  Zimmer / Wohntrakt und gelegentlich ist mit Lärm zu rechnen.( Photos siehe anbei )
 
Wie gesagt meine Bewertung für Service mangelhaft / unbefriedigend bezieht sich auf Gästeservice allgemein.  Als ich endlich nach einer Woche vom Hotel Melia Caribe, wo ich als Ersatz für meine One Bedroom Mastersuite ein abgewohntes Standardzimmer bekommen habe ins Hotel Paradisus Palma Real wechseln durfte, hatte ich bei Hr, Douglas Jonathan(Frontoffice) angefragt ob ich gegen Aufzahlung natürlich ins Royal Service wechseln könnte. Immerhin hatte ich schon ein Woche von meinem Urlaub verloren und in einem Zimmer verbracht welches absolut nicht meinem original gebuchten dem Standard entsprach.

Nach einer kurzen Absprache mit Front Office Manager Adriana Guzmann wurde mir mitgeteilt dass das Royal Service ausgebucht ist und keinerlei Zimmer zur Verfügung stehen. Dies hatte ich akzeptiert und auf meine Anfrage ob  ich gegen Aufzahlung zumindest nur den Royal Service Pool und Strand benützen darf habe ich von Hr. Douglas Jonathan nie eine Antwort erhalten, obwohl er gesagt hat er wird mich sofort verständigen sowie er seinen Supervisor kontaktiert hat. ( so kann man sich natürlich auch Umsatz entgehen lassen)                                                                                                 Ich wollte die zweite Woche einfach nur etwas mehr Ruhe genießen, um die erste Woche in der ich ins Melia Caribe umgebucht worden bin schnell zu vergessen.

Nichts desto trotz meine One Bedroom Mastersuite mit Gartenblick war absolut top und immer sehr sauber gehalten. Wobei ich beim Gartenblick bemerken muss - Gartenblick kann verschiedenes heißen.In meinem Falle haben die Palmwedel meinen kompletten Balkon verdeckt und somit wurde das Zimmer sehr dunkel und na ja Gartenblick waren halt die Palmwedel.(siehe Photos )                                                                                                                                                                   Die Palmwedel sollte man trimmen- somit gäbe es wieder mehr Licht in den Zimmern und einen besseren Ausblick.

Ein anderes Anliegen - wiederum Gäste Service: Eines abends bin ich um Mitternacht aufgewacht da ich auf die Toilette musste, ich machte einen Schritt aus meinem Bett und lag schon flach auf dem Boden. Der Grund dafür - die gesamte Suite stand unter Wasser und wenn ich sage die gesamt Suite dann meine ich wirklich vom Wohnzimmer bis ins Schlafzimmer.
Das kann schon mal passieren und da kann auch das Hotel nichts dafür.Ich hatte die Rezeption angerufen und erklärt  dass die komplette Suite unter Wasser steht. Nach 40 Minuten kam endlich ein Techniker und  als er die Wassermengen sah hatte  er sofort Kontakt mit der Rezeption aufgenommen. Mir wurde mitgeteilt dass ich das Zimmer wechseln muss und sofort jemand von der Rezeption vorbeikommen wird. Also habe ich mittlerweile meine Koffer das dritte mal gepackt und wartete bis ein Bell Boy kam um mir meine neue Zimmernummer mitzuteilen und mit meinem  Gepäck behilflich zu sein. Nach einer Stunde war leider immer noch niemand hier und ich ging selber an die Rezeption um mich nach meiner neuen Zimmer Nummer zu erkundigen.(absolut kein   5 * Service)                                                                                                                                                                               An der Rezeption wurde mir mitgeteilt dass schon längst jemand bei mir sein hätte sollen.(das übliche Vertrösten und nach Entschuldigungen suchen). Nichts desto trotz bekam ich dann endlich ein neues Zimmer . Die Freude trügte , als ich im Badezimmer Licht machte sah ich sofort dass das Zimmer noch nicht einmal ganz fertig gemacht war und im Kühlschrank außer ein paar Wasserflaschen und Bierdosen die außerhalb gekauft wurden, noch von meinen Vorgängern sein mussten. ( siehe Photos )                                                                                                   Nach einem kurzen Anruf an der Rezeption hieß es wieder warten bis ein neues Zimmer lokalisiert werden konnte. Endlich ein neues  Zimmer gefunden, wurde mir mitgeteilt dass dies ein Zimmer in absoluter Ruhelage ist, was ich mir gleich dachte da es in einem der letzten Blöcke lag. ;)                                                        

Dies war dann kurz nach 3.00 Uhr früh und ich durfte meine Koffer endlich wieder auspacken und meine Bettruhe genießen.                                                                                                                                         Dass vor dem Balkon die Durchzugsstraße vom nebenstehenden Hotel ist ( Lkw Lärm- Personal Lärm; ect ), hatte ich gleich in der früh herausgefunden, deshalb waren die Zimmer neben mir oder der gesamte Block mehr oder weniger auf dieser Seite die ganze Woche so gut wie leer.

Ich versucht ein Gespräch mit General Manager Hr. Conrad Bergwerf führen zu dürfen. Hier wurde mir von Hr. Douglas Jonathan  mitgeteilt, dass ein Termin vereinbart werden muss, und  somit hatte ich um einen Termin mit Hr. Bergwerf gebeten. Da ich ja im Urlaub war und keinerlei Zeitzwang hatte, würde ich mich natürlich dem Zeitraster anpassen. Es nur ein Gespräch unter Berufs Kollegen sein. Leider kam auch hier nie eine Rückmeldung trotz nochmaliger Nachfrage vom Frontoffice zurück. 

Die Krönung meines Aufenthaltes aber war dann eines abends als ich Roomservice bestellt hatte.Ich wollte nicht im Restaurant essen und hab mich entschieden im Zimmer mein Abendessen zu nehmen, was ich auch schon mal Tage zuvor tat. Als ich den Roomservice bestellt  hatte und eine Flasche Weißwein dazu haben wollte , der natürlich extra bezahlt werden muss (immerhin eine Flasche Pouilly Fume USD 95.-), wurde mir dies verweigert  bzw. gesagt ich muss diese auf dem Zimmer bar bezahlen. Auf meine Frage warum die Weine die anderen Tage auf die Zimmerrechnung geschrieben wurden , was ja eigentlich normal ist konnte ich keine konkrete Antwort erhalten.
Übrigens die Weinkarte für den Roomservice  ist sehr gut- keine große Auswahl – aber die Weine welche angeboten werden sind absolut top.
Also wiederum die Rezeption kontaktiert , da ich einfach wissen wollte was der genaue Ablauf ist , bzw. eine Antwort haben wollte wieso die Tage zuvor die Weine auf die Zimmerrechnung geschrieben worden sind, wurde mir mitgeteilt, bzw. wurde ich wieder wie schon einige male zuvor vertröstet , dass sich gleich jemand darum kümmern  würde. Leider war auch in diesem Falle nie eine Rückmeldung gekommen und so habe ich mich entschlossen mein Abendessen in einem der Restaurants einzunehmen.
Komischerweise wurde mir am nächsten Tages eine Flasche Champagner angeboten ( welche ich dankend ablehnte)

Ich könnte noch einige  Vorfälle oder Angaben zum Hotel erwähnen die für mich dann teils obwohl negativ , eigentlich schon lustig wurden, werde aber davon Abstand halten.
Ich finde es sehr schade da das Hotel in diverser Media für den „ einzigartigen Gästeservice „ so groß Werbung macht und dies meines Erachtens absolut nicht zutreffend ist. 
Unter anderem auch in dem Wilkommensbrief  auf dem noch der Vorgänger von Hr. Bergwerf angegeben ist.
Paradisus Palma Real …………..to pamper and create an experience you will remember forever. Our main commitment is hat your Paradisus experience touches all your senses. Our staff will accomodate all your needs. Thank you for giving us the privilege of hosting your vacation.
Nichts desto trotz versuchte ich die restlichen Tage der Woche noch so gut wie nur möglich zu genießen.
Kurzerhand habe ich mich an dem Tag meines Check outs entschlossen meinen Flug umzubuchen und noch eine Woche in Punta Cana zu verlängern, nachdem mir ja die erste Woche wegen der Über/Umbuchung in ein Hotel was ich von früher kannte und nie gebucht hätte, entgangen ist und leider auch in meiner zweiten Woche zu viel negative Dinge in dem Hotel wo Service so groß geschrieben wird erlebt hatte.
Mag sein wenn sie den Royal Service buchen, was ich versucht hatte aber leider nicht gelungen ist, dass dann der Service etwas besser ist. Dazu kann ich leider keine Angaben machen.                             Definitiv stimmt dass der erste Blick von den Angestellten immer auf das Armband fällt und dies scheint den großen Unterschied bezüglich Service zu machen.
Fazit  Ich würde dieses Hotel keinem meiner Freunde oder sonst jemanden positive empfehlen. 
In meinem Falle leider alles andere als zufriedenstellend , deshalb die negative Bewertung und die Überlegung ein Schreiben an den CEO der Gruppe weiterzuleiten.

reviews.title: Great time

I would like to thank a Big Macdonna everybody involed with what the resort has to offer.  Also i would like  to thank Antonio the swim up bartender he was amazing and showed you a good time.

reviews.author: Tyson Y
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: Really great resort. Very friendly people. Best experience is the Avenue bar. Great employees. Drayi, Juan, Edy and Lucia really made everything so fun. Four great personalities. Worth going to the resort just for them let alone all the other great experiences we had. Big thumbs up to the staff.

reviews.author: Wayne M
reviews.title: For the ultimate in relaxation and peace of mind...
reviews.text: Upon my arrival at the Paradisus Reserve, I was greeted with an awesome Mimosa and warm genuine smiles by all of the staff present on the morning/early afternoon of November 9th of this year(2014)... The brown skin young lady that got me checked in was very very kind, helpful and hands on in making sure that I did get situated smoothly and quickly... My room was fabulous and the Chefs that were out by the pool area cooking were on point and very accommodating to my request...   BUT!!!!!   The BEST experience came at the HANDS-Pun intended- of Roselina Del Rosario... SHE GAVE ME THE BEST MASSAGE EVER!!!!! If I could have packed her and brought her back to the states she would be here RIGHT NOW!!!! She was very professional and pleasant and a efinite asset to your establishment...

reviews.author: Jeffery H
reviews.title: Heaven on earth!!!
reviews.text: I just got back from this Beautiful resort. All of the staff and service are top notch!! I had two butlers while I was there because I was there so long and they're days off were different. They were Samuel and Johnfi. They really go all out and give great customer service. Also want to give a shout out to Pedro and Leonardo at the royal service bar. They go all out to satisfy!! Just about everyone I met remembered and called me by my first name "Rico" which I really liked. The food was outstanding in the restaurants and I really love the steak and lobster at the Gabi and Market grill restaurants. Room service was very fast and prompt and I also really liked the wake up service with the follow up wake up call.The entertainment staff was fun and kept the activities going. Especially Reynaldo (love that guy)! The YHI spa water treatment is a must try experience and included. I would also like to thank Omar in the business center for all his help and courtesy. The casino is small but I won at the Blackjack tables every night. You get more value for your money if you gamble with Dominican money instead of US money at the tables I found out. Overall, it was a great trip and I met a lot of new friends both staff and guests. I will definitely be back next year!!

reviews.author: AlineRiodeJaneiro
reviews.title: It's Paradise!
reviews.text:
I've just spent 6 days in this amazing resort. Took the Royal Service and was amazed with the level of service provided. My butler was Faustino Ramos and he was extremely efficient and discrete. He arranged restaurant reservations, prepared my bath and brought me a fresh fruit plate every night. He was always available, without being intrusive.
Food was amazing at the Pallazzo exclusive restaurant. Miguel Jimenez was an outstanding waiter who knew exactly what I was going to order and took excellent care of my needs. 
The guys at the beach were also incredible and extremely kind. I never heard a "no" at this place: anything you could ask for, they would make a way for you to have it "con mucho gusto".The grounds are very, very beautiful, the rooms are classic, but some renovation would go well. The only point for improvement I could see was some inconsistency in house keeping- although rooms were extremely clean, on my last day I had to call the room service as my room hasn't been cleaned yet ( it was 4pm). I also had my room prepared in 3 out of 6 nights, but no big issue.
 It's simply the perfect place to relax and enjoy a great vacation.
