reviews.text:
Excellent Location, Excellent Resort in a Luxurious Tropical Garden !! This hotel is an adults only Paradise. Most of the staff is extremely friendly & helpful.
I would highly recommend this resort as a couple's Paradies, not really a hot spot for singles.

reviews.text:
Una de las mejores experiencias vacacionales, si bien es cierto que las playas de República Dominicana son sin duda una de las más bellas del caribe, tener las mejores instalaciones y la mejor atención hacen el mejor conjunto para disfrutar unas vacaciones al máximo.

Es un complejo de gran tamaño donde al entrar tienes todo a primera mano, un área de compras, una variedad gastronómica fabulosa entre todos sus restaurantes... el red lounge está bien para las noches de fiesta sin necesidad de salir del resort (que no hay muchos sitios donde salir) y por supuesto el Gabi Beach Club también ideal por el beat de música que maneja.

La cena de Passion, el restaurante del Chef Martín Berasategui es una delicia, cocina Vasca de Autor con excelentes sugerencias del somelier para maridar.

Qué decir del entretenimiento... no hay forma de aburrirse, tienen un equipo de actividades muy grande que desde primer hora hasta al final del día te mantienen ocupado entre juegos, concursos, clases y demás... el spinning en agua es una maravilla  pero debes reservar tu participación por que el acceso es limitado.

El Gimnasio es pequeño pero muy completo y bien ubicado por lo que puedes hacer una pequeña rutina antes o al finalizar tus actividades... 

Lo mejor, tienen unos shows, de miedo, el STOMP y el REY LEON valen mucho la pena...

Sin duda, excelente lugar para vacacionar

reviews.author: stanvard
reviews.title: Terrific Property - Not quite luxury, but almost
reviews.text:
I just got back from 5 nights at Paradisus Palma Real.  I needed a getaway to a beautiful, high-end resort where it was warm and I could just relax, and I got exactly what I was looking for.

If you are a true luxury traveler, a big all-inclusive isn't going to do it for you.  A huge resort just can't feel exclusive and completely, even if areas of it are devoted to being such (which this one had).  For some reason, I hadn't processed that before I arrived.  But once I accepted that fact (and hearing/reading about many of the other resorts in Punta Cana), I realized that the Paradisus is probably the best place to stay in Punta Cana, its staff does a great job at creating as luxurious an environment as possible, and I had a really great time.

In order to be helpful to future travelers, I'll focus my review on a few specifics:

1.  The Reserve vs. Paradisus Royal Service
2.  Royal Service vs. No Royal Service
3.  A few good things
4.  The resort's challenges to expect
5.  Things the resort can improve on

1.  The Reserve vs. Paradisus Royal Service

I was originally booked to stay at The Reserve, the newer, fancier, smaller, and more exclusive property of the Palma Real situated behind the main hotel (away from the beach).  I was really looking forward to my swim-up room, an outdoor jacuzzi, private garden, and private Bali Bed (The Reserve comes with full access to everything at the main resort).  When I arrived, I was told that they had a room at the main resort in the Royal Service section, which is the adults-only luxury section of the main resort - right on the beach, with a butler - that they could upgrade me to for free.  I wasn't sure what to do, as I had been really looking forward to the room at the Reserve, but they convinced me to go to Royal Service as my room was right on the beach with a balcony overlooking the beach.  

It was a tradeoff that I think was ultimately worth it.  When I booked, I didn't mind that the Reserve was 1/2 mile from the beach, but it ended up being a huge plus to be right there, since I enjoy sitting by a beach more than sitting by a pool, and the Royal Service comes with butler service (including a cell phone to contact him), which is not offered for folks without kids at the Reserve.  My butler (Yohel) was great, made all of my on-property restaurant reservations for me, and helped me out with anything I needed.  Royal Service also comes with its own large section of the beach with lots of big cushioned lounge chairs as well as bali-beds on a beautiful stretch of beach where you are not disturbed by folks trying to sell you things.  My room was also lovely and spacious and again - right on the beach.

What I did give up was what I think would have been a nicer room experience at The Reserve and a more exclusive feel, as well as a much more tranquil atmosphere overall.  The private pool for Royal Service guests was the size of a postage stamp and always crowded, whereas the pools at The Reserve and even the main pool at the resort felt fairly empty and peaceful.  If you want to spend the day sitting by the pool (or in your own private garden!), choose The Reserve.  If you have a family, choose The Reserve (lots of kids activities).  If you are looking for privacy, choose The Reserve.  If you prefer to be on the beach, choose Royal Service to be close to the beach and go to The Reserve whenever you want quiet pools.

2.  Royal Service vs. No Royal Service

If you can swing the added cost (or you are offered a free upgrade like I was ;) and you are not with kids, Royal Service is the way to go.  You have access to 4 restaurants on the property that the main resort guests do not have (for free), and priority booking at all of the restaurants (and these restaurants are MUCH better than the rest).  You have an exclusive beach area with lots of staff and great lounging options.  You have a great indoor lounge, very close to your room with internet access and food & drink throughout the day.  You have a butler devoted to you to help you with anything you need.  I never thought I would want that, but it came in handy and made my stay easier.  All that being said, the rest of the resort is beautiful as well, the main pool is huge, and there are plenty of great seats on the main beach.

3.  A few good things

- The service was really excellent, even outside of a great butler.  Sure there was a glitch here and there, but there were tons of staff and everyone was extremely professional and tried very hard to accommodate and help you relax.  I have heard it's the best service in Punta Cana, and I don't doubt that.
- The food was really quite good in the exclusive restaurants (and all of The Reserve restaurants), and they also have 24-hour room service.
- The property is really beautiful - well-landscaped and well kept.
- The beach is really beautiful - lots of white sand that they manicure every morning, with amazing beach chairs/bali beds and great staffing.
- Really easy/fast to get from The Reserve to the main resort.

4.  The resort's challenges to expect

- There is The Reserve, Royal Service, Melia Subscribers, Family Concierge, and other distinctions which have different privileges, areas, and benefits.  It all gets a little confusing.  Some of the amenities are at the main resort, while others (like exercise classes) are at The Reserve.  There is a huge book of options/services in the room It can feel like too much thinking (vacation-thinking that is!) to parse out everything.  But I guess that's just the way they cater to the broadest clientele they can.  Just know that it feels like a big resort, even if you stay to just your 'exclusive' area - for good or for bad.
- The food at the non-exclusive restaurants really isn't as good as the food at the exclusive restaurants.
- Many of the resort's restaurants require long pants and closed shoes for men for dinner.  I didn't know this ahead of time and brought one pair of each, but found it irritating to have to put them on every night.  I don't think it would detract from the atmosphere to have men wear a nice polo and shorts and sandals.  Who cares?  Get dressed up only if you want to.
- While the beach is gorgeous, the water is not great.  It's not the resort's fault at all.  But there is really tons of seaweed which you have to walk over and swim with.  I spent a lot less time in the ocean than I expected to.  But I guess that's Bavaro Beach.  And it's not crystal clear like Turks & Caicos - really because of the seaweed.
-  While the service is great, it is very in-your-face.  I have found that service at really top-notch places is largely invisible and more subtle.  But I think that's The Melia's (company who owns the resort) style and I am confident all of the employees were fulfilling their expectations very well.

5.  Things the resort can improve on

These are good to know (and did not ruin my trip at all), and things I think management can improve on to make this an even better experience in the future:
- The main buffet is really sub-par.  Anyone used to buffets at resorts or cruises will be disappointed (so I'm told).
- The reservation system is weird.  It was easy for me, because my butler set everything up via Royal Service, but I heard a lot of griping, since folks sometimes could not get reservations or we were told we had to make them, and the restaurants were often fairly empty.
- Neither the Spa at the main resort nor the Royal Service reception had a spa menu from the Reserve (bigger spa) with prices.  So I had to go all the way to The Reserve to look at prices and book (or I could have called, but still - silly).
- The spa treatments were so-so and indistinguishable from one another.
- The Yoga class I took was laughable.  It did not resemble Yoga in any way.  It was a combination of vogueing, sleeping, and stretching.  I left after 25 mins.  Anyone expecting real Yoga should stay away.
- Keys get demagnetized easily/often.  Pain to keep going back to get them re-magnetized.

Those are some details I hope will be helpful to future vacationers/management.  On the whole, I really had a terrific time.  I am not sure I would go back to Punta Cana because of the so-so ocean and not great access to great excursions, but as a stand-alone resort/beach, it was pretty terrific and just what the doctor ordered.

reviews.author: DocGirl6
reviews.title: Perfect Solo Trip
reviews.text: Decided to take my 1st solo trip and chose Punta Cuna.  After reviewing several properties, I selected Paradisus Palma Real.  I definitely was not disappointed! I arrived to a beautiful view of the ocean and the moment I stepped on to the property, I was transported into Paradise. I decided on a Royal Service (adults only) ocean view room. It was exactly what I wanted.  My check-in went smoothly and was greeted by my butler, Juan de Leon.  I was in good hands. I decided to have a massage on the beach on the afternoon of my arrival---best choice---nothing like relaxing to the sounds of the ocean and the feel of a cool breeze after a stress-filled summer.  I enjoyed drinks near the pool (served by Leonardo) and juices on the beach served by Jorge.  The beach was amazing and the attendants (Martin and Francisco) were very accommodating.  I decided to have meals in the Palazzo, Market Grill, and Gabi Beach.  Juan was able to arrange for me to have some Dominican food one night---perfect!

reviews.author: Alina S
reviews.title: First time in traveling alone
reviews.text: It was my 1st time vacationing solo but never once felt alone. Astrid Mercedes and Natalia made check in/out and everything in between so easy in the Royal Service VIP lounge. My butler, Jeuri  Ferreira, seemed to always find me to inform me of the day's reservations or to make sure that my every request was met. He was sweet, attentive and knowing he was around made me feel safe and looked after. Pedro, the beach concierge, always had my palapa ready, kept the drinks flowing and always had a story to tell. The WIFI in the room was not always working but that was a sign to unplug and relax which i was able to do so easily. Overall, the staff is what made my vacation so exceptional, everyone is happy and friendly and that is what would make me return to Paradisus Palma Real. (food was good too!)

reviews.author: SusanMTtoronto
reviews.title: Wow factor form the moment you arrive
reviews.text:
Accommodations were spectacular.  Hotel staff were courteous and helpful.  Room always spotless

The setting is spectacular - I was a bit hesitant about Dominican Republic overall but was very impressed.  IF you are going to go this would be the place to go - no need to leave the property. Beaches and pools had lots of options to be either where the action is, or to have some peace, quiet and privacy.

reviews.author: Melanie R
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: I have just returned from my vacation at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana which totally exceeded my expectations.  Anabel Gonzalez, Yeuri Beltre, and Ada Morla along with the excellent waiters, housekeepers, waitresses, and others made my stay unforgettable.  I came solo and everyone did their best to take care of me.  They were very warm and attentive and made me feel very comfortable.  The food was great.  The grounds are amazing, the rooms were contemporary and spacious, the beach was breathtaking.  There is so much to do & discover at this resort.  I am looking forward to going back in the near future.  This resort is highly recommended.

reviews.author: cruehd
reviews.title: Very Nice Property
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at The Reserve and had a wonderful time.  This review is going to be long but well worth it.  After reading, you will have a full detail of the property and what it has to offer. So here goes...Just for a side note, I was a solo traveler.  The first thing you must do after checking in, is to see your concierge and book ALL your dinner reservations. They fill up quick.  For those into the water activities, it means dragging your butt to the beach area.  They have a separate section to reserve various activities (scuba/snorkeling/kayak/etc).  It's a small sacrafice of 2-3 hours for the first day only.  Then after that, there are no worries  =)

The staff is wonderful.  Very friendly and courteous in all aspects.  Many speak English and those who don't, call their co workers over to help.  The waiters/waitress/bartenders are all attentive to accommodate your needs even if you have special needs or requests.  

The room...I stayed in a one bedroom master suite.  very spacious, comfortable bed (king size), nice living room/kitchen.  The shower had multiple jet streams so you can choose which option you prefer.  there were 3 different sinks to wash up.  The patio was great.  Two lounge chairs to sit and relax and even have a smoke if you’re a smoker.  The gentleman who restocked my minibar was great.  it was filled every day with a variety of soft drinks.  My room was cleaned by 5pm everyday and restocked with towels.  The air conditioning blasted so cold I actually had to shut it off at times. The only negative part to this was the Jacuzzi.  It took close to an hour to fill up and the jets were not powerful.  A bit of a letdown for me seeing I enjoy sitting in hot tubs.

The food/restaurants.....let me start off by saying EVERYONE has different taste buds/pallets, so you need to keep an open mind when eating in the Caribbean. They have 6 different specialty restaurants and after eating at all of them, I was never dissatisfied.   Some of the sauces are different than here at home (BBQ/Marinara, etc) and they can tend to be heavy handed with the salt, but all you have to do is request it to be lightly salted or light on the sauce.
The Reserve also has 3 different buffet halls.  One by the main reception (  ) which is plain and basic.  The other two (Gabi Beach & NAOS) are located on the other end of the resort which offer more choices and a variety of ethnic foods.  This can be burdensome to get to, but if you’re willing to be patient to get there, it’s well worth it.

The Beach/Pool.....In my opinion, the pool was better than the beach....It wasn't as crowded and the cabanas and huts were an added bonus.  These are all free, but it is first come, first serve. Some of the huts are reserved for families that pay for the family plan, but still plenty to go around.  The beach was a bit unpleasant to me.  When I was there, A storm must have hit which brought in seaweed.  It was everywhere; along the shore and even in the water.  However, the water temperature was nice.  Waiters come around both areas taking drink orders.  The pool even has a swim up bar area.  Obviously, the beach doesn't.

The Resort....This property is humongous.  It's actually two resorts combined into one.  There are a variety of activities/night life/restaurants scattered throughout the place.  In order to get where you want to go, you either have to walk or wait for the TRAM (golf carts) to transport you. This is definitely an inconvenience, but it's a good way to walk off all the food you eat...lol
The resort is also maintained beautifully.  The workers are out there everyday taking care of the grounds.

Nightlife/Activities...There are a variety of shows for both kids and adults.  Check the weekly bulletin.  

Some details may have been forgotten, but if you need additional info, feel free to ask.

**IMPORTANT NOTE**
I understand that it is an ALL INCLUSIVE place and it is expensive to stay here. However, some of the workers go above and beyond and I feel you should tip them a few bucks.  Coming from a person in the service industry, when someone brings you a drink/meal whether you're sitting at a buffet table or lounging in a chair, giving them a buck or two is a nice gesture.  Especially when asking for extras or special accomodations.

reviews.author: KathleenFras
reviews.title: Wonderful experience!
reviews.text: I enjoyed relaxing in the shade by the ocean by day and the wonderful eateries they had to offer for dinner.  I enjoyed a waiter by the name of Nestor at the Grill.  His personality helped sell the place.  In fact all the employees were friendly!  I highly reccomend this resort!

reviews.author: Kimberly S
reviews.title: Beautiful property!
reviews.text: I love this resort! It is so clean and well kept - I have never been to a place where all of the restrooms are clean all of the time!!  The bartenders Leonardo and Jorge (fresh fruit) were always on top of their game! Richard Ortiz at the Palazzo was so attentive and courteous everyday. It was a pleasure to see all of these people as they always had a smile ready for you! Little Angel from activities is a joy - from the aqua spinning to dancing at night during the shows! Chef Alexis at Vento outdid himself with a meal that was out of this world!! OMG it was orgasmic! LOL Royal service is the way to go here and Elvis is extraordinary! Will definitely return.

reviews.author: WakeChmp
reviews.title: Frequent Travel with complete review (Royal Service)
reviews.text:
For starters, I can understand why an average or less than frequent traveler would rate this property 5 stars.  It is very nice and I will comment on some of my experiences.  I rate this resort 4, based on an extensive amount of travel experience I have.  I don't typically stay at all inclusive resorts, but a majority of the hotels in Punta Cana are all inclusive.  
Secondly, the reviewers who comment this resort is "perfect" or that it's the best resort in the caribbean are mistaken.  Also, the reviewers that comment on how nice there weather was when they were does not help you in your travel decision.  Instead of writing a novel, I am going to make this as short and sweet as I can.  

I stayed May 2014 in a partial ocean view room, Royal Service package.

The Positives:
1- The resort grounds and lobby are absolutely amazing.  I haven't seen a hotel in Punta Cana that can compare.  Open air lobby lobby with perfect views of the pool and ocean.  
2- The pool and beach area are excellent as well.  The pool is gigantic and there was always plenty of space.  The beach area is very quiet and the ocean was just right. 
3- The rooms were not elegant, but they were above average. The in-room jacuzzi is a nice tough, but everything else is was nothing spectacular.  Partial ocean view rooms are only partial ocean views if you lean over the balcony.  The mini-bar was pretty good too.       
4- Overall, the restaurants were above average.  They offer a good variety and selection of different foods.  We are very picky eaters and we found stuff that we enjoyed at all of the restaurants.  I really enjoyed the grilled lobster at Market Grill.  The steak was hit or miss.    
5- The cleaning staff was outstanding and I would give them 5 stars.  They were always there early in the day and did an outstanding job.  They were also very friendly.

The Negatives:
1- The so called 500 "resort credit" offered when we booked online ended up being a complete scam.  I was extremely disappointed.  Essentially, they are just coupons to use towards stuff that you have to purchase.  They should be called "resort coupons."  Example, several of them were 10 dollar coupons for purchase of wine.  Well, at an all inclusive resort I don't really want to spend much money out of pocket.  Their wine for purchase was extremely expensive.  All the other coupons were bad, except for the Spa discount, which we used and saved me 50 dollars.  I didn't think a resort this large would have to offer gimmicks to get people to make reservations, but I guess not.  
2- The excursion/Tour Guide desk was a complete disaster.  There are three different companies all at the same desk, and you have to choose one.  They offer the same tours, but at different prices. Also, they didn't know anything about the tours and were reluctant to try and explain anything.  I would think they could offer suggestions or have a list of most popular excursions, but instead they have a bunch of outdated fliers. 
3- The seating and reservation process at the restaurants was strange.  I understand why they have to take reservations and spread things out, but there would be two or three other couples in the restaurant and they would sit us 2-3 feet from them. 
4- The bars didn't offer a drink menu or any "specialty" drinks.  I think this would be a nice touch and help guests decide.  The resort should have a few signature cocktails. 
5- The pool and cabana service was weak.  If you are really aggressive and find someone, make sure to tip and tell them to come back or you won't see them again. 
6- While I wouldn't say the service was "great," it was pretty good.  The workers and servers really tried hard.  They just need some more training, but they do a pretty good job in the restaurant.  I tipped most of them in the restaurants if they did good. 
7- Wifi.  Wifi works occasionally.  I believe the resort is in the process of fixing this. 

Finally, I will review my Royal Service Experience. Most people want to know, "Is Royal Service worth it or not?"  The answer is "well, maybe."  I will start with the bad.

1- The Butler services were terrible.  Other than making reservations at restaurants, which he screwed up, he really didn't do anything for us.  He was hard to get ahold of and really at the end of the day, it didn't work out for us.  So, luck or the draw, maybe you will get one of the better Butlers.  One evening he told us, "I can't get you a reservation at Market Grill, I am sorry."  Immediately after, I walked directly to the Market Grill and asked for a reservation at 9, and they said, "yes, of course."  I believe the purpose of the Butler is to essentially "control" the guests.  He was persistent we only use one tour company, and was making reservations without consulting us. He let us down in the end, when the concierge didn't show up to pick up our bags and we had to carry them across entire resort.  I tried calling, but he didn't answer his phone. 
2- The hotel does not police the Royal Service areas.  Other guests end up in the Royal Service areas, and I never saw the resort manage that at any point. 
3- No drink service to the cabanas.

The good:
1- Royal Service pool and beach area are much quieter and have nice chairs, day beds, and cabanas.  We never had an issue getting one.  They day beds were really nice to lay on the beach.  The other side has basic chairs and no cabanas.  Royal Service has two private pools that are Royal Service only.
2- The smoothie bar in Royal Service was nice.  They make fresh fruit smoothies all day.
3- No kids in Royal Service
4- Location of Royal Service rooms are much closer to the beach
5- Access to the Palazio restaurant and breakfast in the morning.  The breakfast here felt more private and upscale, as it was just reserved for Royal Service guests.
6- Free access to the spa at resort, and YHi spa at the reserve.  The YHi spa was outstanding! I highly recommend. 

So, you have to decide if the good vs bad I mentioned is worth the extra money.  Also, you will take a risk of having a bad Butler. For us, the good outweighed the bad because the resort grounds, beach, and pool are outstanding. Personally, I think they should just do away with the Butler service. 

Overall, despite some complaints in Royal Service, we had a great stay so I rate it 4 stars.  We enjoyed the privacy of Royal Service.  Make sure if you stay here you are aggressive, or you won't get drinks.  In the end, I don't think you can go wrong with this resort, but let's not call it "perfect."   

Note to manager:  We started off on a bad note when the hotel forgot to pick us up.  I sent the hotel three e-mails requesting pick-up, and they never responded.  I followed the instructions exactly on their website.  When I checked in, I mentioned this and the employee told me, "show me the e-mails."  Sorry, at that point it was too late.  At check-out, not one person asked us, "how was your stay."  Employees saw us carrying our own luggage out and nobody said a word.  Get rid of that resort credit! It was very misleading.  The actual employee herself at check-in told us the only good ones are the spa and casino one. Our check-in and check-out overall here was an F.

reviews.author: Kurt N
reviews.title: Butler Service
reviews.text: This was my first stay at this property.  I only had two days, and had a great time.  I definitely recommend springing the extra $50 for the Butler Service.  I was assigned Edward, and he was very professional and was focused on providing top-notch customer service.  Excellent job staff - I will be back.

reviews.author: Lovethebeach085
reviews.title: Royal Service Fantastic
reviews.text: I love this place! The Royal Service I read about in other reviews so I went for that. My butler Elvis is the greatest! He is so attentive to detail, courteous, friendly and all in addition to doing a fantastic job overall. Since I am traveling by myself it is very comforting knowing I can count on someone for assistance and he is very reliable. I feel more secure for sure. Leonardo at the pool bar is the best! He remembers your drinks and starts making it before you even order :) I wanted to pamper myself so I picked the Royal Service and I couldn't be happier. The room is soooo quiet and close to all I want and need so I don't have to hike anywhere. Pedro the beach concierge is amazing, too. Helping you to set up and bringing you drinks to your chair. Will definitely recommend...

reviews.author: Kerry H
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text:
Beautiful property. Not a great choice for solo travelers. Overall disappointed with the food and service, especially because I paid for the upgraded service. 
I upgraded to royal service, they arrange private transportation from the airport to the hotel. How I was taken to the wrong paradisus is beyond me. And their lack of apologies and acting as if it was my fault made it worse. 
Check in went smoothly. Most of the advertised services with the royal service package I did not experience. My butler did not pack or unpack for me. He was rarely to be found. There was no aromatherapy. And I had to check up on dinner reservations- would've been less stressful to have done it myself. 
I was disappointed with the service overall and perhaps it's because I went alone. I was unhappy with the spa treatment. Most of the food was mediocre at best; Gabi beach and bana tepanyaki were the exceptions. 
Seems like a great place for couples that want romance.  But honestly I did not feel pampered here. 
Went to another resort. Beaches are better, food is better, atmosphere is more fun.

reviews.author: JayCola61984
reviews.title: a cancelled flight brought me here for a night!!!!
reviews.text:
I stayed at another resort for four nights and while on the runway ready to leave I ended up having my flight cancelled due to a mechanical issue that would require overnight maintenance. The airline stated they were going to put us up for the night at this location and pick us up in the morning to fly out. The stuff of dreams, a free extra night in Punta Cana, sure why not, better than being snowed in at an airport Sheraton in New England. We arrived at the resort via busses and the front desk was EXTREMELY helpful, friendly, and really lightened the mood for some people who were aggravated around me. I was far from aggravated, I didn't have anywhere to be, why not be here for free? 

I was checking in and the very pretty Dominican front desk agent told me, you are one lucky guy, you are in a jacuzzi suite in The Reserve, one of their Royal Service suite rooms. Wow, when was the last time that happened to anyone? Awesome marketing for the resort I guess, airline uses insurance and pays them for rooms they aren't using, leaving a guy like me wow'ed and considering returning. Regardless, check in was 5 star they really made you feel welcome - explained where dinner was and directed me towards a shuttle that would take me to the room. Arrive at room I can hear the ocean, couldn't at my last resort, wasn't close enough. Open the door and wow, what a room. Very upscale furnishings, impeccably clean, and a wrap around balcony with a tub. Can't complain! There were plenty of towels, unlike my last resort who holds those as more valuable than Stoli vodka, and plenty of high end bath accessories and such.

I settled in and relaxed for a few as a long day at the airport wears on you. Decided to head over the bar and restaurant to see what was up. The bar was right on the beach and the buffet was connected. I almost don't even want to say buffet because it was far too nice for that term.

The service was awesome, a buenos noches and a squirt of hand sanitizer from the hostess, nice touch there. Had a few drinks and wandered in where the grub was. WOW are you kidding me, where was this at my last resort? Chef station had carved suckling pork, a grill with 20 or so Caribbean lobster tails on it and another searing ahi tuna. There was endless amounts of fruit, beans and rice, salad, coconut shrimp and fish etc. Everything was 5 star, I can only imagine their sit down service. Had two giant plates and called it a night there.

Had to be up early for round two of the flight so I relaxed in the room, tested the jacuzzi out, and relaxed on the quiet patio. One more walk on the beach and called it a night. The bed was extremely comfortable and the nights sleep couldn't have been better.

Did a quick breakfast in the same spot as last night, same awesome service and food, omelette station, tons of fresh fruit, plenty of bagels toast eggs etc. Fresh fruit juices out for the taking, didn't see that at prior resort. 

I knew it was at least a 10 minute walk to the front desk but to my surprise I arrive back to my room and a golf cart was waiting to take us, they knew we had a big group and had it all planned out, no stress at all, great touch Paradisus those things do not go unnoticed.

I understand this specific cluster of rooms is more expensive than where I stayed however, I believe the service and quality of the overall resort would make even the standard rooms worth booking without question.

Thanks again Paradisus team you made one night of interrupted travel a great experience!!!!!

reviews.author: Christine F
reviews.title: Business Center
reviews.text:
Omar was amazing!  He was able to help me with all of my computer and printing questions.  
He was always there asking if I needed anything - even brought me coffee! five star service.  
I recommend this to anyone that needs to do work while on vacation!!

reviews.author: ana g
reviews.title: HOTEL DE EXCELENCIA!!!!!!
reviews.text: Me he alojado en varias cadenas de hoteles, especialmente en los Melia que se distinguen por su excelencia y calidad tanto en las lujosas instalaciones como en sus servicios ( comidas, limpieza, gimnasio, etc), pero el Palma Real se caracteriza además por la calidez y amabilidad de su personal, especialmente su equipo de animación, quiénes con su dedicación y vocación de servicio alegran a cada uno de los huéspedes. Quiero felicitar a la gerencia por la selección de ellos, especialmente Francisco Reynoso, Macdonal y Reyna. Indiscutiblemente son el espiritu alegre del hotel. Volveré

reviews.author: Candida30
reviews.title: Paradise in Paradisus
reviews.text:
The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana is literally paradise in a magnificent setting complete with Eco gardens in which you can travel from one part of the property to another. The employees at the main concierge at the Reserve are extremely attentive and knowledgeable. Upon entering you are transformed into a paradise complete with magnificent floral gardens surrounding a large, beautiful pool. The employees at the Reserve concierge in each respective building are equally as gracious, attentive and knowledgeable about the resort. The suites are comfortable and complete with modern amenities. It was a pleasure to walk around the resort and explore the grounds. The trams were extremely helpful and arrived in a timely manner. Walking to the beach was very pleasant as you walk or travel via tram through the eco gardens hearing music emanating from the fauna and smell sweet incense. As you enter the beach area you encounter the white sand and turquoise water, leaving you breathless. There are ample restaurants to eat, although I would recommend the hotel offer more local, Dominican cuisine.
A special thank you to Mindy at the main reserve concierge, Yuri, Ada and Anabel at the concierge in the building in which I stayed, Candida, my namesake, who greeted me every morning at Gabi club for breakfast, and José at the pool area who is extremely gracious and attentive. Also a thank you to all the staff at the reserve pool and beach areas and the staff at the individual restaurants. The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana entices you to visit again and again, although it is the graciousness and beauty of the Dominican staff that ensure that you enjoy yourself and return for future visits.

reviews.author: Maria H
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Lmi experiencia es muy buena la atención a través de la señorita Anabel González muy buena. Su recomendación para restauránd y visitar diferentes lugares, el restaurándola Vento Muy bueno, los masajes del  YSPA excelentes masajes es un lugar para regresar muy pronto.

reviews.author: Russell C
reviews.title: Wonderful visit even after a year to reflect
reviews.text: I visited Paradisus Palma Real in June of 2013 and let me just say it was absolutely great. I am a very low maintenance individual and even traveling alone everyone was extremely friendly.  Absolutely get the Royal Service as just getting into restaurants is worth it, but Tony my butler was great despite having to wait on several groups other than myself.  I eat all over the world and the food is better than any all inclusive I have been to so don't be scared away by any negative comments.  Berenice America and Alexander Guzman were there every day at Palazzo taking caring of me, learning my name, and exactly my favorites.  And the dinner at Passion is so well worth the up charge.  Great selection of food and the service was managed perfectly.  Laura Castillo and Luis Rubio really took care to give me a in depth view of the dishes as well as some of the details that made the meal exceptional.  Some people weren't happy because cable wasn't working perfectly in their room... You are on a beautiful resort, the Royal lounge has great WIFI and TV, and those bothered were usually with someone else so just keep that in mind.  I enjoyed my stay so much that I am bringing my now fiancé to get married at the resort in a couple of months.  They earned my trust and look forward to a wonderful second trip!  My only request would be that the Royal guests get the pre trip email to coordinate the reservations and requests ahead of time...look forward to seeing the staff with my future bride!

reviews.author: Leticia G
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Excelente resort, la atención insuperable, había leído muchas opiniones positivas pero la realidad superó mis expectativas. La oferta gastronómica destacable. Ideal el servicio real para quienes busquen días de descanso y tranquilidad sin preocuparse de nada. Agradezco a Yohel por su amable atención y en la zona de playa a Pedro quien desborda simpatía para todos.

reviews.author: MaryLiam
reviews.title: Perfect Beach Getaway
reviews.text: This was my first solo vacation and my goal was to enjoy a beautiful beach in a quiet and relaxing setting. Paradisus Palma Real's Royal Service was perfect for this goal. I had an ocean view room that was beautifully and tastefully decorated. The room was kept fresh and clean daily by the maid service. Since the room faced the private beach, my porch was a quiet refuge - no children running around and no loud partiers, just the fantastic view of the palm trees, white sand and blue-green water. The butler service provided by Jeziel Alvarez was excellent. Jeziel was always responsive, reliable and personable. He made sure I had a cheeseplate in my room in the afternoon and had a relaxing bath ready for me when I returned from dinner. The personalized service on the beach was also amazing. I don't recall the gentleman's name, but every morning when I stepped on the sand, the same friendly face greeted me and walked me to my private Bali bed. And within 5 minutes of my arrival on the beach each day, he brought me an ice bucket with bottled water. The entire staff was great. Everyone I passed gave me a friendly smile and said hello. I pre-arranged transportation to and from the airport to the hotel with Olympus. They also provided outstanding service and the driver, Yamarco, was very courteous and friendly. My new goal is to return here and enjoy the Royal Service with my family!

reviews.author: Isaac C
reviews.title: Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text: The service is excellent at the Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana, everyone is friendly and tries to help with anything you might need. My concierge Anabel Gonzalez was very helpful from the first day I came, she was able to make reservations and point out activities I would like. She was always ready to help with any requests. Also housekeeping is excellent they come several times a day to clean the room and check that everything is nice. The entertainment staff is also friendly and helpful and the bartenders are always happy to make drinks. The Reserve is nicer than the Paradisus Punta Cana because it is quieter and there is less competition for the pool areas and beach.

reviews.author: ELAHEJOON
reviews.title: 2nd class citizen
reviews.text:
I felt that there was a difference in the type of service that they give to Royal Services and ones who booked with Jetblue getaways. I paid over 3G and felt like s second class citizen... But the Staff was the NICEST IN THE WORLD!!!
The aqua spa was not maintained at all half the jets didn't work and the showers didnt work, The staff and entertainment staff was amazingly kind and so pleasant!!

reviews.author: Ehdiver
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: This place is Vegas at the beach. Great if you like constant noise and drink all day. There were at least 30 boats passing back and forth on the beach all day. Lots of hawkers on the beach. I was on the beach enjoying the quiet one evening and was approached by a prostitute. My final three days were spent nursing food poisoning.

reviews.author: Hayfa H
reviews.title: Paradisiaque
reviews.text: C'est un superbe hôtel, très beau:l'architecture est magnifique et super propre: le personnel du ménage est très minutieux. Un grand merci à tous le personnel sans qui le séjour n'aurait pas été le même, toujours à disposition et à l'écoute, très polis et souriants.  Un remerciement particulier à Noèl pour son dynamisme lors de ses cours d'aérobic et sa gentillesse, à Fabio V pour ses précieux cours de bachata sur la piscine, à Wandy pour son sens du service au Gabi club et aussi à Luís pour sa gentillesse et son superbe sens du service sur la plage the Réserve ainsi que Micky. reviews.author: Harvey1926
reviews.title: Great trip!
reviews.text: Rosemary checked me in and took me to my room and went over everything for me . Each building has its own concierge where I met Luisa. She gave me the grand tour of the grounds. She went and made reservations for dinner for the next couple of nights . Food is really good! Then I met Yeuri also concierge.  He not only made sure I had LOTS of bottled water in my room.  But made dinner reservations for me . Everyone very helpful . Even Yina , in housekeeping made sure I had extra coffee. You can have food and drinks by the pool or beach or even delivered to your room.  I went by myself and felt secure. I'm happy I chose this place!

reviews.author: casper G
reviews.title: Hotel de maxima categoria
reviews.text: Concurri el 7/12/13 me recibieron muy bien,pero me equivoque con mi reserva y gracias a la intervención de la Srta.Josefina Abreu de recepcion ante la Gerencia (Sr. Jorge Mora) se me otorgo una habitación superior sin costo?? ,los restoranes todos buenos pero recomiendo dos "Vento"con su personal Areche,de la rosa,de la Crez,Gerrero,Silverio,Colen,Alexis, Montain,Yuderquis y Juan Suarez ;  el otro recomendado es el  "Gabi Beach" con Kimberlyn    Geniel,Liliana,Mateo,D Aza,Daniel ,Waner Franklin  y el equipo de room service con Sergio y su staff,la camarera claribel Ramírez pregunten por cualquira de ellos en los diferentes servicios mencionados y gozaran de la mejo estadia en tan "hermoso" hotel.Espero,si mis posibilidades económicas me lo permiten poder en el 2014 hacer el mismo viaje.LO MEJOR DE LO MEJOR H.Gaspar Gattuso

reviews.text:
Partis pour 4 jours seulement en solo....wow! excellent hôtel....il faut choisir une chambre à la réserve pour avoir la tranquilité d'esprit ....notre concierge Jennifer est excellente.....la nourriture est correcte avec une grande variété ....la plage réservé pour les client de la réserve est belle...les serviette toujours disponible ....et pas besoin de se lever tôt pour réserver une place....

et Voila

reviews.author: 27VMG
reviews.title: Beautiful property; Attentive and personable staff; Good value.
reviews.text: One of the most beautifully landscaped resorts I have ever seen.  The staff was always friendly, polite and attentive.  Well maintained beach.  11 restaurants to choose from and all I sampled were excellent.  The price I paid for an all-inclusive package was quite reasonable.  I was in the Royal Service section and assigned my own butler.  Royal Service provides access to its own private section of the beach and its own private restaurant (La Palapa).  But this was more pampering than I really needed as a solo traveler.  Room was well designed, clean, and very comfortable.  I went solo but would definitely return with family or friends.

reviews.author: Steven T
reviews.title: Dissappointed
reviews.text: This was my 3rd time back. 1st room I was checked in, had crayon marks all over the sofa and the TV did not work. 2nd room had ants and several lights were burned out. The Internet connectivity is horrible and several computers in their lobby do not work. I very rarely got a connection and most times, I was disconnected.The buffet food quality and offering is below average. The beach is nice and the golfing was a good experience. "Free" golfing was included in my package but you still have to pay a $50 cart fee. The casino at their sister hotel is small but nice. The staff was friendly.

reviews.author: kyle m
reviews.title: Paradise on Earth
reviews.text: Your trip to paradise begins as soon as you pull up to the breath taking entrance/lobby with a spectacular view of the Carribean just beyond the palazzo and beach. The decor is very lush with an abundance of lounges and settees on which to sit, relax and enjoy a drink. I was very impressed with my room as it was a Single Garden Suite and was probably considered "low end"-but to my astonishment had an 80 square foot private balcony and double jacuzzi-things that were hard to find at ANY resort at any price. The food was fantastic as were the grounds and facilities. But my highest praise is reserved for the staff-all of whom were great-but there are two who I feel are worthy of special attention. First is Jorgelina who works at the front desk. She was always friendly and quickly resolved a minor issue I had with my room key. THANK YOU JORGELINA!! My biggest praise however, is reserved for Julio who works for dining services. THANK YOU FOR YOUR KINDNESS AND EXCELLENT SERVICE!! I whole heartedly recommend this fantastic resort to anyone looking for an elegant and relaxing Dominican getaway. In my opinion it's the best resort on the island. I've already planned my return trip.

reviews.author: JUANKAHLO
reviews.title: Exelente  Hotel, Uno de los All inclusive Mas completos.
reviews.text: The Reserve en Paradisus Punta Cana  es un  hotel dentro de un hotel con todas las comodidades  para  complacer a todos. El check in fue rapido e informativo , habitaciones espaciosas y limpias y equipadas con todo lo necesario para disfrutar. La veriedad gastronomica  es  acertada con opciones para todos. El roomservice es  muy completo y  a tiempo , dando seguimiento en todo momento a cualquier pedido ) ojo unica critica es que pedi una soda y vino movida y al abrirla  estallo! pero nada del otro mundo. Jardines , playas y pisinas en excelente  condicion . Recomendado para todo aquel que quiere disfrutar de una eperiencia superior. Vale la pena al 100%.

reviews.author: Mario M
reviews.title: RECOMIENDO ESTE HOTEL
reviews.text: He concurrido a este hotel, y he utilizado el Royal Service porque vale la pena hacer una inversión, porque se trata de un lugar para relajarse y encontrar la tranquilidad que uno anhela después de varios meses de trabajo. Recomiendo el restaurante Passion de Martin Berasategui.

reviews.author: Hannelore G
reviews.title: overrated hotel
reviews.text:
I was at this hotel oct 10th 2013. I travel a lot so I know what is good and what is not.
the rooms are very dated, and musty. To go to the restaurants from the room it is over 1/2mile.
the food is not a 6 apple quality.Maybe a 4 apple.
apple vacations sells this automatically with a vip service. for me the service was,3 phone calls for restaurant reservations. and one phone call for the airport transfer, since there was never an apple rep.to find. for this I had to pay nearly $1000 more, even with the single booking this was much to much.
everything in my suitcase had to be washed or drycleaned, it smelled and everything was wet.
I would not recommend this hotel, it is overrated and overpriced. it should be a 4 star at the most.

Ps. the staff was excellent, very helpful

Hannah McN  Philadelphia

reviews.author: Paula R
reviews.title: GRAN HOTEL DE LUJO
reviews.text:
Es un hotel ideal para pasar la vacaciones y descansar.
Personal muy amable y muy pendiente de hacer de tu estancia una gran esperiencia.
Las instalaciones y habitaciones son excelentes y muy amplias.

reviews.author: Luis A
reviews.title: vacacines de lujo
reviews.text: acabo de pasar unos días de maravilloso descanso en Paradissus Palma Real en Punta Cana exelentes instalaciones, una arquitectura muy agradable buen paisaje, muy buena la atención de todo su personal en especial Yubi, Yira, Leo, Angel de actividades con los que jugué boleyboll baile pinte, y también Luis Diaz y Ramon del bar de piscina gracias por tan buenas vacaciones

reviews.author: Jennifer r
reviews.title: Definitely worth it!
reviews.text: I recently visited the Dominican Republic and stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real.  I also decided to upgrade to the Royal Service not knowing what to expect, but was very happy I did.  The service I received was impeccable, the resort beautiful and the staff very courteous and helpful.  In particular, my butler, Juan de Leon, was fabulous (with the Royal Service, you are assigned a personal butler who is available to assist you with your vacation needs). I will definitely will go back to this resort and will request Juan.  This resort is also an all inclusive resort, which can be hit or miss.  The food here was definitely a hit! Lots of choices and delicious and with an exclusive restaurant for Royal Service guests.  The Royal Service is definitely worth the extra cost!

reviews.author: 1mistyblue
reviews.title: Close to Paradise
reviews.text:
After staying at The Reserve, I chose to stay at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa for my next visit.  I loved the property and decided to give this side a try.

Great idea - it was the same beautiful property with a better level of service.  It made me wonder whether the difference was because of the different times of year that I visited (low season vs. high season).

Summary:
Again, upon arrival I was given a room with a double bed instead of a king as I'd requested.  I would not take pushing the beds together as an answer after my previous stay. The nice employee who drove me to my room kept asking me to sit and get comfortable as they tried to resolve the matter.  He called the front desk and waited for a while and then left to go back to the main desk.  He assured me that they would find me another room.  After 15 minutes of waiting,  I kept calling the front desk until they resolved the situation.  Which led to the room right next door.  I'm not sure why they didn't give me that room to begin with as it was not occupied.  Not sure what it is with this place.  

After getting over the double bed situation, my trip was a week of peaceful relaxation.  The room was quiet, my view of palm trees/courtyard was not a problem, and my wi-fi access came and went intermittently, but I dealt with it.  The wi-fi also worked on the beach and in some of the restaurants (as a lone traveler, this was good for me).  The few problems I had with the room (after the move) were limited to water leaking from the shower at the bottom of the door (which a couple of towels solved), a repair had been done in the ceiling of the shower and they left a painted board there (most people wouldn't have noticed) and no light bulb on my balcony (I didn't sit out there at night, but it would have been nice to have had the option).

Additionally, something that concerned me about the light bulb matter was that a maintenance man came to my door to check on the light a number of days into my stay at approx. 6 pm.  He looked and saw no bulb, but never came back to put one in.  The next night at approx. 10:15 pm (the night before my departure), two men appeared at my door claiming to be there to "fix the light."  Who does repairs at that time?  No one I know, so that did not happen. And as I was leaving the next day, why couldn't that wait?

Food 
The food was as expected - Vento is still my favorite restaurant (service and food 5 stars like I remember) - I went there two nights.  Tried Teppanyaki and it was not good.  I think it was the chef that we had (service is provided to groups whether you're together or not).  He didn't do any tricks and the food tasted one star at best. At Market Grill they forgot to bring me my drink and wasn't very apologetic when I reminded them.

Not a beer drinker, but all they'll serve you is Presidente.  Mixed drinks came with well liquor - if you want top shelf, I advise picking some up at duty-free before you get to the resort.  Get all the bottled water you can, you'll need it.

Beach
This is where I spent most of my time; in the SUN.  Beach was beautiful as usual.  Way more people here than in Sept of 2012 when I visited.  It happened to be during Spring Break and there were many college students at other resorts (I didn't notice many here). There were a lot of friendly people out there and the weather was fantastic - not one rainy day.  It was hard to get a palapa on some days and I found there were a lot of people who would use them and then leave towels after they'd left and they would appear occupied.  Other people would intentionally leave things so that if they wanted to come back and use them later, other people would not sit there.

Didn't use the pools this time, but they were as lovely as ever.  The ocean was my friend.

Gym
On the small side, but overall functional.  Treadmills, weights, mats, and other things you need to get a full body workout.  I found it strange that they requested your room information when entering the gym although we are all wearing bracelets that identify us as Paradisus Palma Real guests that have access to the gym.

Overall, this trip was great.  I did my own thing (no shows or spa this time) and relaxed and had a stress free time.  I would definitely recommend the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort to my friends and will be going back.

Many thanks to the people who cleaned my room and restocked my water every day - they were the highlight of my visit.

reviews.author: Indya26
reviews.title: Huge Hotel Close to The Beach
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the Paradisus Punta Cana resort for a wedding. The hotel is about 30 minutes from the Punta Cana airport. I was upgraded to The Reserve which is like a hotel within Paradisus. The room was nice and spacious with a jacuzzi tub, glass shower and separate toilet with double sinks. The Reserve has it's own pool, and restaurant but is about a 5 minute walk to the beach and the rest of the resort where the other restaurants are along with the main lobby which is where the casino and nightly entertainment is located. The Reserve mainly had families so it can get a bit noisy but it wasn't unbearable. The staff was very pleasant and attentive. I would definitely stay again but I would chose to stay in a luxury room on the main property instead of The Reserve.

reviews.author: Noel A
reviews.title: Nice vacation
reviews.text:
I am on the 4th day of a one week vacation to The Reserve at Paradius Punta Cana. Check in was easy (thanks to Rosemary and others) The grounds of the resort are simply beautiful and the accommodations are very comfortable. Nice swimming pools and facilities for children. The restaurants are nice and the fresh fruit (mango, guava and papaya) are also very nice. All the staff at Gabi restaurant are friendly, actually that goes for all the staff at the resort. Best of all is the white sand beach and gentle ocean waves. Spend as much time as possible by the beach--it's very nice. Luis, Jose and Adolpho who manned the bar at the beach were excellent and have kept me well "hydrated" while I am on the beach :) The pictures on the resort's web site don't do justice to the resort so I was a little apprehensive before I arrived. Overall very nice vacation (so far) and lots to do. I recommend this resort. 
Noel A.

reviews.author: Joe C
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text:
This was my 8th or 9th time to the Paradisus Palma Real since my first trip in July 2006. I love this resort it is beautiful and just is a great place to get away and relax for a week.
The food was great as usual. Although my favorite restaurant Passion now changed to where you have to pay some $ to eat there. It wasn't a big deal many other places to choose from though.
I was recognized by 6 people there from my past trips to the resort and it was nice to see familiar faces. Have to say Jose Ramos from Vento went over and above his services for me while I was there. I saw Jose every morning for breakfast and he really took great care of me the 2 times I ate at Vento. Great guy ask for him if you eat at Vento. Brought me a special appetizer that wasn't on the menu that was delicious and just did a great job.
The workers are very friendly, the resort is clean and gorgeous, and the beach is spectacular.
I got to my room which used to have a direct ocean view, but because of the trees that have been growing in the garden I couldn't see the ocean like I used to from the room. A little disappointed about that because I had stayed in these back rooms before on the 3rd floor that used to look out directly at the ocean. Now you really can't see it.
The only negatives if I really want to complain about something is the reservations for dinners. Always have been some issues getting them I still to this day have no idea how these work. I ask for 6:30 PM at a restaurant they say they are full and I look in and the place is empty. 
Also as usual the sea weed is always bad and I know they clean up during the morning I just wish someone was there all day cleaning it off the beach. Other than that I had a great 9 days here as usual that's why I keep coming back. I've been to other places in the Dom Rep and other countries, but love this place. Great weather, food was delicious, pool and beach beautiful and had a great trip once again. Will definitely be back.

reviews.author: laurafusion
reviews.title: So amazing!!!
reviews.text: Stayed here earlier this month for some much needed R&D and was truly impressed. Last year I stayed at the Reserve, but like the hotel much better. I encourage you to upgrade to Royal Service. Everyone there is great and makes for a very relaxing vacation. No worries here with Martin Lineo reserving my favorite daybed each day, Antonio Duval making my dinner reservations and ensuring I came back to a room with a fabulous jacuzzi prepared, and Wilken Mejia mixing delicious mojitos!! The Royal Service pool is much quieter and relaxing than the other pools and is adults-only. Food everywhere was delicious (Gabi Beach restaurant with its great seafood and open air waterfront dining takes the prize for best food!), the entertainment was fun, and I met lots of people from around the US and other countries. I will definitely be back again.

reviews.author: FallFinesse
reviews.title: Great Way to Vacay
reviews.text:
I visited Pardisus Palma Real during June 23-30. After having all of my friends bail on the trip, I took the trip solo. That small snag did not matter. I arrived at the hotel and was immediately greeted by the staff. The Dominican people are some of the friendliest people you will ever meet at this resort. After my initial check-in, I chose to upgrade as a way to have help whenever I needed throough the butler service. With the upgrade, I was taken to another lounge area where I met my butler Juan De Leon. Upgrading was the best thing I could've done. Juan took me around the resort, explaining all the different things available to me as well as the benefits of a butler. He took me to Market Grille to have lunch while I waited for my room to get ready. Afterwards, we checked my room only to find it was not quite what I requested. Within minutes, Juan was able to find a room that suited my needs. Partial ocean view overlooking the pool. Throughout the 7 night stay, Juan made all my reservations for dinner (and didn't complain when I changed my mind), iron clothing for the evening and surprised me with baths drawn for the evening and light refreshing snacks. Upgrading to Royal Service was worth it. In Royal Service, you gain access to two of the best restaurants in my opinion on this massive and beautiful property, Palazzo and Gabi Beach. Although I ate at Nano a few times, the quiet serene atmosphere in Palazzo was amazing. Oscar Polanco, Belkis Robley and the other hostess whose name I do not have always made me feel welcomed. Richard and the other waiters were great. The joys of royal service also include your private beach where the pool concierge was always at your service. Billy Levons, Francisco and Martin were my favorites! These guys are as much entertaining as they are helpful. Drinks and bali beds they would get for you instantly. The Sunset Bar became my favorite spot as I got to hang out and socialize with the great bartenders Nelson, Gloria and another bar tender whose name slips me (will post his picture). The beds were easy to get to as well as access to the beach. Definitely for adults and those who just want to relax, be romantic or party it up just a little. Manuel always made the freshest fruit juices if you just wanted something cool. The time around the Royal Service side was always fun as you got to know all of the butlers as they were all there to service you. Thanks Carlos (The Boss :-), Jeury Ferreira (great person and very helpful with translating), Tony and all the other butlers who may have helped in some form or fashion. (These guys on the royal side really made my graduation/birthday trip amazing as a solo trip)
Now more about the property. Rooms were cleaned daily with turn-down services and wonderful chocolate! I wish I had taken advantage of the water therapy provided in the spas more often. I had a great massage at the Reserve (neighbor resort) by Vitatly. One of the best I have ever had. The spa facility itself was amazing.
Several restaurants to choose from with whatevery type of food you wanted. My least favorite was the Asian Fusion but the overall was great on the property. There were shows to attend each night. The Michael Jackson show was my favorite. I was able to take advantage of the Cultural Tour excursion with Johnathan G and Johnny. There's a mall very close with some of the trendiest stores and as well commercial. The mall and Reserve were all accessible through the golf cart service at the hotel. There was never a dull moment at the resort and you really could enjoy yourself without leaving the proper. The only issue with the room was with the phone and the internet was very spotty but having royal service I was able to access the lounge where computer use was free. I would recommend this place to anyone who's looking for a true getaway! Pictures to come at a later date!!

reviews.author: happygofortunate
reviews.title: A Terrific Vacation
reviews.text:
I just returned from 11 days at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana.  I’ll start by saying, if you can afford to upgrade, do it.  The Reserve is a smaller section of the property that caters strictly to the Reserve guests.

Basically, the rooms are nicer and in some cases, bigger.  While at the pool or the beach, you will always have a wait staff to get your drinks and bring you food.  And you will also have the pleasure of meeting Silvio, Guest Service Manager - who seemed to pop up whenever you needed him.  I don't actually think he slept the entire time I was there!

If you spend any amount of time at the Reserve pool, you’ll most certainly meet Luis Santana who is one of the nicest people there.  His sole aim is to keep you from doing anything!

At Gabi Club, the restaurant located in the Reserve area, you won’t be dealing with a line or waiting for a table.  I had breakfast and lunch there almost every day.  The food was excellent and everything was fresh … even the displays of the food probably had me eating more than I wanted to.

The beds are unbelievably comfortable.  At The Reserve, you can select the pillows you’d like to try … it’s called the Pillow Menu. J

As you’ve already read, the grounds are gorgeous and immaculately kept.  In fact, I don’t think I’ve ever stayed at a cleaner resort.  You’ll be hard-pressed to find a single piece of trash anywhere.  My room was spotless and so was every building/restaurant on the property.  A big thank you to the ladies who took care of room 2417 including Mathilda and Glorya.

This was my first experience at an all-inclusive.  I am not much of a drinker so it usually doesn’t make much sense for me.  But the rates were so good, I thought I’d try it.  I must admit, not looking at the prices on the menu was really nice.  They also offer room service at all hours at no additional charge.  Your room also has a small mini frig that is stocked – no fee for that either.

I think my expectations concerning the food were pretty low.  I thought being at an all-inclusive meant a few choices and fairly bland offerings.  It simply wasn’t the case here.  Now there were meals that weren’t my favorite, but it wasn’t the quality of the food – everything was well prepared and I thoroughly enjoyed it.

I was able to eat at just about every restaurant:  Aqua, Vento, Gabi Beach, Gabi Club, Mole, The Grill, Bana and Bana Wok.  I did not get a chance to eat at Fuego. Like I said, I thought the food was terrific and unlike most trips, I always ordered dessert.

If you’re hoping to stay active, you will love this place.  They offer free tennis classes on Monday and Wednesday from 5:30-6pm.  I brought my racquet, but you can borrow one from them.  Amby is their pro and he is funny, nice, and very patient … he didn’t quit after trying to help me with my serve!  Domingo and Jose are also there and fun to play with as well.  You can get a one hour lesson or just play for an hour with one of them for only $20!  Anyone back in the States knows that’s unbelievably cheap.

They also offer a nicely appointed gym as well as  studio space.  For an extra fee, you can take yoga, pilates, meditation, stretching.  They have a menu at the concierge and the spa.

I did get a massage at the YHI spa.  As always, spa services at a resort are way over-priced and this is no exception.  An 80 minute massage was $140 plus taxes and fees.  I had a resort credit that made it a little more palatable, but it’s still pretty pricey.

As for the negatives, there are only a couple:  be aware that because this is the tropics and the humidity is high, most floors are tile or marble.  Not much sound gets muffled so you can hear just about everything, especially doors closing.  The doors – at least in my building - must be slammed to be shut.  Since all doors face in to a courtyard, you can hear them all.  Not sure if they’re aware of this or not, but it does seem fixable.

Also, and this goes along the same lines, but I was in a room that had an adjoining door to another room.  It might as well have been separated by newspaper because I had could hear everything next door.  Unfortunately, I was stuck next to a family with two kids, one of whom did nothing but cry and whine the entire time they were in the room.  Trust me, I don’t blame the kid, I blame her parents.

Are kids welcome?  Definitely - and I posted some other information - as well as pictures about my stay/trip on my travel blog.  You are more than welcome to check it out or send me any questions.  www.travelfor1.squarespace.com  (If this doesn't show as an active link - just paste in your browser.)

reviews.author: Maria C
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones
reviews.text: Felicitar a la excelente atencion de todos los que hacen que la estancia de los turistas sea de las mejores,en especial a Reynaldo Cabrera Sky Bar junto con Yudelkis Rivas y su compañero Angel(animacion),que gracias a ellos mi estancia fue como estar en casa,de verdad que fue mas que excelente su atencion,me brindaron muy buenos momentos...saludos a todos ellos y recomendado 100% el destino y como no el Hotel......con ganas de volver.

reviews.author: Cla Z
reviews.title: MARAVILHOSO!!!!
reviews.text:
Excelente em todos os aspectos. Praia perfeita em frente ao hotel, piscinas sempre limpas, camas gigantes tanto na praia quanto na piscina (na área exclusiva aos hóspedes do Royal Service) sempre sendo preparadas pela equipe de atendimento do Royal Service e sem nenhuma economia quanto as toalhas, todos os restaurantes com atendimento muito bom e ótimas opções a la carte, com destaque para o Bana Sushi (para quem gosta de japonês, vai se esbaldar) e para o Palazzo onde tomei meu café da manhã todos os dias e jantei uma vez (ali recomendo o saltimboca de rês e de sobremesa o brownie com sorvete - delicioso!!!). O atendimento é muito bom em todos os restaurantes mas, definitivamente o Palazzo supera a todos. Equipe sempre gentil, atenta e solícita.
Quanto a equipe com quem convivi na área do Royal Service durante os dez dias que lá estive, só tenho elogios...
Meu mordomo, JEAN-PIERRE, foi um presente que ganhei pouco depois de chegar. Além de ser fluente em 6 línguas (inclusive o português), é de uma delicadeza e respeito impressionantes. Cuidou de todos os detalhes para que eu sempre me sentisse confortável e segura (como viajei sozinha, isso para mim fez toda diferença). Recomendo a todos que peçam por ele caso decidam optar pelo Royal Service pois nem todos os hóspedes tiveram experiências tão gratificantes quanto a minha com seus mordomos (inclusive eu, que fui recepcionada por um e pedi para substitui-lo dois dias depois).  
Ao pessoal da piscina/praia da área do RS, só tenho a agradecer:
- PEDRO deve ser o cara mais alegre e simpático de toda República Dominicana. Cuida do atendimento a cada hóspede como se ele fosse único e se esmera em cada atitude, sempre buscando atender as diferentes necessidades de cada um. Sua alegria de viver é contagiante; 
- JAMON (que cobre as folgas do Pedro) também é adorável! Mais tímido e sério do que o Pedro mas, tão eficiente quanto ele. Atendia a todos sempre com muito respeito e cordialidade;
- FRANCISCO GIL e WINKIM também ajudaram a deixar meus dias em Punta Cana mais felizes. O primeiro estava sempre atento as necessidades de todos e trazia rapidamente o que lhe era solicitado, sempre com um sorriso nos lábios e a simpatia que lhe é característica. Já o Winkin, é o responsável pelo bar da piscina do RS e, além de preparar drinks MARAVILHOSOS (recomendo "Oh my Gosh" e "Two Brothers"... fora os mojitos, é claro), também servia a todos com agilidade, respeito e muita simpatia. 
- Também vai um agradecimento especial ao LUIS (Z) que, apesar de atender no bar da piscina principal (que eu não cheguei a frequentar), trocou meia dúzia de palavras comigo no segundo dia e, a partir dali, toda vez que me via passando chamava para pelo menos me dar um olá em meio a muitas risadas e uma ou duas longnecks, com as quais ele gentilmente me presenteava.
Resumindo, foram 10 dias de recarga, relax e pura mordomia (rsrsrs). Minha nota para o hotel, os serviços oferecidos e principalmente a equipe, é 10!!!!

reviews.author: Mavis Y
reviews.title: My Paradisus Palma Real Experience
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying I had a fantastic time! 

I was there on vacation on May 5th thru May 12th by myself. This was the 1st time every. Now I have been on a lot of trips to some of the best places and resorts but nothing measures to the service and attention that I received from one of your entertainment staff call Rodolfo.

This man made me feel special and simply like a queen. Yet very professional, his conversation, attention whenever he saw me around, dancing made me forget all about the fact I was alone. reviews.author: Ana Alexandra C
reviews.title: maravillosas vacaciones
reviews.text:
Estuve en punta cana y pase unas Excelentes vacaciones en The Reserve.  El hotel es fascinante, la  comida es muy buena en especial la del Gabi Beach y el el restaurante Fuego fusión latina. 

Los cócteles son exquisitos, los bartenders del Gabi Club son muy atentos, siempre pendientes con tu cóctel listo antes de pedirlo, en especial a Kelvin.

El servicio de habitación es excelente, la habitación es super confortable y el servicio del personal es muy profesional . Quiero agradecer en especial a mi concierge Fernando Mengó, me ayudó todo el tiempo en lo que necesite siempre con una amabilidad y una sonrisa siempre.  

En las reservas de restaurante me gustaría mencionar al joven Alberto Gutiérrez quien me ayudó con mis reservas de restaurantes. También a  los concierges Johana Solano, Nikel Lendor  y Asia Mateo.

Les recomiendo el hotel a todos.

reviews.author: Stephanie J
reviews.title: Most beautiful resort around...just don't eat or expect good service
reviews.text:
I recently returned from a 7 day/6 night trip to The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana.  Despite this resort’s offering the most aesthetically magnificent property and accommodations, this will go down as the worst vacation I have ever been on, as for more than half of my trip the resort failed to provide basic (as well as advertised) services during my stay.  

Let me start by telling you that I am a single woman who travels alone often.  I am accustomed to "higher end" vacations, and spend the money to have superior service.  I work hard, and I look to vacation as a time to have others wait on me for a little while.  By all accounts, this resort appeared to fit the bill, but ultimately failed miserably.
 
1.       During my stay, I (and the entire Reserve section of the resort) was without hot water from Friday (3/8) through the late afternoon on Tuesday (3/12).  Moreover, on Sunday (while they attempted to make repairs), there was no water at all from 10am through 8pm.  The resort’s response to this “inconvenience” was to have each guest from the Reserve pack a bag so they could be taken to another (much older) part of the resort that had hot water for bathing purposes only.  After your shower, they would shuttle you back to your room.  They would not accommodate “permanent” room changes or offer any monetary compensation.  
 
2.       As a resort that caters to English speaking Europeans, Canadians, and Americans, I was very surprised that more than just the most basic English communication skills were lacking in the service staff.  Of course the front desk and time share sales people spoke fluent English, but the pit boss in the Casino claimed to speak absolutely no English, and the dealers were very limited English speakers (and inexperienced dealers with trouble counting to 21 and making accurate payouts).
 
3.       The service staff at the Reserve Pool (which is a lovely spot), was very nice, but would disappear for two hours right around lunchtime, just when a guest would be looking for another cocktail or some lunch by the pool.  
 
4.       The food was, on average, well below expectations. The buffet breakfast was good, lunch was limited, and do not even attempt to dine at the Reserve buffet for dinner; it is absolutely abysmal.  The restaurants had slightly better fare, however, the resort is very strict that you must have a reservation for dinner in the restaurants (even if there are empty tables available).  My assigned concierge made dinner reservations for me one night, and I received a written confirmation of that reservation slipped under my door.  The following night my concierge made a reservation for me, but left no such written confirmation; fortunately, I ran into her (she was not always at the desk) and was able to verbally confirm my reservation for that evening.  A third time I requested a reservation, and received no verbal or written confirmation.  I called the main concierge number and they were unable to discern whether or not I had a reservation, and the restaurant does not have a phone number for guests to call directly.  Given the logistics of making my way to the restaurant (I was suffering with an pre-trip injury and was walking with a cane), I just gave up on going over to my choice restaurant that evening.
 
5.       Inconsistency is the norm. As an example, during my 6 night stay, I received only 3 nights of turn down service.  The other nights…nothing.  The internet was intermittent two or three days, but when you call to inquire about restoration, the response is “Yes, it is not working.”  What kind of service is that?
 
6.       When it was time for me to confirm my pre-paid ground transportation back to the airport, I was told that I had to travel to the main hotel where the ground transportation desks were located in order to make such a confirmation.  The desks didn’t have phones!  I traveled to the main hotel lobby (by tram because I walk with a cane and this is a bit of a hike from the Reserve lobby) in order to speak with the VIP representative.  I arrived only to be told that that representative was over at the Reserve!  One of his buddies at a competitor travel company called him on his cell phone to handle my confirmation, after which I caught another tram back to The Reserve to enjoy my last few hours by the pool.
 
While I may have gotten a “good deal” on my travel package, this was far from worth any amount of money I paid.  I have never complained about a trip in my life, however, this experience was just too awful.  This is not a "high end" vacation. This is more of a self-service opportunity.  I have never encountered such lack of interest in customer service anywhere, not even American fast food restaurants.  When I asked for some compensation for the major inconvenience caused by the water problems that were unique to the Reserve, they offered me the privilege of returning at a future date with two free nights...not on your life.  Unfortunately this resort does not live up to expectations, and, frankly, has soured me on the entire island. 

One final note: the spa services are great, but even the spa was experiencing power problems with the air conditioning cutting out for period of time.

reviews.author: Georges L
reviews.title: Maiker Ramirez
reviews.text: I have been traveling a long time and have been to many hotels around the world.  The service is often good but rarely excellent.  Maiker Ramirez, also known as drinky drinky works at the reserve beach and he is simply an amazing host, entertainer, server, companion and a light for the beach.  His attention to all patrons is amazing, he never forgets anything and he stays until the job is done.  He is a true star for this hotel.  I manage a lot of people on a daily basis and I would take him on my team any day of the week.  Great job Maiker, see you on my next visit to your hotel.  By the way this is my second time to this hotel, and I went back because I knew Maiker would be there to brighten my day on the beach.

reviews.author: traveller090
reviews.title: Amazing gardens, beach and resort
reviews.text:
This is an absolutely stunning resort on the a perfect, white sand, palm studded beach in Punta Cana.  The gardens are meticulous as is the entire resort.  It is absolutely beautiful throughout and the staff is attentive, friendly and know how to take good care of their guests.
I had some problems with the wifi but they were able to set up a router in my room that made my access to the internet perfect.

reviews.author: EricaCamillo
reviews.title: MEGA RESORT!
reviews.text: Férias incríveis e inesquecíveis! A praia de Bávaro é linda, os restaurantes são ótimos, as bebidas muuuito boas.... O atendimento é simplesmente nota 1000! No bar da piscina temos o Ramon "Fuego" - O ACROBATA, temos o Luis "Fueguito" - O MEGASIMPÁTICO, e tbm o Paulino - O BOMBA (e só pra atender um sonho meu de férias, ele aceitou, com a maior boa vontade, ser o meu JAMES PARTICULAR!!!
