E o pessoal da recreação Angel Alcantara e Joangel que não deixavam ninguem parado, era  futebol, volei, dança.... afff.... e por fim a Su, a nossa governanta, cordial, solícita, SEMPRE PRONTA pra atender nossos caprichos.... Ahhhh que férias!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: njespo
reviews.title: WOW!  Truly Paradise!
reviews.text:
I have been coming to Punta Cana for the past ten years and while I have had an enjoyable time everywhere I've been, I never felt the desire to return to the same place until now.  This place lives up to its name in that it is truly paradise.  The staff is wonderful and helpful in every way.  I could never remember all the names but I'll start with my check-in.  I was upgraded to The Reserve which was a pleasant surprise and the lovely lady who checked me in made sure I was given a cold tropical drink along with a wet washcloth to freshen up after the plane ride.  Very nice touch.  As I was waiting for my room to be made ready I was offered a complimentary massage at the Spa....Very nice touch (no pun intended!)   :)
The wait staff was vey helpful and always smiling...the shuttle drivers were always there when you needed a ride....One of the drivers was a fine young man named Starling who exemplified the fine staff employed at the resort.  The bartenders and chefs were absolutely fantastic and the premises were absolutely gorgeous and impeccably clean.  My room was a junior suite and eceeded my expectations...in brief, it was such a great place that I am already planning a return visit...I highly recommend it !!

reviews.author: miandomo
reviews.title: GASTRONOMIA
reviews.text:
Todo en el hotel es perfecto, lo mas excelente la cocina, dirigida por el gran chef Miguel Angel Domingo, que ha pesar de su corta edad ya es uno de los grandes, con un buen saber hacer, todos los platos exquisitos, de una elaboración perfecta.
Gracias por darnos de comer de esa forma

reviews.author: LewisOM
reviews.title: Very Good.. Not Great
reviews.text: Beautiful grounds and lobby.. Very friendly service.. Nice white, sandy beach with a great view if you wake up early enough to drop off towels to save a hut.This was my first trip to Punt Cana after 3 trips to Cancun at an all inclusive. What's similar about all of the trips is that service is only fair. No pepper in pepper shakers, no coffee cups on tables when waiter comes to pour some, no waiter at all to bring you coffee or refills, bringing coke instead of diet coke, chardonnay instead of cabernet.. Stuff that's not so bad as long as it's what's you expect. Poor countries with a language barrier results in spotty service. But people are very friendly and always helpful. Food is so, so.. Very nicely presented but there's only so many times you can go to the buffet and be wowed. Wake up early save a seat on the beach or the pool. enjoy the relaxation or go out and play if that's your pleasure (golf, non-motorized water activities ..snorkel (make reservation.. only 15 slots/day) , catamaran, paddle boat, kayak are included). shows are ok.. but it's something to do if you don't gamble. ala cart restaurants look great, food is fair at best. Alcohol is watered down.. after your drink is mixed give the guy a dollar and ask for a shot of rum/tequila etc. My favorite night spot was a coffee stand set up near the casino that made a custom cappuccino with a shot of bailey's.. yum..  room was large and even though only had a garden view (aka cheapest room rate) it was still very nice and comfortable with a view of a garden. plus had the benefit of a shorter walk to the pool, restaurants, etc

reviews.author: Pam S
reviews.title: Outstanding and attentive service was the highlight of my stay!
reviews.text:
This was my first visit to beautiful Punta Cana and it will not be my last! I had a fantastic time made even more special by the superior accommodations and friendly attentive staff at The Reserve at  Paradisus Punta Cana. Lilin Diaz and Diosmeri Francisco at the front desk guided me throughout my one week stay. I felt safe and cared for which was so important to me as I was traveling solo. It goes without saying that the resort is perfection. My corner one bedroom suite with jacuzzi and balcony was spacious, clean, and sunny. The beach, pools, spa, gym, restaurants, and bars were excellent! It was nice to enter the gym and be handed a water bottle & towel with a friendly hello. 

Jose De Los Santos at both the Reserve Pool and Beach made a lasting impression on me! He was there with towels and drinks without having to ask as if he could anticipate my every need. His friendly conversation and warm smile truly made my vacation extra special. His coworker Mikal was also very sweet! At Gabi, the poolside restaurant where I ate breakfast and lunch most days, the staff could not have been more pleasant! Whether it was Santos bringing me specially brewed Dominican coffee or the ear to ear smiles from Jorge Fidel making my day with his prompt attentive service. Jorge was also my server at Vento Restaurant for dinner where I ate several nights. He somehow managed to make me feel like I was his only guest from suggesting a dish or making me a special dessert, Jorge must be commended for his friendly and gracious service! 
Let me not forget the two most wonderful people who made me feel very special at Fuego Restaurant. My servers were Daniel Encarnacion and Marilin Villa. Trust me on this one....go to this restaurant more than once. I had two fabulous meals there and Ithe food is creative and delicious. But again it was Daniel and Marilin who gave me advise on the food and wine and made friendly conversation during my meal so much so that I felt like a VIP! 
Being solo at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana was unusual but I was always made to feel relaxed, happy, and completely well-cared for. I am recommending this resort to all and I am looking forward to returning soon!

reviews.author: Teddorjan
reviews.title: Don't go. Worst hotel resort i ever stayed. After 30 years travelling.
reviews.text: Rude, untrained staff. Horrible food buffet. Bad organized organization.  Unprofessional check in. Room smells bad. Wrong room. And that all for the price of over 300 dollar a night!!! If i compare this with hotels and resorts in the rest of the world. This is realy the worst for  this price i stayed until now.

reviews.author: Lucy N
reviews.title: Buenos empleados
reviews.text: Todo bonito, pero la habitacion muy lejos de la piscina y restaurant, a lo primero no me gusto,en la laguna se rompio una tuberia y salia un olor no muy agradable, pero lo compusieron rapido, gracias a Dios, Juan Robinson, Rosa, Carlos Trinidad en el Restaurant muy amistosos y profesionales, Ramon fuego, Luis fueguito, y Gillermo avila, bartenders de la piscina, muy simpaticos y dispuestos, la animacion me gusto mucho especialmente, Jose actividades y Maria la coreografa, fueron una bendicion en mi estancia, gracias a ellos la pase muy bien, Dios les bendiga a todos!

reviews.author: Ken F
reviews.title: A truly wonderful vacation
reviews.text: This was one of my best vacations ever! My trip to the resort was excelente! Being off season in October, the resort was not overly crowded. I upgraded to Royal Service and that made my trip even more special. My luggage arrived from Philadelphia  a day late and the staff constantly kept me informed about when I would receive it.The staff was exceptional especially Marcelo and Julio the butlers. One of the great things about Royal Service is that, besides Palazzo, I could eat at the other great restaurants. I will long remember the fresh fruit and juices. The food was abundant and the choices provided were ample and delicious. I offer kudos to the house keeping and beach maintenance staff for their great work. I definitely want to return to the clean beaches, beautiful water and facilities. I can' t stop talking about the the resort to my friends.

reviews.author: Baronalfbau
reviews.title: Baronalfbau
reviews.text:
Have been to many fine beach resorts - the Paradisus Palma Real exceeds all competition. I opted for the Royal Services upgrade and it was well worth it. The facility is beautiful and very well maintained. But truly it is the key staff members that make the experience exceptional like Manuel my butler anticipate my every need and delivered extras every night a dinner reservation was made for me at my desired hour, my Cabana was arranged by the Royal pool, when my day was complete I would come back to my room and find a hot foam bath waiting, a fresh snack, a fresh bottle of wine, and incense lit. Anything I needed was only a quick mobile phone call away - never a problem always accommodating. Manuel guided my stay with charm and same professionalism from arrival to my departure. 
Then there is Yomalyn the treasure of the of the Royal Services private lounge. Yomalyn checked me in, explained all elements of my stay, amenities available, organized complimentary drinks (my favorites) whenever I dropped by to relax for a bit and take advantage of the free wifi access. She is so warm and personable nothing was ever a bother or inconvenience. She is the charming person that represents the premier Royal Services experience. 
Take advantage of the Palazzo Restaurant (exclusive to Royal Package customers) - the food is fresh and very well prepared by the chef....but the staff are so friendly and attentive....especially Señor Ortiz. Richard was so friendly and checked in frequently to make sure I had everything I needed. The Vento Mediterranean restaurant was also very good....but the treasure there was the young lady that greets you as you enter....once met never forgotten as she not only greets and seats you but checks in regularly to make sure your comfortable and assures all your dining needs have been met or exceeded. 
Feel kinda bad for those guests that say they had a less then perfect experience....but all I can share is my own experience and all I can say is this place is a little piece of paradise on earth. My stay was perfect in every way. And large part of this was related to the wonderful staff members I mentioned.

reviews.author: Victor
reviews.title: Very good hotel and service
reviews.text:
I stayed in this hotel in August 2012 and found it very good:
The room (junior suite) was spacious and nice – big bed (TV close to it) jet bath for two, nice resting and kitchenette area with separate TV+ DVD player and a balcony 
As it was mentioned in many reviews – the room had an unpleasant smell and it seems in a humid tropical climate it is quite difficult to avoid this problem, but it was not really awful and after letting some fresh air inside and then putting on air conditioning the smell almost completely disappeared

The beach was very nice, especially Gabi beach with its white sand and DJ music in the evening, but as usual for this time of year there was a lot of sea grass and there were not so many people swimming in the sea.

Food was good, I would definitely recommend Passion gourmet restaurant and Gabi, Vento was also nice with its Mediterranean food. 

Entertainment included a live rock and jazz bands performing in the bar-area which I liked the most, as well as local shows and theme evenings (Michael Jackson show, 90-ies party, Latino music etc.) and of course Casino with its Texas Holdem tournaments.

YHI SPA is quite pricey but very good, especially “Baba” massage

Service was good, they called my room to ask about any complaints or observations and some minor problems were solved very quickly.

Overall impression over the hotel and its services was very good.
Special thanks to Ellyn Esbrera and Marcos Florentino

One important thing to take in mind when deciding to go to this hotel: it has several degrees of all-inclusive (starting from simple AI – white collars, then VIP AI – black collars, Royal service, Melia club members etc.) Simple AI does not permit access to certain areas of the hotel (like special pools and separated beach areas with pre-assigned Bali beds for Royal service guests or Family concierge-Club members) as well as options on visiting a la carte restaurants might be limited or involve a considerable extra charge. This all was a little confusing. Most of the excellent reviews on this hotel come from those who upgraded to VIP or Royal Service whereas limitations on a “simple” AI guest might bring some disappointment.

reviews.author: Destiny2210
reviews.title: Un verdadero Paraiso
reviews.text: Una experiencia inolvidable...Un hotel con excelentes instalaciones y con un personal siempre atento a las necesidades del huésped, siempre con una sonrisa. Maravillosos jardines, majestuosa piscina, tragos, playas soñadas...para recomendar!!!

reviews.author: Marta P
reviews.title: Royal Service hace la diferencia !!!!
reviews.text:
Estuve en el Royal Service del Paradisus Palma Real de Playa Bavaro en el mes de julio. Es realmente de excelencia. Las instalaciones, la recepcion, las habitaciones, el restorante Palazzo, el personal, la preciosa playa y piscinas, superaron ampliamente mis expectativas !!!!  Si a esto le sumamos unos dias de sol increibles y el maravilloso entorno de esa zona de Punta Cana puedo decir que es uno de los mejores sitios del Caribe para pasar unas vacaciones muy tranquilas y agradables.
No puedo dejar de mencionar a Richard y Santos del Restorante Palazzo, siempre atentos y eficientes. A Francisco, Wilkin, Martin y Pedro de la piscina y el bar de playa exclusivos del Servicio Real, tambien muy amables y alegres. Y a Julio, el mayordomo asignado por el hotel, que se ocupo con real interes de todos los detalles. Increibles tus jacuzzi, Julio !!!!
En cuanto al sector de recepcion del Royal Service, que fue remodelado este año, no solo puedo decir que quedo muy comodo y precioso, sino que su personal soluciono a mi llegada, rapidamente y con una sonrisa una cancelacion de mi reserva que se habia producido por un error de mi agencia de viales.
En resumen, un lugar en el que uno parece atendido "por sus propios dueños" . Para volver muchas veces.

reviews.author: Cindy B
reviews.title: Nice Wedding
reviews.text: I was not a happy auntie!!  The service was less than desirable.  Rooms smelled very musty water on coffee table there for 3 days from plant.  Unable to use any restaurants do to time constraints.  Checked in at 5 so had to do buffet even though checkin clerk stated just show up and they will let you in when my sister got there late 9:30 pm. Refused us and dressed very nicely!!  No one could understand English.  Transportation arranged by Romance, they insisted my sister call day before departure.  The hotel charged us after 45 min lost in translation...$17.  She gave them $50 and another 20 min to find change!!  They actually took it out of my debit card too which created an international fee.  They only had beer in refrigerator and did not ever replenish our water the whole time.  Our room was comped as my sister is groom's mother.  So they said they had to charge us $400 last night even though much less online or other guests!!  Food was not the greatest although I only got to eat at a restaurant 1 night out of 4.  It advertises all these restaurants not open for lunch and all reservations.  Did not make you ever feel welcome there.  It is hotter than the 3 trips to Africa, Aruba, Puerto Vallarta etc.  I would never return to this resort.

reviews.title: AndRey Gal
reviews.text:
Отдыхал в этом роскошном отеле 2 недели. Сразу скажу, что я очень придирчивый человек и мне сложно угодить, также обращаю внимание на самые мелкие детали. Но в Paradisus Palma придраться к чему-то невозможно. Персонал настолько профессионален, что погружение в полный рай проходит на самом высоком уровне. 
Здесь прекрасно всё! Кухня восхитительная! Пляж (особенно Royal Service) заслуживает только самых высоких похвал. 
В общем, если есть выбор между Paradisus и чем-то ещё, то тут и думать нечего, только PARADISUS!

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: The Staff Was Incredible
reviews.text:
I have stayed at many upscale hotels including other Melia hotels and several Kempenski hotels, and I would rate my stay at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort as my best overall hotel experience.  I have had the pleasure of staying at other hotels were the facilities were equally good and some that had better food (not that the food wasn’t good), but none could match the landscaping or the people that they had working there. The landscaping was probably the best that I’ve seen, but what truly differentiates the Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort from the other hotels and makes it my new favorite vacation spot are the people that work at this hotel. 

I have never been greeted as warmly by so many different hotel employees as I was at the Paradisus Palma Real.  The hotel employees acted like they were genuinely happy to see me, and made me feel like I was truly a special guest.  The ladies that cleaned the room, the bar tenders, the waiters and waitresses, and the hostesses all made me feel welcome.  I wish I could remember the names of all of the great employees I encountered while I was there, unfortunately I only recall a few and I would like to give a special thank you to all of them including Nelson (the bartender at Gabi Beach); Altaonia Pio (waitress at the Lobby bar); Alexandra Infante (hostess at Vento) and last but not least my absolute favorite employee in the entire hotel Isaura Garcia (hostess at Naos). 

Additionally, the entertainment was good also and included a casino and nightly shows that either showcased live music or a theatre show. The facilities were excellent. The room had a living room area, a balcony, a bathroom area and a bedroom area with a Jacuzzi in it.  The Spa was nice, but I have been to some hotels that had a better Spa.  

Thank You

Michael from Georgia 
(Room #3428)

reviews.author: Michele0322
reviews.title: Blissful
reviews.text:
This resort is absolutely breath taking the moment you walk into the main entrance/lobby. The staff is very friendly and helpful. The food is horrible. I got sick my third night...really bad...one of the staff at the front desk Vladimir Rodriguez came to my room and was patient and stayed with me after seeing how sick I was. He called a doctor and waited with me until the doctor came to my room. He also followed up the next day to make sure I was doing better. I was vomitting nonstop and had severe stomach ache that I could not walk, stand up right, nor lay down. I called and was very angry due to the pain. I was rudely speaking to Vladimir and NOT once did he gave me attitude. He was calm, patient, and understanding at all times. I was on vacation by myself and it was scary getting sick there, but with an outstanding employee like Vladimir by my side...I felt safe.

Also Jose from the entertainment Activities, Emmanuel Rodriguez bus/bell man, Edgar Gonzalez at the customer service were all very helpful and friendly as well. These employees made my stay at the Paradisus Palma Real wonderful.

Also Grammy Yaniel from VIP Travel Services at this resort is excellent. He gave me great advice on a few excursions to visit must see places in Dominican Republic. I enjoyed my visit to Saona Island, went parasailing, Ocean Spa, club Imagine. Thanks to Grammy I never had a boring moment in DR.

I would definitely revisit this beautiful resort!!!!

reviews.author: Tat3115
reviews.title: T. S. Toronto, Canada
reviews.text:
I just returned from a one week stay at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. I enjoyed it very much. It is upscale resort.  All the staff was very friendly. Almost every one was fluent in English and some spoke other languages as well.
Food was excellent and service was great. The front desk manager Rafael Torres spent a great deal of time to help choose the best room and plan suitable for me. Josefina Abrey -front desk receptionist made me extremely happy finding me the ocean front room and helping to choose the royal service with many priveleges inluding an exclusive beach area for the fraction of money. She helped make my trip so pleasant. The room was huge and very clean. The bed was very comfortable and linens were changed daily. At night it was very quiet in the hotel. It is a 500 rooms hotel and it was almost completely booked but I never felt crowded on the beach or in the pool and restaurantes. 
The Gabi restorante is one of the best but you pay for the meal if you are a standard  service member. I recommend to upgrade your service from standard but after your arrival.
The pools area was beautiful with a lot of vegetation and very comfortable sunbeds. The hotel has a very wide and long white sandy beach with many palapes. 
One very negative thing with this hotel is  Ilike to swim in the ocean and the sea weed was growing all over in the water. It was very unpleasant.

reviews.author: Monica O
reviews.title: Great Experience !
reviews.text:
If you are looking for few days to relax, enjoy the beach, and pamper your place.   This resort will be the best choice.

The SPA is excellent !!  all the staff was very kind and always ensuring you were pampered.  If you are thinking on getting a massage, Rosi is Fantastic !!  Apart from being very professional her kindness and positive spirit makes the difference.

This is the first time I have a one week holidays alone.  I was a bit worried at the beginning, but once I arrived at the Resort I felt safe, respected and the best of all pampered.  Exactly what I was looking for.  !!

I will go back again and will recommend this place to everyone looking for a week of peace !

reviews.author: VICTORIA R
reviews.title: Прекрасный отель (Виктория)
reviews.text:
Отдыхала в Paradisus Palma Real в марте 2012 года. Можно сказать, что нашла *свой* отель, хотя в Доминикане восьмой раз. Красивая территория, чистота, интересный ландшафт. Все очень компактно, самое главное - нет паровозиков с их удушающими выхлопами. Все в зоне шаговой доступности. Сервис безупречен - никакой медлительности, невнимательности, *маньяны*, чего я насмотрелась в других отелях, причем в некоторых не ниже по классу.
  Очень понравилось питание: здесь нет безумно больших столов с повторяющимися (зачастую непрожареными, непроваренными блюдами). Пробовала почти все: очень и очень вкусно. Готовят с душой. Фруктов в достатке, всегда стоят огромные вазы. Алкоголь очень достойный, на любой вкус. Коктейли отличные.
 У меня была концепция Royal servis. Сюда входит отдельная зона на пляже (сам пляж - это отдельная песня) с мягкими лежаками размером с 2х спальную кровать и балийские кровати. Всегда можно спокойно занять место под солнцем или под навесом. С полотенцами проблем нет: берешь, сколько хочешь и оставляешь на пляже. Также есть свой отдельный бар и бассейн, куда вход другим гостям запрещен. На пляже обслуживают официанты, делают все очень быстро и с улыбкой (и лежаки переставляют по просьбе гостей, полотенцами застилают, приносят все из бара вплоть до кофе в кофейнике и чашечками).
  Для меня самое главное было, что в этой части отеля нет заселения с детьми, поэтому отдых прошел очень спокойно, как и планировалось.
 Убирали в номере хорошо . Без всяких напоминаний ванная комната наполнялась полотенцами, шампунями и т.д. два  раза в день. На ночь оставляли шоколадку.
 Баттлер постоянно звонил или заходил, узнавал: нужна ли какая-нибудь помощь. Внимание чувствовалось везде и во всем.
  У Royal  есть отдельный ресепшен, где происходит оформление заселения и выписки из отеля. Здесь накрывают завтрак, ланч, вечером что-то типа фуршета. Всегда есть кофе. чай, закуски, вода в холодильнике. Также там есть бесплатный интернет, но у кого с собой планшет - в каждом номере WI-FI бесплатно.
  Впечатления от отеля самые положительные, недостатков не обнаружила. В июне собираюсь снова туда.

reviews.author: kevinmarshall
reviews.title: just returned from paradise
reviews.text:
just returned from the paradisus palma real and loved every minute of it
i did pay for the royal service and def received it thanks Ramone He went above and beyond to make sure i had everything i needed. I love this rersort and plan to return ASAP

reviews.author: Aaron B
reviews.title: FUEGO FUEEEEEGO!!!!
reviews.text:
Vine aquí solo por una semana de vacaciones, increible el lugar, muy lindo, buena comida y tragos, el staff es muy amable,

reviews.author: Tori E
reviews.title: The Best Vacation I've Ever Had
reviews.text:
My vacation to Paradisus Palma Real was AMAZING!  I had read some bad reviews before going and cannot believe that anyone could have one bad thing to say.  From the very moment I got there, to the very end, everyone was so nice and accommodating.   Also, I traveled alone and it was very safe.  I was a little worried about that, but no one bothers you, especially since it's mostly couples.

RESORT: very clean.  There are a couple of pools, one being very big.  The pools have beds in them with tables for your drinks.  I thought this was a nice touch so you don't have to tread water.  Some are even covered by huts.  I got Royal Service (worth the money!) so I mostly stayed at the RS pool.  I enjoyed it b/c it was quieter and there were no kids.  Also, the RS beach seemed to have more bali beds under huts which are conducive to sleeping.   The beach was clean and the water great.  There were butlers walking around asking if you needed anything.  The bars were plenty and stocked with top shelf if that's what you like.

ROOMS: also very clean.  I was worried I might see a cockroach, and I didn't see one.  My room had a jacuzzi which the staff prepared for me every night.  There was a flat screen TV, mini bar, and patio.  There is plenty of water, juice, and soda stocked in the room, but if you need more, just call and they'll be right there.  I also ordered the scented pillows which were a nice touch.

FOOD: I mostly ate at the Gabi Beach restaurant which I really liked.  The salads were great.  The breakfast is by far the best meal - and I never ate at the RS one.  The fruit is the best I've ever had.  I did eat at Passion and Tempaki but really liked being outside better.  Take advantage of the smoothie bar open all day.  

ACTIVITIES: There were plenty, but I didn't do any of them since I wanted a week of doing nothing but sitting in the sun.  They looked like fun though.

NIGHTLIFE: Not much of one.  I wasn't going for the nightlife at all.  If you are, you might want to try Aruba.  From what I heard at the airport, none of the resorts had nightlife.

OTHER TIPS: The punta cana airport is very easy to navigate.  Just have your papers ready when you get off the plane.  I took a cab to the Palma Real which was $30.  They drive like nut cases, but that's how it is. 

If you have any questions, please email me thru this sit.  I'd be happy to answer them.

reviews.author: SwitzerlandAnisa1
reviews.title: I loved the site - tip for wheelchair Users
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel for two weeks and must say that I was impressed by the architecture and the surroundings. My congratulations go the architect who built this hotel. The architect has a true sense for aesthetics combined with a sense for details. Wheelchair users will feel very comfortable in this hotel as it is fully accessible. However, be sure to ask for the special wheelchair room. To note if you are travelling alone, you must have strong arms in order to use the bed which is quite high! Otherwise, the toilette is accessible sideways and the shower is a drive in. If you do not want to go use your own wheelchair ask the special chair. If you want to swim in the ocean, ask Guest Services to organize for some to help you. The staff is friendly and helpful.  A. W. Switzerland

reviews.author: audrav
reviews.title: you get what you pay for
reviews.text:
I just got back from spending one week in paradise at the Paradisus Palma Real. This resort by far is #1 in Punta Cana, but you pay for what you get.

The hotel itself is beautiful. The design and layout is perfect. All the restaurants, theatre, disco etc…are all in the main building which is covered so when it rains, you will never get wet.

The restaurants are small in size but the quality and presentation of food is excellent. They have every imported type of wine and alcohol for you, all-inclusive. I had a couple of Cosmopolitans there and they were excellent. When having dinner or lunch every time I ordered a glass of wine, blanco or rosado, they would bring you a new bottle, poor you a sample to taste, and off they’d go. California, France, Italian - It was like being home.

The rooms are all the same, only the view changes. They are all Jacuzzi suites, with a balcony the décor is beautiful. My view looked into the Zen Garden. I sat outside many nights and enjoyed the peacefulness

The pool is very large, with a swim up bar. They play relaxing jazz music, there is no loud sankie activity by the pool. There are many bani beds and palapas no shortage here. 

The spa and gym facilities are great. I did not go to the spa, but had a thorough tour. I went to the gym a couple of times, I took the spinning class, it was good. They also offer yoga and pilates.

The animation team is not hanging around by the pool all day. They do a few dance classes which they take people on the beach for, so they don’t bother the people that want to relax. They offer wine tasting, painting lessons, Spanish lessons, drink mixing, flower arranging that kind of thing, it was a little different.  There is horseback riding included as well as various water sports. The entertainment at night was ok. I went to a couple of shows by the animation team, which were really poor quality the Boogey Nights and Latin Hits show were what you would expect from the team. Then there was the Michael Jackson Show that was very entertaining. One night they had a small band just playing music in the courtyard, the singer was excellent. They had a beach party at Gabi Beach, it was very well organized, the staff was all dressed in flowing white clothes and they played modern music, it was nice. The casino is quite big, the disco is small and they played the same music all the time.

This resort is definitely tailored to honey-mooners, families and business groups, if you want to come here to party you’re at the wrong resort.

The people that work at the resort are very professional. When you arrive, they set up a time to give you a tour where they try to make you buy into a points program with the chain. It takes an hour, but at least you get a good overview of the resort.

I would definitely recommend this resort to honey-mooners, and for business meetings. 

I got what I needed out of the vacation, and would definitely return.
